Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Niederuzwil liegt in einer attraktiven Gegend des Kantons St. Gallen und bietet Ihnen eine hervorragende Verkehrsanbindung durch die Nähe zur Autobahn sowie zu Bahnhöfen. Die Region besticht durch ihre Nähe zu Appenzell und zum Bodensee-Raum, was Ihnen Flexibilität bei der Wahl Ihres Wohnortes ermöglicht. Als Arbeitsort profitieren Sie von der wirtschaftsstarken Ostschweiz mit vielfältigen Branchen und kurzen Wegen zu etablierten Unternehmensstandorten.

### Das packen Sie als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Niederuzwil an

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihr Rüstzeug für den erfolgreichen Einstieg

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Langzeitpflege

Die Langzeitpflege lebt von Beziehung: Sie begleiten Menschen über lange Zeit, kennen ihre Gewohnheiten und bauen echtes Vertrauen auf. Dabei begleiten Sie auch komplexe, chronische Verläufe – mit Ruhe und Kontinuität statt Hektik.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Niederuzwil verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

In der Region Niederuzwil besteht eine hohe Nachfrage nach diplomierten Pflegefachpersonen in der Langzeitpflege, da die demografische Entwicklung den Bedarf kontinuierlich steigert. Sie haben als Fachkraft ausgezeichnete Chancen auf dem Arbeitsmarkt und können von flexiblen Anstellungsmodellen im 80-100-Prozent-Bereich profitieren. iPersonal erleichtert Ihnen den Einstieg durch spezialisierte Vermittlung zu sorgfältig ausgewählten Arbeitgebern in Ihrer Region und bietet Ihnen dabei umfassende Beratung sowie schnelle Platzierung.

Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

jobs.title: Laboratory Manager
jobs.description:
The Quake Laboratory is being established at ETH Zürich in 2026 by Stephen Quake, who is moving from Stanford University. The lab works at the interface of physics, engineering, and biology, developing new measurement and modelling approaches that transform what is possible to learn from individual cells and from minute amounts of molecular material.

Three major research programmes will run in parallel: (1) reconstructing the regulatory architecture of E. coli at high resolution as a foundation for predictive models of gene regulation; (2) building large-scale single-cell atlases of human and model-organism tissues — including a first-of-its-kind atlas of the human autonomic nervous system — and training AI/foundation models on those atlases to interrogate aging biology and the evolution of multicellularity; and (3) advancing liquid-biopsy approaches that read cell-free nucleic acids from blood to detect disease, monitor physiology in collaboration with external partners.

The lab will be a multidisciplinary environment of approximately 10 people spanning molecular biologists, biochemists, computational biologists, machine-learning researchers, physicists, and engineers, with active collaborations across ETH, EPFL, the University of Zürich, and internationally.

The Laboratory Manager is the operational backbone of the group. You will own the day-to-day functioning of a complex, multi-modal wet lab — from bacterial molecular biology through human clinical sample processing through high-throughput sequencing — while serving as senior bench scientist, trainer, and trusted adviser to the PI on everything that keeps a productive research group running.

This role is ideal for an experienced research scientist who enjoys working across multiple biological systems, building infrastructure, mentoring less experienced colleagues, and taking pride in operational excellence. You will not be expected to drive a separate independent research programme; rather, you will enable and accelerate everyone else's. In return, you will be a core, named contributor on ambitious science, with a genuine voice in how the lab is built.

Lab operations and infrastructure

Lead the build-out and ongoing operation of the lab's wet-bench facilities at ETH, including equipment selection, installation, qualification, and routine maintenance contracts
Establish and maintain shared resources: cell culture rooms, BSL-2 areas, sequencing prep zones, –80 °C and liquid-nitrogen storage, autoclaves, common reagent stocks, and instrument calendars
Own ordering, supplier relationships, inventory management, and stockroom organisation across consumables and reagents; negotiate framework agreements where useful
Maintain and audit core SOPs, sample-tracking systems, and electronic lab notebook practices across the group
Serve as the lab's interface with ETH core facilities (e.g., Functional Genomics Center Zurich, ScopeM, Genome Engineering & Measurement Lab) and external service providers
Bacterial molecular biology and biochemistry — E. coli regulome

Run and oversee a molecular cloning pipeline for E. coli — design and assembly of plasmids and genome-integrated constructs, strain construction, and storage
Set up and maintain biochemical workflows relevant to regulatory studies: protein expression and purification, in vitro transcription, and quantitative biochemistry as projects require
Establish microbial growth, induction, and time-course infrastructure, including plate readers, continuous-culture systems, and microfluidics interfaces where relevant
Train new lab members in fundamental microbiology, sterile technique, and standard E. coli genetics; troubleshoot stuck cloning and expression projects
Mammalian cell biology and tissue handling — single-cell atlases

Run and supervise mammalian cell culture (primary cells, iPSC-derived cells, established lines), including media preparation, line authentication, and biobanking
Establish robust workflows for tissue dissociation, single-cell and single-nucleus suspension preparation, FACS-based cell sorting, and quality assessment
Coordinate the tissue-acquisition pipeline with clinical and academic partners — biospecimen agreements, chain-of-custody documentation, fixation and shipping logistics, ethics-approved sample handling
Liquid biopsy and cell-free nucleic acid workflows

Operate and maintain low-input cfDNA and cfRNA extraction workflows
Implement and refine cfNA library-preparation protocols (small-input WGS, methylation/EM-seq, fragmentomics, targeted panels, cfRNA-seq) and contribute to method development for new assay modalities
Establish quality-management practices appropriate to clinical-grade samples
High-throughput sequencing

Serve as the lab's senior practitioner for sequencing workflows— including library QC, pooling, balancing, and instrument operation or vendor coordination
Establish QC dashboards and acceptance criteria across library types (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA/ATAC, spatial, cfDNA/cfRNA, microbial)
Coordinate with computational team members on sample sheets, demultiplexing, primary QC, and timely return of FASTQs and standard metrics
Maintain relationships with the Functional Genomics Center Zurich and external sequencing providers to handle overflow and specialty platforms
People, training, and culture

Onboard new lab members (postdocs, PhD and MSc students, technicians, visitors); design and deliver hands-on training in core methods
Mentor junior research staff and rotation students at the bench; lead routine technical lab meetings and troubleshooting clinics
Foster a rigorous, collaborative, and psychologically safe lab culture; embody and reinforce expectations around reproducibility, careful record-keeping, and intellectual honesty
Compliance, safety, and ethics

Serve as the lab's biosafety officer and primary point of contact for ETH Safety, Security, Health & Environment (SGU); maintain BSL-1/BSL-2 documentation, GMO and pathogen registrations as applicable
Ensure compliance with Swiss regulations on the use of human biological samples and personal data (Human Research Act, Federal Act on Data Protection), including ethics submissions and amendments
Manage chemical inventory, waste streams, radiation safety (where applicable), and animal-work documentation in coordination with ETH veterinary services
Lead the lab's emergency-preparedness procedures and serve as first responder for incidents
Desired Qualifications

Education: PhD in molecular biology, biochemistry, bioengineering, genomics, or a closely related field; or a Master's degree with substantial additional research experience
Bench experience: At least 5 years of hands-on experience post-degree in a research lab, with demonstrable senior-level expertise across at least two of the three core areas (bacterial molecular biology / mammalian single-cell genomics / cell-free nucleic acid workflows)
Bacterial cloning and biochemistry: Independent experience designing and executing E. coli cloning, strain engineering, and protein biochemistry without supervision
Mammalian cell biology: Fluency in primary and cultured mammalian cell handling, FACS, and tissue dissociation for single-cell genomics
Sequencing: Direct experience preparing and QC'ing libraries for Illumina sequencing; familiarity with at least one long-read platform (ONT or PacBio) is a strong advantage
Liquid biopsy / cfNA: Demonstrated experience processing blood for cell-free nucleic acids and the pre-analytical care this requires
Lab leadership: Track record of training and supervising more junior scientists; ability to write clear SOPs and run a cross-functional bench operation
Operational competence: Comfortable with budgets, ordering systems, equipment service contracts, and biosafety documentation
Communication: Excellent written and spoken English; ability to interact effectively with clinicians, vendors, ETH administration, and external collaborators
Preferred Qualifications

Experience with single-cell genomics platforms (10x Genomics, Parse, Scale, Honeycomb) and spatial transcriptomics
Experience with clinical or biobank sample workflows under ISO 15189 / ISO 20387 or equivalent quality systems
Experience with Swiss research administration, ETH systems, or comparable European institutions
German language skills
A senior, intellectually central position in one of the most productive single-cell and measurement-science groups in the world as it moves from Stanford to ETH
Competitive ETH salary and benefits, commensurate with experience and ETH guidelines
A multi-year horizon: this is intended as a long-term role, not a stepping stone
Substantial influence on lab design, equipment selection, and operational standards
Co-authorship on publications you materially contribute to, in line with established practice
Professional development support, including conference travel and technical training
Relocation support for candidates moving to Basel, in line with E

jobs.title: Vice President Turbo Charging Research & Development (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled, strategic and innovative Vice President R&D to lead and manage the research and development of new turbocharging products, components, and technologies within our organization.

In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing the entire R&D process, including product performance testing, validation, and ensuring product safety and reliability. You will lead a team of ca 120 R&D employees and manage a budget of over 50 MUSD. You will collaborate closely with the division presidents and other senior leaders to ensure that all product releases meet the highest standards before launch. You and your experts will also support the process of technology scouting beyond turbocharging. Located in Baden, you will report to the CEO and be part of the extended management team.  

Your Responsibilities:

1. R&D Strategy and Leadership:

Lead and manage the turbocharging R&D department to drive the development of new products, components, technologies and engineering methodologies aligned with the company’s strategic goals.
Define and execute the TC R&D strategy ensuring it supports the company's vision and objectives.
Foster an innovative environment that encourages creative solutions, research breakthroughs, and efficient development processes.
Secure that the R&D budget is spent efficiently on related projects and initiatives.
Represent the company in industry organizations and initiatives, (eg. CIMAC Greenhouse Gas Strategy Group, Swissmem industry sector for the internal combustion engine industry), and support the Swiss IMO delegation.
2. Product Development and Innovation:

Oversee the development of new products from concept through to prototype, ensuring that each product meets performance, safety, and reliability standards.
Manage the research and design process to ensure efficient, cost-effective product development that reflects the customer needs and is in line with Accelleron Product Market Strategy.

3. Product Performance Testing and Validation:

Ensure that robust testing and validation processes are in place to assess product performance and reliability with adherence to safety and quality standards.
Maintain and continuously develop testing and computing infrastructure.
Focus on improving product performance, reliability and safety.
Identify potential risks and implement corrective actions throughout the product lifecycle.

4. Collaboration with Management:

Work closely with the Division Presidents and senior management to ensure alignment on product development goals and timelines.
Jointly approve and sign-off on all product releases with the Division Presidents to ensure that all products meet the required standards before market launch.
Enhance the opportunities that AI provides in collaboration with AI organization.
Collaborate with Vice President Strategy and Investor Relations on scouting of new technologies.

5. Continuous Improvement:

Identify opportunities for process improvements within the R&D department and across the organization to optimize efficiency and productivity.
Stay current on industry trends, research methodologies, AI and emerging technologies to maintain competitive advantage and drive innovation.
Build and maintain networks with diverse stakeholders such as universities, research institutions and associations to gain broad perspective of development and to represent the company.

6. Leadership and Development:

Lead, mentor, and manage the R&D team, ensuring that each member is supported in their professional development and empowered to contribute to the team’s success.
Secure that competences needed now and in the future are acquired and developed.
Foster a collaborative, high-performance and effective safety culture within the department.

​Your Qualifications:

In depth and proven knowledge of turbocharging technologies and research methodologies including an advanced degree in mechanical engineering.
Robust experience of leading R&D operations and engineering globally across a complex technology portfolio.
Strong track record of creating and leading technology strategies, investment prioritization and innovation portfolios, preferably on enterprise level and closely aligned with business strategy.
Experience of repeatedly leading technology development from concept through validation to market introduction, especially leading turbocharger programs successfully converting innovation into commercial outcomes.
Deep understanding of product performance testing, validation, safety, and reliability assessments as well as regulatory compliance.
Exceptional stakeholder and influencing skills based on having regularly interfaced with executive leadership, government agencies, universities, industry consortia and regulatory bodies while advising on technology and policy topics.
Excellent leadership skills with collaborative and people-focused leadership style proven in successfully leading sizable global teams.
Future technology and innovation orientation combined with strong business and investment acumen.
Curiosity, learning agility and entrepreneurial mindset.

Your benefits:

Attractive compensation & benefits
Employee Assistance Program
Global parental leave program
Flexible working models
We look forward to receiving your application. If you want to discover more about Accelleron, take another look at our website accelleron.com.

jobs.title: Director of Expeditions
jobs.description:
Director of Expeditions - School in Switzerland

A prestigious and internationally renowned boarding school in Switzerland is seeking an outstanding Director of Expeditions to lead one of the most distinctive outdoor education programmes in the world. Reporting to a senior member of the leadership team, the successful candidate will provide strategic and operational leadership for a large-scale expedition programme encompassing mountain, ski and adventure-based learning experiences. This is a rare opportunity for an experienced outdoor education professional with strong leadership credentials, technical expertise in alpine environments and a passion for developing young people through challenge, resilience and discovery.

JOB PURPOSE
The Director of Expeditions serves as the strategic lead for Aiglon’s renowned expedition department. The post holder is responsible for the development and delivery of the programme’s vision and ethos, ensuring it is progressive, relevant, and distilled into a coherent curriculum across the whole school. They provide leadership to a team of qualified expeditioners and ensure that all activities are managed with the highest standards of safety and risk management.
KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES FOR THE POSITION

1. Strategic Leadership & Vision

Visionary Design: Develop and oversee the philosophy and approach of our expedition programme, ensuring it reflects our aim to continue to be world leading in outdoor pursuit provision.
Curriculum Development: Develop and implement the expedition programme ensuring it is progressive for all students, regardless of age or length of stay at Aiglon.
Challenge: Ensure challenge is appropriate to ability and context, acknowledging that expeditions serve pastoral and community-building purposes alongside physical stretch.
Reinforce the purpose of expeditions: independence, resilience, responsibility and growth.
Holistic Assessment: Take a lead role in the school’s development of holistic assessment within the expedition context.
External Engagement: Seek to build relationships with the wider community to share expertise and gain insights from external best practices, with particular emphasis on risk management.

2. Operational Oversight & Management
Team Leadership: Provide instruction and guidance to the Head of Senior and Junior Expeditions in their operational oversight.
Leadership: Provide inspiration, leadership and guidance to all teaching staff involved in expeditions with the expectation to deliver the highest standards and professionalism.
Staff Development: Manage professional reviews, appraisals, and training (internal and external) for the expedition staff.
Meetings: Chair expedition department meetings and work closely with both Junior and Senior heads to ensure departmental alignment.
Stakeholder Liaison: Liaise with the School Council, Assistant Heads, Houseparents, and academic departments.
Recruitment: Oversee and support the recruitment of all expedition staff, including guides.
Development: Monitor and continually improve the process of student reflection.
Administration: Ensure all paperwork and communication is complete, efficient and effective.
Budgets: Preparation and management of all Expedition budgets
Administration: Use Aiglon’s data management system to record and organise all expeditions
Mountain School: Line-manage the Junior Mountain School Programme, with specific liaison with the Bear Grylls Survival Academy
Summer Camp: Act as the senior advisor for all summer expedition activities, ensuring a robust handover of safety protocols and operational standards to the Summer School team while maintaining ultimate accountability for safeguarding and risk management frameworks.
3. Safety, Risk & Compliance
Safety Evaluation: Oversee and evaluate the safety protocols of the entire expedition programme.
Risk Management: Encourage and verify a high level of risk management documentation and ensure operating standards align with best practice.
Open Culture: Ensure a safe and open environment for staff to share experiences and opinions to improve safety.

The qualifications, experiences and attributes of the post holder must match the detailed specification below:

Essential

Swiss-recognised International Mountain Leader/Accompagnateur
Winter mountaineering or ski qualification
Rock Climbing Instructor
First Aid certification
Driving licence
Professional working proficiency in French and a fluency in English

Desirable

Teaching qualification
Holder of an IFGMA qualification
Higher level qualification in other adventure activities:
Paddlesports
Mountain Biking

Essential

Experience in health and safety auditing, incident management protocols, and Swiss legal requirements for high-risk activities.
Experience in managing department budgets, equipment procurement, and overseeing a team of full-time and freelance staff.
Experience in designing progressive outdoor education programs that align with educational frameworks
Experience leading and teaching young people and groups in the European mountains in a variety of adventurous activities
Highly competent skier
Professional-level competence in winter navigation and avalanche safety
Experience in the creation and delivery of presentations and information to a wide range of audiences

C. Personal Qualities, Attitudes and Behaviours
Essential

Ability to build professional relationships with students within the clear boundaries of Aiglon’s safeguarding policies.
Ability to communicate clearly and effectively across all stakeholders.
The ability to inspire confidence in staff, students and parents whilst articulating the value of risk to the School Council and Board of Directors.
Proven ability to remain calm and lead a team through high-pressure emergency situations in remote environments.
Aiglon expects the Director to have a commitment to continuous professional development, staying at the forefront of international outdoor education trends and safety standards; they should also be expected to mentor junior staff in their professional development.

jobs.title: Trainee Account Management / Lektorat 100%
jobs.description:
Trainee Account Management / Lektorat 100%  
In unserem interdisziplinären Team aus Projektleiter:innen und Polygraf:innen mit Schwerpunkt Aktionswerbung und Preiskommunikation unterstützt du die Projektleiter:innen der Valencia Kommunikation AG in Basel. Ziel des sechsmonatigen Trainee\-Programms ist es, dich auf die Welt der Werbung vorzubereiten. Ein zentraler Bestandteil dabei ist das Kennenlernen der einzelnen Arbeitsschritte vom Briefing über die Umsetzung bis hin zur Produktion.  
Dein Weg in die operative Projektarbeit wird Schritt für Schritt aufgebaut und beginnt mit der selbstständigen Umsetzung kleinerer Projekte: Du erstellst Terminpläne und Offerten, briefst Teammitglieder, schreibst Rechnungen und stehst im Austausch mit Kund:innen sowie Dienstleister:innen. Da du in dieser Funktion viele Informationen liest, prüfst und vergleichst, sind eine hohe Konzentrationsfähigkeit, Genauigkeit sowie fokussiertes Arbeiten, auch über längere Zeit, besonders wichtig.  
Das Trainee\-Programm richtet sich an Talente mit organisatorischem Geschick, die Freude daran haben, vielfältige Aufgaben zu koordinieren. Fühlst du dich angesprochen? Dann erwartet dich ein praxisnahes Trainee\-Programm, das dir wertvolle Einblicke in die Arbeitswelt einer Kommunikationsagentur bietet.  
Das bringst du mit  
Persönlichkeit: Du bist aufgeschlossen, wissbegierig, anpassungsfähig, dienstleistungsorientiert und arbeitest gerne im Team.  
Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest seriös, zuverlässig und behältst auch in hektischen Situationen den Überblick.  
Kommunikation: Du kommunizierst gerne, präzise und kannst vernetzt denken.  
Sprache und Text: Du hast Leidenschaft für Text, Wort und Schrift sowie Freude an Sprachen. Viele unserer Aufträge werden in Deutsch, ösisch und Italienisch umgesetzt. Du musst nicht alle Sprachen beherrschen, Grundkenntnisse sind aber hilfreich.  
Ausbildung: Du hast eine abgeschlossene Berufsbildung im kaufmännischen Bereich, einen eidg. Fachausweis als Kommunikations\-, PR\- oder Marketingfachfrau/\-mann, einen Fachhochschulabschluss im Bereich Marketing, Kommunikation oder Linguistik oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung.  
Tools: Du bringst Anwendungskenntnisse in MS Office mit und hast Freude daran, weitere Software\-Programme zu erlernen.  
Warum Valencia?  
Weil du hier nicht einfach abarbeitest, sondern mitdenkst, mitgestaltest und Verantwortung übernimmst. Und weil wir überzeugt sind, dass gute Arbeit dort entsteht, wo Menschen Lust haben, sie gemeinsam gut zu machen.  
Dich erwarten die besten Arbeitskolleg:innen, vielseitige Projekte und ein zeitgemässes, flexibles Arbeitszeitmodell auf Basis einer 40‑Stunden\-Woche mit Remote\-Work\-Möglichkeit.  
Als monetäre Benefits erhältst du monatliche Lunchbons im Wert von CHF 150\.– und wir schenken dir nach der Probezeit das Halbtaxabonnement. Zusätzlich übernehmen wir deinen Krankentaggeldversicherungsbeitrag.  
Gleichzeitig investieren wir im Rahmen unserer «Academia de Valencia» bewusst in deine fachliche Entwicklung, sowohl zeitlich als auch finanziell.  
Du arbeitest in einer technisch hervorragend ausgestatteten Arbeitsumgebung mit flexiblen Arbeitsplätzen und schönen, offenen Räumen mitten in Basel. Unsere Agentur befindet sich in der Innenstadt und ist vom Bahnhof SBB in nur fünf Gehminuten erreichbar.  
Ein ganz besonderes Highlight ist unser jährlicher Agenturausflug: Gemeinsam verbringen wir ein Wochenende in «Valencia», wo auch immer dies sein mag.  
Willst du den ersten Schritt in die abwechslungsreiche Welt der Kommunikation wagen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. jpidd54244fjm jit0728jm jiy26jm

Client:  
Trust Accountant  
Description de l'entreprise  
Client:  
Our client is a respected independent provider of trust and corporate services with an established presence in Geneva and an international client base. Renowned for delivering bespoke solutions to private clients, entrepreneurial families and international structures, the firm combines technical expertise with a genuinely relationship\-driven approach.  
With a strong reputation for quality, discretion and long\-term client partnerships, the business offers a collaborative and multicultural working environment where professional development is encouraged, individual contributions are valued, and high standards of client service are at the heart of everything they do. This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing organisation working on a diverse portfolio of international trust and corporate structures.  
Description du poste  
Position:  
Due to continued growth, our client, a leading independent trust company, is looking to strengthen its Client Accounting team in Geneva. Joining a busy, close\-knit team, you will work closely with the Managing Director, fellow Trust Accountants and Trust Officers, taking ownership of a varied portfolio while contributing to a collaborative environment where quality, professionalism and exceptional client service are at the heart of the business.  
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  
Take ownership of the accounting for a portfolio of trusts, companies and foundations across a variety of international jurisdictions, including Swiss entities.  
Maintain accurate accounting records, perform bank and balance sheet reconciliations, and ensure the integrity of financial data.  
Prepare annual financial statements and supporting working papers in accordance with applicable accounting standards.  
Assist with the preparation of Swiss corporate tax returns for straightforward entities.  
Produce financial reports and management information for clients, trustees and other stakeholders.  
Work closely with Trust Officers and colleagues across the business to deliver a seamless, high\-quality service to clients.  
Identify opportunities to enhance accounting processes, controls and operational efficiency.  
Provide technical accounting support and contribute to wider team initiatives and ad hoc projects as required.  
Why Apply?  
Join a respected independent trust company with an established international presence.  
Work alongside experienced trust professionals in a collaborative, supportive team.  
Manage a varied portfolio of sophisticated international trust and corporate structures.  
Enjoy close interaction with senior management and the opportunity to make a real impact.  
Develop your technical expertise in a stable, professional environment committed to delivering exceptional client service.  
Competitive remuneration package, with salary commensurate with experience, qualifications and technical expertise.  
Profil recherché  
Profile:  
Degree or professional qualification in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline.  
At least 3\-5 years' accounting experience, ideally gained within a trust company, fiduciary, family office or international corporate services environment.  
Previous exposure to trusts, foundations and offshore structures would be a distinct advantage.  
Solid understanding of Swiss accounting principles, with experience preparing financial statements independently.  
Experience preparing accounts and simple tax returns for Swiss companies is highly desirable.  
Well organised, detail\-oriented and able to manage multiple deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.  
A proactive and solutions\-focused approach, with strong communication and relationship\-building skills.  
Able to work autonomously while also contributing effectively within a collaborative team.  
Fluent English is essential; French would be a significant asset.  
Must be eligible to work in Switzerland and hold a valid Swiss work permit.

jobs.title: Head of Marketing
jobs.description:
About KEMARO
Founded in Switzerland in 2016, KEMARO develops autonomous cleaning robots, cloud software and artificial intelligence for industrial use. In 2018, the company launched the K900, the world’s first autonomous dry-cleaning robot for industrial and logistics facilities. Today, KEMARO employs almost 60 people at its headquarters in Eschlikon and continues to grow internationally. Our solutions help companies in logistics, manufacturing and industry keep their operational areas clean, safe and efficient.

As we continue to scale internationally, we are looking for a Head of Marketing (m/w/d) to help shape our next stage of growth.

You will lead our marketing team across Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Marketing Operations and Events. Together with our leadership team, you will define our marketing and go-to-market strategy, develop the team and ensure that marketing contributes measurably to business growth.

Your tasks:

Go-to-Market Strategy:
- Define KEMARO's global go-to-market strategy in close collaboration with Product, Sales and the executive team.
- Provide strategic direction across Product Marketing, Sales and Marketing to ensure a consistent go-to-market approach.
- Challenge and guide ICP selection, positioning and messaging developed by the Product Marketing team.
- Lead international market expansion and new market entries (e.g. US).

Revenue & Demand Generation:
- Define the demand generation strategy and ensure marketing delivers measurable pipeline growth.
- Guide the team in building integrated campaigns across digital marketing, partner marketing, events, and product marketing.
- Ensure marketing investments and campaigns are optimized for commercial impact.
- Own the global marketing budget and allocate investments based on business impact and growth priorities.

Partner & Agency Management:
- Define and scale our global partner marketing strategy.
- Enable our international partner network with impactful marketing programs and assets.
- Lead and manage external agencies across key markets to ensure consistent execution and measurable business impact.

Brand & Communications:
- Strengthen KEMARO's global brand and thought leadership.
- Ensure consistent messaging and compelling value propositions across all customer touchpoints.

Leadership:
- Lead, coach and develop a growing team of marketing specialists, enabling them to excel in their respective disciplines while ensuring all activities support a coherent marketing strategy.
- Foster close collaboration across Marketing, Sales, Product and the executive team.
- Act as a strategic sparring partner to the CEO and CCO on marketing, go-to-market and commercial growth.


Your profile:

- Proven experience leading B2B marketing for complex products in technology, industrial automation, robotics, MedTech or similar industries with long sales cycles and multiple decision-makers.
- Strong understanding of the full B2B marketing ecosystem, from go-to-market strategy, product marketing and positioning to demand generation, partner marketing and international market expansion.
- You understand how technical products are commercialized and how Marketing, Sales, Product and partners need to work together to drive business growth.
- Experience leading and developing high-performing marketing teams, setting a clear vision, coaching specialists, and enabling them to succeed.
- Comfortable switching between strategic leadership and hands-on execution where you can create the greatest business impact.
- A trusted sparring partner for Sales, Product and executive leadership, able to challenge assumptions and translate business priorities into marketing strategy.
- Data-driven and commercially minded. You measure success by pipeline, revenue and business impact—not by marketing activities alone.
- Naturally curious. You enjoy understanding customers, industries and buying processes before defining strategy, and you're excited by the challenge of scaling complex B2B technology internationally.

We offer:

- A key leadership role in a fast-growing Swiss robotics company with global ambitions.
- Significant ownership, autonomy, and the opportunity to shape both the marketing organization and KEMARO's global growth journey.
- Participation in our PSOP (Phantom Stock Option Plan), allowing you to share in KEMARO's long-term success.
- A collaborative, international team with flat hierarchies, short decision-making paths, and direct access to the executive team.
- Flexible working with up to 50% home office (after the probation period).
- Individual learning and professional development opportunities.
- Regular team events and a culture built on trust, curiosity, and continuous learning.


Have we sparked your interest?

Are you ready to help make the world cleaner and more digital?

We look forward to receiving your complete and compelling application via our website, addressed to Jasmin Meier. Please note that we prefer direct applications and can only consider applications submitted through our website.

jobs.title: Senior .NET Engineer - Front Office Trading
jobs.description:
Senior .NET Engineer \- Front Office Trading  
As the premier supplier to our international banking client in Basel, Swisslinx are looking for an experienced Senior .NET Engineer with strong Microservices knowledge and experience in containers to support a Trading Systems project.  
Senior .NET Engineer \- Front Office Trading  
Job description:  
Design, implement, and test .NET microservices to enable data connections between external SaaS services and internal applications.  
Collaborate with team members to ensure alignment with existing architecture and patterns.  
Document design and implementation decisions.  
Perform requirements analysis, design, and initial testing for the system within a team context.  
Provide on\-call support for deployed microservices.  
Contribute to discussions on system design and architecture improvements.  
Ensure microservices are secure, scalable, and maintainable.  
About the customer:  
In this role the SW Developer will integrate external SaaS services with internal applications used for front to back tracding.  
This is an initial contract running for 24\+ months with strong likelihood to extend on a long term basis (up to five years) based on the project road maps, with start date by November 2026\.  
As part of an agile team, the engineer will ensure that the microservices align with the existing architecture and design patterns while meeting the evolving needs of the organization. This position will involve close collaboration with other software engineers, business analysts, and stakeholders from various departments such as Risk, Finance, Banking Backoffice and Front Office (Traders).  
Requirements:  
At least five years' SW development experience of which at least 2 years should be in C\#/.NET Core \& micro\-services  
Experience in Kubernetes / OpenShift Container Platform is mandatory  
A passion for clean code, software craftsmanship and automated testing (TDD a plus), and the ability to impart this knowledge to others.  
Strong hands\-on experience with message queues (ideally Kafka),  
Experience with relational and non\-relational databases (HDFS is a plus),  
Knowledge of modern CI/CD pipelines  
Experience in a bank or similar highly regulated environment, including knowledge of trade lifecylce  
Fluency in English  
The following are nice to have but not mandatory:  
Experience with the secure software development lifecycle  
Knowledge of financial transactions and operations.  
Compensation benefits:  
Please note interviews would be conducted via video call ( two rounds), however the role is based 100% in Switzerland. Our client offers:

jobs.description:

L’entreprise et vous  
Chez Services Plus Énergies (SPE), nous accompagnons nos clients dans les métiers du chauffage, de la ventilation et de la climatisation, avec une forte exigence de qualité, de réactivité et de fiabilité.  
Dans le cadre de l’évolution de notre métier, nous recherchons un·e Exploitant·e d’installations CVC pour prendre en charge un parc d’installations et en assurer le bon fonctionnement au quotidien.  
Ce rôle va bien au\-delà de la simple surveillance technique. En tant qu’Exploitant·e, vous êtes responsable de vos installations : vous suivez leur état, anticipez les dérives, réalisez les interventions nécessaires et contribuez directement au confort des habitants, tout en veillant à limiter les consommations d’énergie.  
Vous devenez progressivement l’interlocuteur de référence sur votre parc, reconnu pour votre connaissance des installations, votre réactivité et votre capacité à faire avancer les sujets avec sérieux et bon sens.

jobs.title: Observability Engineer
jobs.description:
Observability Engineer  
Job Description  
As an Observability Engineer, you will take on hands\-on engineering role with real influence on the evolution of our observability landscape. You design, implement and operate modern observability solutions that ensure transparency, reliability and performance of our IT services across cloud and on\-premises environments.  
This role combines deep technical ownership with exposure to modern observability standards and cloud technologies. You will work closely with experienced platform, architecture and service management teams and collaborate with our ServiceNow team to technically integrate observability signals and alerts into Service Now Event Management (ITOM).  
While your focus remains hands\-on engineering, platform operation, and continuous improvement, you will also actively contribute to strategic topics such as observability strategy, roadmap definition and platform evolution, while remaining strongly rooted in implementation and day\-to\-day operations.  
Engineer, operate and continuously improve observability platforms as a service for infrastructure, platform and application teams;  
Implement and maintain telemetry collection for metrics, logs and traces using open standards such as Prometheus and OpenTelemetry;  
Design and operate scalable telemetry pipelines, including collection, processing, enrichment and routing of observability data;  
Build and maintain dashboards, alerts and service level indicators that support both operational teams and service owners;  
Integrate observability platforms with IT service management solutions, event management, and automation workflows;  
Support migration from legacy monitoring platforms to modern observability solutions;  
Troubleshoot complex performance and availability issues across distributed systems;  
Collaborate closely with application teams, service owners and platform stakeholders, providing consultative guidance and observability best practices to improve observability coverage and signal quality;  
Contribute to the definition and evolution of observability standards, best practices and guidelines;  
Contribute input to observability strategy, roadmap planning and technology evaluation;  
Create and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, and onboarding guides.  
Requirements  
Proven hands\-on experience as an Observability Engineer, Monitoring Engineer or similar technical role;  
Practical experience with open standards and ecosystems such as Prometheus, OpenTelemetry and related tooling;  
Experience designing and operating telemetry pipelines for metrics, logs, and traces;  
Experience with observability in modern distributed systems and cloud native architectures;  
Experience with LLM observability, including monitoring, tracing, and quality signals for AI or ML based workloads;  
Experience migrating from existing monitoring platforms to new observability platforms is a strong plus;  
Experience with cloud platforms, especially Microsoft Azure;  
Experience with on\-premises environments, particularly Microsoft based virtualized infrastructures;  
Experience with scripting and automation using tools such as PowerShell, Bash, JSON or YAML;  
Experience deploying Observability solutions / platform as IaC (Terraform);  
Good understanding of IT service management processes and event driven operations is a plus;  
Strong problem\-solving skills and a structured, analytical mindset;  
Ability to collaborate effectively across infrastructure, platform, application and architecture teams;  
Proactive mindset with a strong willingness to learn and continuously improve;  
Fluent English verbal and written communication skills. German is a plus.  
What you can expect  
We provide modern working conditions, including work\-from\-home options, flexible hours and a home office allowance to ensure staff members have a work environment equipped with the latest technology;  
A diverse culture founded on mutual respect, teamwork and appreciation awaits you at LGT Capital Partners. We go the extra mile to generate impact;  
We empower and invest in you: your professional development and personal growth are our priority. We offer various internal and external training opportunities that are aligned with your ambitions and our business needs. If you are interested, you can also enhance your German or English language skills  
We are proud to be owned by the Princely Family of Liechtenstein and our company is inspired by its entrepreneurial spirit;  
Commitment to ESG: our approach to business is influenced by the Princely Family's long\-term perspective. Sustainability is key for us and has shaped our actions since 2002;  
You benefit from favorable terms and conditions if you wish to participate in LGT Capital Partners' investment programs or to use LGT banking products and services.  
Contact Information  
If you are interested in becoming an integral part of a successful alternative investment management team in an international, multicultural working environment we will be pleased to get to know you soon.  
For further information please contact us.

Human Resources  
LGT Capital Partners AG, Pfaeffikon

Specialist Neurodevelopment  
The Nestlé Group is the world's largest food and beverage company with 92\.6 billion Swiss Francs in sales in 2019\. It is present in 187 countries around the world, has 403 factories and its 291'000 employees are committed to Nestlé's purpose of enhancing quality of life and contributing to a healthier future. Nestlé offers a wide portfolio of products and services for people and their pets throughout their lives. Its more than 2000 brands range from global icons like Nescafé or Nespresso to local favourites. Company performance is driven by its Nutrition, Health and Wellness strategy. Nestlé is based in the Swiss town of Vevey where it was founded more than 150 years ago. Learn more about our Group and reasons to join us on  
Specialist Neurodevelopment  
Location: Switzerland  
Work model: Office\-based  
Contract type / duration: Permanent  
Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.  
As a Specialist Neuroscience at Nestlé Research, your mission is to lead and contribute to research on the impact of nutrition in infant and child neurodevelopment through the concept, execution, and delivery of scientific projects for clinical substantiation You'll make a difference by collaborating closely with internal teams, external academic partners, laboratories, clinical research organizations, healthcare professionals and regulatory stakeholders. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and proprietary innovative solutions for humans, pets, and the planet.  
How you'll make an impact as a Specialist Neurodevelopment  
Leading research projects that advance understanding of nutrition's role in infant and child neurodevelopment.  
Designing and delivering clinical studies that generate credible scientific evidence and meaningful developmental insights.  
Building productive collaborations with scientific partners to identify opportunities, close knowledge gaps, and strengthen project outcomes.  
Interpreting clinically relevant cognitive, motor, language, behavioural, social\-emotional, and brain development outcomes.  
Communicating complex scientific findings through clear presentations, reports, publications, and business\-facing materials.  
What will make you successful  
Bringing a PhD and postdoctoral experience in nutrition for neuroscience, neurodevelopment, cognitive neuroscience, psychology, or a related biomedical discipline.  
Applying knowledge of early\-life research, developmental assessments, and paediatric cognitive, social\-emotional, behavioural, or brain development outcomes.  
Using clinical research skills to shape protocols, coordinate study delivery, interpret evidence, and connect scientific insights to innovation opportunities.  
Collaborating across interdisciplinary teams and external partners while influencing decisions through scientific credibility and evidence\-based reasoning.  
Communicating fluently in English.  
Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing\-oriented mindset.  
At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do.

Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

jobs.title: Finance Officer
jobs.description:
Aiglon College seeks to appoint a suitably qualified
Finance Officer
to join the school from: 01.11.2026

Your profile
The role and candidate profile for this role is detailed in the attached job description and person specification.

Successful Aiglon staff are enthusiastic, experienced, committed, reflective, dynamic and willing to try new ideas. If you share these values and have an appetite for challenge and an ambition to make a positive impact on our world, we welcome your application.  

About us
Located in Chesières (Vaud, Switzerland), Aiglon College is a not-for-profit, international boarding school offering a distinctive, world-class education in a stunning alpine setting.
The school was founded on a distinctive ethos: the balanced development of mind, body and spirit. This philosophy underpins everything we do at Aiglon, both inside and outside the classroom.
There are over 480 students, representing more than 70 nationalities, following the International GCSE (IGCSE) and International Baccalaureate Diploma (IB Diploma) programmes.

What we offer
Aiglon is dedicated to the well-being and professional development of all staff, within a vibrant, friendly, and modern workplace. Beyond competitive salaries and comprehensive social security benefits, we provide free accident and loss of salary insurances, generous pension and leave entitlements, as well as a range of special perks and advantages.

How to apply
Deadline for applications: 04.09.2026
Early applications are encouraged.  We reserve the right to appoint before the application deadline should we find the right candidate.  Please apply through our School platform (eteach) following the instructions; applications sent by standard email will not be considered.

Aiglon is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children.
Applicants will therefore need to undergo child protection screening appropriate to the post.

You can find information on how the School processes your personal data within the School’s Privacy Notice.

JOB PURPOSE
To work closely with with the other Finance team members to ensure that the school accounts are operated accurately

KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Account payable
Process invoices and payment for overseas and Swiss suppliers
Liaise directly with appropriate staff regarding orders and invoices
Input all the bank payment to the supplier and others
Reconcile the individual accounts with the nominal account
Be responsible for the annual closing of the purchase ledger
Manage emails in French and English with all suppliers
Creation of new providers in the system

Account receivables
Prepare and send invoices to parents / guardians
Establish credit notes
Bill students’ account for their additional charges
Follow up and book payments
Answer parents’queries regarding students’ account
Finalise accounts for leavers and prepare deposit refunds
Review aged debt report with the Director of Finance on a monthly basis
Liaise with Admissions about student records, whenever necessary
Chase debtors regularly and escalate to the Director of Finance if necessary

Nominal Ledger
Maintain the nominal ledger update files
Deal with other activities linked to the nominal ledger
Carry out other audit preparation as required

OTHER TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Assist and be able to cover for the other members of the Finance Team
Comply with the Schools financial regulations
Archive all nominal ledger files as appropriate
Undertake any other tasks which may be reasonably required by the Director of Finance for up-coming projects and the smooth running of the Finance department
Understand and implement all school policies and procedure, particularly those relating to the safeguarding children and young people
Understand the School’s Guiding Principles and uphold the ethos of the School at all times

The qualifications, experiences and attributes of the post-holder must match the detailed specification below:
A. Education, Qualifications and Languages
Essential
Have at least a Bachelor’s degree in Finance and strong evidence of continuous professional development
Fluent in English (C1)
Desirable
French language skills (B2)

B. Experience and Knowledge
Essential
At least 3 years experience in accounts payable, accounts receivable and general ledger
Proficiency in using technology, IT systems, email, and other relevant software for communication, record-keeping, and administrative tasks
Experience in using an ERP system
Experience of working with colleagues from diverse backgrounds
Experience in an international environment
Problem-solving skills
Desirable
Experience of working in an educational environment
Experience in using iSAMS/iFinance systems

C. Personal Qualities, Attitudes and Behaviours
Essential
Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build strong, trusting relationships with direct colleagues and other members of staff
Strong organisational and time management skills
A positive and solution-focused attitude to working life
A willingness to go the extra mile as part of a fast-paced, leading boarding school that operates around the clock

jobs.title: Senior Operational Risk Specialist - Private Banking
jobs.description:
Description de l'entreprise  
Client:  
Senior Operational Risk Specialist \- Private Banking  
Description de l'entreprise  
Client:  
Our Client is a highly respected private banking and financial services institution with a long\-standing heritage and an international presence. Providing personalised investment advisory and asset management solutions to private and institutional clients, the organisation combines the strength and stability of an established financial institution with an entrepreneurial and forward\-thinking culture.  
With a strong focus on expertise, trust, and long\-term relationships, our Client offers an environment where talented professionals are encouraged to take ownership, collaborate closely with colleagues, and make a meaningful contribution. Employees benefit from a dynamic, people\-focused culture where professional excellence, commitment, and teamwork are truly valued.  
Description du poste  
Position:  
Are you an experienced Operational Risk professional within banking, looking for your next career step in a role where you can further shape and strengthen a mature risk framework? Or perhaps you are currently working in Big 4 risk advisory or internal audit and looking to transition into a strategic in\-house operational risk position within a leading financial institution?  
This is an exciting opportunity to join a close\-knit 2nd line of defence team, where you will play a key role in enhancing operational risk governance, supporting regulatory alignment, and driving continuous improvement across the organisation.  
As a Senior Operational Risk Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring robust risk governance, supporting regulatory alignment, and strengthening operational resilience across the organisation. Your expertise will help drive effective risk management practices, challenge existing processes, and ensure consistency across the Group.  
Responsibilities to include, but not limited to:  
Lead and further develop the Risk and Control Self\-Assessment (RCSA) process, ensuring effective identification, assessment, and monitoring of operational risks  
Oversee outsourcing and third\-party risk management activities, ensuring appropriate governance and risk mitigation measures are in place  
Support the ongoing alignment of the operational risk framework with Swiss regulatory requirements, including relevant FINMA expectations  
Promote consistency of operational risk practices across the Group and collaborate with stakeholders across different functions and locations  
Provide risk insights, reporting, and recommendations to senior management to support informed decision\-making  
Contribute to the continuous improvement of operational risk processes, controls, and governance frameworks  
Profil recherché  
Profile:  
University degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or a related discipline  
Approximately 8\-10 years of professional experience in Operational Risk, Internal Audit, Risk Advisory, or related control functions within banking or financial services  
Strong understanding of operational risk frameworks, including RCSA methodologies and control environments  
Experience working with Swiss banking regulations and FINMA requirements  
Experience with outsourcing/third\-party risk management and regulatory\-driven risk initiatives would be an advantage  
Strong analytical, organisational, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work independently and influence across different levels of an organisation  
Excellent communication and presentation skills  
Proactive, "get things done" hands\-on approach, comfortable working in a dynamic, lean and evolving environment  
Fluent English required; strong French skills expected, with German considered an advantage  
Good knowledge of Microsoft Office; familiarity with Avaloq would be beneficial  
Available to work full\-time (no home office)  
Eligible or already in possession of a Swiss passport or Swiss work permit

jobs.title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Tagdienst 50-100% für die Region Huttwil gesucht
jobs.description:
- Ein etabliertes Pflegeheim in der Region Huttwil sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, geregelter Tagdienst mit planbaren Arbeitszeiten.

### Ihr Überblick zur Stelle als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Huttwil

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Tagdienst im Pflegeheim

**Pensum:** 50–100 % (flexibel wählbar)

**Anstellungsart:** Festanstellung

**Einsatzbeginn:** Ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Huttwil

**Arbeitgeber:** Pflegeheim – den Namen erfahren Sie im Gespräch

Huttwil liegt im Emmental und besticht durch seine zentrale Lage in der Region Bern. Die gute Verkehrsanbindung mit Bahnverbindungen ermöglicht schnelle Pendelwege. Der Ort bietet attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen mit einem starken Handwerks- und Mittelstandssektor. Sie profitieren von der Nähe zur Natur, dem guten Arbeitsplatzangebot und erschwinglichen Lebenshaltungskosten.

### Das erwartet Sie als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH im Tagdienst in Huttwil

- Verantwortung für den gesamten Pflegeprozess von der Bedarfserhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Vorbereitung und Abgabe der Medikamente
- Überwachung von Vitalzeichen und frühzeitiges Erkennen von Zustandsveränderungen
- Fachliche Anleitung von FaGe, Pflegeassistenz und Lernenden im Team
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen Pflegesystem
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien und Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe
- Darüber hinaus Mitgestaltung von Pflegekonzepten sowie wir verbessern die Qualität stetig im Team
- Teilnahme an interprofessionellen Rapporten und Visiten im geregelten Tagdienst

### Ihr Profil – darauf kommt es an

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Empathie und Belastbarkeit
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. Niveau B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Tagdienst im Pflegeheim

Diese Stelle ist im Tagdienst angelegt. Sie arbeiten also in einer klaren Tagesstruktur mit geregelten Übergaben am Morgen und am Abend. Dabei nehmen Sie an Rapporten im Team mit Ärzten und Therapien teil, koordinieren Termine mit Ärzten und Therapeuten und begleiten Angehörigengespräche. Somit verbinden Sie fachliche Verantwortung mit einem planbaren Alltag.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau oder Pflegefachmann HF/FH im Tagdienst verbinden Sie fachliche Tiefe mit einem Alltag, der Planung zulässt. Genau deshalb ist die Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH im Tagdienst in Huttwil bei Berufsleuten mit Familie so beliebt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben zum Beispiel den Pflegebedarf, planen anschliessend die Massnahmen, führen sie durch und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern sie die Medikamentenabgabe, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen im Gesundheitszustand frühzeitig. So entsteht Pflegequalität, die bei jeder Bewohnerin und jedem Bewohner ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die dreijährige höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium in Pflege an einer Fachhochschule (FH). Beide Abschlüsse berechtigen zur eigenverantwortlichen Berufsausübung. Ausländische Diplome benötigen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen attraktive Weiterbildungen offen, etwa ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Funktion als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Der Arbeitsmarkt für diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen in Huttwil zeigt eine anhaltend hohe Nachfrage, besonders im Tagdienst mit flexiblen Pensenmodellen zwischen 50 und 100 Prozent. Ihre Qualifikation als HF/FH-Absolventin oder Absolvent ist in der Region sehr gefragt, da Spitäler, Pflegezentren und ambulante Dienste kontinuierlich Fachkräfte suchen. Mit iPersonal erhalten Sie einen erfahrenen Partner an Ihrer Seite, der Sie durch ein umfassendes Netzwerk mit passenden Arbeitgebern verbindet und den Bewerbungsprozess vereinfacht. So finden Sie schneller und unbürokratischer die ideale Stelle, die Ihren persönlichen Anforderungen entspricht.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Huttwil

- Gratis-Weiterbildungen dank [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – Ihre Karriere bekommt Rückenwind
- Dazu persönliche Beratung durch Ihre feste Ansprechperson, von der Bewerbung bis zum Stellenantritt
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Ebenso faire, GAV-konforme Anstellungsbedingungen mit transparentem Lohn
- Langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Und vor allem: Diskretion garantiert – Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH im Tagdienst in Huttwil

**Welche Ausbildung benötige ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit einer SRK-Anerkennung ebenfalls willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Arbeite ich in dieser Stelle auch nachts?**
Nein, denn diese Stelle ist bewusst im Tagdienst angelegt. Sie profitieren daher von planbaren Arbeitszeiten mit geregelten Übergaben.

**Kann ich das Pensum frei wählen?**
Ja, denn das Pensum ist zwischen 50 und 100 Prozent flexibel wählbar. Sagen Sie uns einfach, welches Modell zu Ihrem Leben passt.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
Sie erhalten in der Regel innert 24 Stunden eine Antwort – denn Warten ist verlorene Zeit. Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir dabei streng vertraulich.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Im Inserat verzichten wir jedoch aus Diskretionsgründen darauf.

### Interessiert? Wir freuen uns auf Sie

Product Manager Specific Solutions  
DECTRIS is a successful and expanding high\-tech company that develops and produces X\-ray and electron detectors. Our detectors are used worldwide in large\-scale research facilities and in industry. Their unique properties enable scientific breakthroughs in life sciences and material sciences. Our more than 170 employees are located in Switzerland, the United States and Japan. At DECTRIS, we combine innovation and development with agile industry practices. As a spin\-off of the Institute and by focusing on the needs of our customers, we are able to combine scientific excellence with qualified service and industrial know\-how.  
Our scientists as well as our technical and commercial experts ensure that our customers benefit from the latest technologies.  
DECTRIS values collaborative working rather than traditional hierarchy and is guided by the principles of Sociocracy 3\.0\.  
Your Tasks  
Proactive Customer Interaction: Systematically track customers' upgrade cycles and facility roadmaps to engage in technical design dialogues pre\-tender, influencing specifications early, and harvesting the full potential of our markets  
Strategic Portfolio Balancing: Strategically qualify Specific Solutions projects when standard options are unviable or selectively to demonstrate DECTRIS' cutting\-edge custom capabilities  
Strategic Evaluation: Evaluate whether a customer request should be handled as a customized detector or if it signals the need for a new standard product  
Requirements Engineering: Coordinate with customers and Area Sales Managers to determine detector requirements, setup details, and application backgrounds  
Technical Feasibility: Collaborate with technical experts to estimate feasibility, risks, effort, time, and costs for novel designs  
Proposal Management: Provide Sales with technical concepts, price estimations, and lead times to create winning offers  
Project Oversight: Maintain a clear overview of ongoing projects and keep all internal and external stakeholders informed  
Balancing Interests: Find pragmatic solutions that match the customer's timeline and budget while protecting DECTRIS' interests and technical standards  
Visibility and Outreach: Represent Specific Solutions at conferences, user meetings, and facility visits; turn completed custom builds into reference cases and application stories that seed the next generation of requests  
Your Skills  
Science/engineering degree or similar, previous experience in product management or project management is an asset  
Strong understanding of X\-ray technology, vacuum systems, and related equipment. You can quickly grasp the capabilities and boundaries of our standard products  
Excellent skills in interacting with various stakeholders, from scientists in international research facilities to internal cross\-functional teams  
Ability to identify and reduce technical risks and suggest pragmatic solutions  
Understanding of how market trends and customers' needs can be leveraged to enhance business outcomes  
You understand where the X\-ray markets, its applications, and customer needs are heading, and you can translate that into which custom requests are worth pursuing  
Proven ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple customer requests simultaneously while meeting tight deadlines  
You are precise in creating and updating project and product documentation  
Average travel requirement around 15%

A successful and growing high tech company in an international, scientific environment

An international work environment formed by more than 170 experienced engineers, scientists and other professionals. The company languages are German and English  
Excellent, flexible working arrangements to enable professional development and personal life balance  
An attractive working environment: modern infrastructure with wheelchair\-accessible rooms, small fitness room, underground car park, subsidised meals, free snacks and drinks, various company events, internal and external training, home office options, after\-work beers and other joint leisure activities  
X\-ray Markets Team

They create a roadmap for product development and market penetration, aligning it with DECTRIS' overall business goals. jobs.description:
- Für ein bekanntes Haus im Bereich Pflege und Medizin in der Region Wetzikon suchen wir Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH – Schwerpunkt Langzeitpflege Demenz.

### Auf einen Blick: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH für die Region Wetzikon

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Wetzikon liegt im Zürcher Oberland und verfügt über eine ausgezeichnete Verkehrsanbindung mit direkten Bahnverbindungen nach Zürich. Sie profitieren von der zentralen Lage zwischen Stadt und Landschaft sowie einem vielfältigen Arbeitsmarkt in verschiedenen Branchen. Die Region bietet Ihnen eine gute Lebensqualität mit attraktiven Wohnmöglichkeiten und ist gleichzeitig wirtschaftlich dynamisch und innovativ.

### Diese Tätigkeiten erwarten Sie in Wetzikon

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihre Stärken für diese Stelle

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Langzeitpflege Demenz

Die Demenzbetreuung arbeitet person-zentriert: Im Mittelpunkt steht der Mensch mit seiner Biografie. Sie gestalten deshalb einen Alltag mit festen Ritualen sowie vertrauten Handgriffen, erkennen nonverbale Signale und begegnen Unruhe mit Ruhe.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Der Arbeitsmarkt für diplomierte Pflegefachfrauen und -männer in der Langzeitpflege mit Demenzfokus in der Region Wetzikon verzeichnet eine hohe Nachfrage durch zahlreiche Pflegeinstitutionen und Altersheime. Sie profitieren von ausgezeichneten Chancen auf stabile Anstellungen im bevorzugten Pensum, da qualifizierte Fachkräfte knapp sind und kontinuierlich gesucht werden. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als erfahrener Vermittler mit regionaler Expertise, um Ihnen gezielt passende Positionen zu erschliessen und den Einstieg ins neue Arbeitsumfeld zu erleichtern.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Wetzikon

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind
- Eine feste Beraterin begleitet Sie persönlich, von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Tag

- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein

- Und vor allem: Diskretion garantiert – Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege Demenz in Wetzikon

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
Meist hören Sie schon innerhalb von 24 Stunden von uns, denn Ihre Zeit ist uns wichtig. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

jobs.title: Gestionnaire Contentieux & Faillites
jobs.description:
Gestionnaire Contentieux \& Faillites  
FER CIAM — L'humain au centre des prestations sociales  
La FER CIAM est l'agence genevoise de la plus grande caisse interprofessionnelle AVS de Suisse FER Genève, créée par la FER Genève et pleinement intégrée dans son écosystème de services aux entreprises membres.  
Avec près de 47'500 affiliés — entreprises et indépendants confondus — elle est l'un des acteurs incontournables de la protection sociale en Suisse romande.  
Au quotidien, ses équipes gèrent l'encaissement de 2,425 milliards de cotisations AVS et assurance chômage, ainsi que le versement de plus de 876 millions de francs de prestations AVS, AI et allocations perte de gain. En parallèle, elles assurent l'administration des allocations familiales et l'application des conventions collectives de travail.  
Un périmètre technique exigeant, au service de milliers d'entreprises et de leurs assurés — où chaque dossier a un impact direct sur la vie professionnelle et sociale des personnes concernées.  
Description du poste  
Votre mission :  
Au sein de la FER CIAM Genève, vous jouez un rôle clé dans la gestion et la sécurisation des créances des institutions affiliées. Vous pilotez les dossiers de contentieux, de poursuites et de faillites, assurez le suivi des procédures civiles et pénales ainsi que les actions en réparation du dommage, tout en accompagnant les affiliés et en collaborant étroitement avec les autorités et les partenaires internes. Votre rigueur et votre expertise permettent de garantir une gestion efficace des dossiers et la préservation des intérêts des institutions représentées.  
Vos activités principales :  
Gestion des procédures de faillite  
• Réceptionner et traiter les actes des offices des poursuites et des faillites, établir les productions de créances, contrôler les paiements et mouvements (imputation, annulation de poursuite, réclamation de frais)  
• Contrôler les actes de défaut de biens, les procès\-verbaux de saisie et les états de collocation, et engager les actions de suivi nécessaires  
• Suivre les procédures de mainlevée, gérer les correspondances et les frais associés et tenir un échéancier rigoureux des dossiers.  
Actions en réparation du dommage et procédures pénales
