jobs.title: Medior Accountmanager
jobs.description:
Op feestjes kun jij straks helder uitleggen wat je doet: jij bent accountmanager en helpt organisaties om hun digitale ambities waar te maken. Je bouwt en onderhoudt sterke klantrelaties, adviseert over complexe IT-vraagstukken en vertaalt de behoefte van de klant naar concrete, schaalbare cloud- en werkplekoplossingen. Je volgt marktontwikkelingen op de voet, signaleert commerciële kansen en zorgt ervoor dat jouw klanten continu stappen zetten in hun digitale groei. Je werkt bij een ambitieuze IT-dienstverlener die organisaties begeleidt in hun digitale transformatie naar een moderne, veilige en toekomstbestendige cloudwerkplek. Technologie is daarbij nooit een doel op zich, maar een middel om waarde te creëren, processen te optimaliseren en gebruikerstevredenheid te verhogen. Veiligheid, flexibiliteit en transparantie staan centraal in alles wat je doet. Samen met ruim 200 collega’s werk je vanuit meerdere vestigingen in Nederland aan uiteenlopende IT-vraagstukken. Je schakelt dagelijks met beslissers aan klantzijde, denkt strategisch mee over hun digitale roadmap en weet commerciële kansen te vertalen naar duurzame samenwerkingen. Of je nu bezig bent met het verdiepen van bestaande relaties of het binnenhalen van nieuwe klanten: jij combineert commerciële scherpte met oprechte interesse in de business van de klant. In deze rol krijg je veel ruimte om je eigen aanpak vorm te geven. Je bent actief in koude en warme acquisitie, bouwt aan je eigen netwerk en stuurt doelgericht op resultaat. Van het eerste contact tot en met het sluiten van de deal ben jij het vaste aanspreekpunt, waarbij je steeds de balans bewaakt tussen klantbelang en organisatiedoelstellingen.

-
Je hebt hbo-werk- en -denkniveau en aantoonbare ervaring als accountmanager in de IT- of zakelijke dienstverlening, bij voorkeur met cloud- en werkplekoplossingen.
-
Je beweegt je gemakkelijk op C-level, stelt de juiste vragen en weet complexe klantvraagstukken te vertalen naar heldere, commerciële proposities.
-
Je bent resultaatgericht, neemt initiatief in koude én warme acquisitie en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor het uitbouwen van je eigen klantportfolio.
-
Je communiceert overtuigend in woord en geschrift, schakelt soepel tussen verschillende stakeholders en werkt gestructureerd om kansen op te volgen en deals te sluiten.

jobs.title: Stagiair IT Servicedesk
jobs.description:
Je legt het op feestjes ongeveer zo uit: jij loopt stage bij een professionele IT-dienstverlener, waar je klanten helpt met hun dagelijkse IT-vraagstukken en van dichtbij ziet hoe moderne IT-omgevingen zijn ingericht. Je draait mee op de Servicedesk, maar krijgt ook de kans om mee te kijken bij specialistische teams, zoals Security, Projecten en Automatisering. Daardoor maak je in korte tijd kennis met verschillende kanten van het vak en ontdek je waar jouw interesses liggen. De organisatie gelooft dat je het meest leert door zelf te doen. Daarom krijg je al snel het vertrouwen om werkzaamheden zelfstandig op te pakken, uiteraard met goede begeleiding van ervaren collega’s. Zo ontwikkel je niet alleen je technische kennis, maar leer je ook hoe je professioneel met klanten communiceert, prioriteiten stelt en gestructureerd werkt binnen een servicegerichte IT-omgeving. De IT-dienstverlener waar je stage loopt, ondersteunt organisaties bij hun digitale transformatie naar een veilige, toekomstbestendige werkplek in de cloud. IT wordt daarbij gezien als middel om groei en efficiëntie te realiseren, niet als doel op zich. Met een groot team van enthousiaste IT-professionals wordt vanuit meerdere vestigingen dagelijks gewerkt aan het beheren, beveiligen en optimaliseren van uiteenlopende IT-omgevingen. Tijdens jouw stage maak je deel uit van dit team en draag je concreet bij aan het oplossen van incidenten en het verbeteren van de dienstverlening. De cultuur kenmerkt zich door vrijheid, vertrouwen en verantwoordelijkheid. Je krijgt ruimte om je werk op jouw manier te organiseren, vragen te stellen en initiatief te nemen. Tegelijkertijd wordt van je verwacht dat je zorgvuldig werkt en eigenaarschap toont over je taken. Er is veel aandacht voor een prettige, informele werksfeer, waar successen worden gedeeld en collega’s bereid zijn om je te helpen als je ergens tegenaan loopt. Zo bouw je tijdens je stage niet alleen aan je technische skills, maar ook aan een stevig funda.

-
Je volgt een mbo- of hbo-opleiding in de richting van IT, bijvoorbeeld (medewerker) beheer, systeem- of netwerkbeheer, of een vergelijkbare studierichting.
-
Je hebt basiskennis van Windows-omgevingen, Microsoft 365 en algemene netwerkbegrippen, en je vindt het leuk om je hierin verder te verdiepen.
-
Je communiceert helder en klantgericht, kunt goed luisteren en weet technische informatie begrijpelijk uit te leggen aan gebruikers.
-
Je bent leergierig, pakt verantwoordelijkheid voor je eigen taken en voelt je thuis in een dynamische servicedesk-omgeving waar geen dag hetzelfde is.

Master Thesis Internship: Big Data for Flight Inspection - Hybrid - - Amsterdam , Noord-Holland , Netherlands - Aerospace Operations Job description
It is a misty morning at Schiphol and you are almost back home. "This is your captain speaking" . Looking out the window you can barely see the wingtips. "Please fasten your seatbelt" . Only seconds before touchdown the airport appears from the grey haze. Taxiing to the terminal you wonder if the pilot has super-vision, or if there is something more?
Flight inspection
Aircraft still rely on a network of ground-based systems for localisation due to their accuracy and reliability. The localisation system used during landing is called the Instrument Landing System (ILS) , which has centimetre accuracy and allows for all-weather landings.
To ensure adherence to strict regulations these systems need to be regularly inspected. Currently such flight inspection is performed by NLR using our Cessna Citation II (as can be seen on the picture above). With secondary accurate localisation equipment onboard a prescribed pattern is flown to determine the alignment, sensitivity and strength of the ILS signal. Such flights are expensive and noisy, emit CO2, reduce airport capacity, and with your help, might be unnecessary…
Big data
Every day thousands of aircraft arrive in the Netherlands, making use of ILS systems. These aircraft all measure the ILS signals as well as their own location, but for each individual aircraft, this data is not accurate enough for flight inspection.
However, with the rise of big data, taking advantage of advances in regression methods such as gaussian process regression (GPR), one can combine the data of all these flights to improve the measurement accuracy and use this for flight inspection. This significantly reduces costs and emissions of flight insp...

jobs.description:
Agile coach
As organizations transition to Agile methodologies, they may need the expertise of an Agile Coach. An Agile Coach is someone who helps organizations successfully implement Agile methodologies. In addition, the Agile coach ensures that teams and individuals develop the right Agile skills and mindset. In this text, we will discuss the definition, competencies and responsibilities of an Agile Coach.
Definition Agile Coach
An Agile Coach is someone who helps organizations successfully implement Agile -methodologies. In addition, the Agile coach ensures that teams and individuals develop the right Agile skills and mindset. The goal of an Agile Coach is to advise organizations on how to improve their practices and integrate Agile methodologies. Agile Coaches are experts in understanding and adhering to Agile principles and ensuring that teams and individuals use the right tools and techniques to achieve desired results.

An Agile Coach needs a number of key competencies to be effective in his or her role. Some of these competencies are:
Knowledge of Agile methodologies : Is familiar with Agile methodologies and the principles behind them. He or she should be able to clearly explain and guide the application of these principles in practice.
Coaching and Training: Must be able to coach and train effectively. This includes the ability to ask the right questions, provide feedback and ensure good communication.
Leadership: Must be a Servant Leader. Servant-Leadership is a "way of being and doing" in which the leader is subservient to the growth of others, the organization and himself. In doing so, this philosophy contributes to a development of society as a whole.

jobs.title: Store Manager - dubbu
jobs.description:
About the job

dubbu is expanding in Copenhagen, and we are looking for a Store Manager (37 hours/week) to lead our upcoming store — a new version of a familiar location, now including a small serving area inspired by Korean café culture.

As Store Manager, you will be responsible for the daily operations, the team, and ensuring that both the retail space and the serving area run smoothly every day.

You will work closely with the founder team and have significant influence on how the store develops in the coming years.

Your responsibilities

Leadership & team

  • Daily leadership of the team (scheduling, onboarding, training, and feedback)

  • Ensuring a high standard of customer service and sales

  • Coaching the team to improve performance on the sales floor

Store operations

  • Overseeing daily operations (opening/closing, stock deliveries, inventory, routines)

  • Ensuring the store always appears well-organized and ready for customers

  • Working with simple KPIs (sales, conversion rate, AOV)

Serving area

  • Responsible for the operation of the store’s small café area

  • Ensuring consistent quality and service speed

  • Daily cleaning, hygiene, and maintenance of equipment

  • Training staff in workflow and standards

  • Contributing to the development of new drinks inspired by Korean café culture

We are looking for someone who

  • Has 2–3 years of experience in retail or café environments, preferably with operational responsibility

  • Is structured and comfortable working with routines, checklists, and clear standards

  • Can lead a team and maintain calm and overview in a busy environment

  • Is hands-on and takes ownership of both people and operations

  • Has an eye for detail and understands the importance of a well-executed customer experience

It is a plus if you

  • Have experience with barista work, matcha, or espresso

  • Have worked with food hygiene or basic food safety procedures

  • Have experience with merchandising or retail visuals

  • Have an interest in Korean culture, cafés, or beauty

What we offer

  • A central role in a growing company

  • Close collaboration with the founder team

  • Significant influence on the store’s development

  • A strong team and an ambitious brand universe

  • Staff discount across our entire product range

Application

Start date: as soon as possible

Please send your CV and a short application to:

job@dubbu.dk

Subject line: “Store Manager”

jobs.title: Senior Associate - FATCA/CRS - Operational tax team (m/f)
jobs.description:
Senior Associate - FATCA/CRS - Operational tax team
Luxembourg
Line of Service Tax
Industry/Sector Banking and Capital Markets
Specialism Banking & Finance
Management Level Senior Associate

Job Description & Summary

In tax reporting strategy at PwC, you will assist clients in developing tax reporting strategies and maintaining compliance with tax regulations. In this field, you will analyse financial data, interpret tax laws, and provide guidance on tax reporting requirements, aiming to optimise tax positions and minimise risks for businesses.

Senior Associate - FATCA/CRS - Operational tax team

PwC Luxembourg is hiring a Senior in Operational tax team (m/f/d). What if it was you?

We are the largest professional services firm in Luxembourg, providing audit, tax and advisory services to a wide variety of clients. To make it happen, we count on the expertise of over 3,600 people from more than 90 different countries, who strive every day to reach excellence and team up to solve important problems through innovative solutions. We value diverse and singular career paths, embrace everyone's unique self and encourage our People to fuel their potential in a work environment that is inclusive, stimulating, and motivating.  
Our Operational Tax department is growing and we are looking for a motivated professional eager to take on real responsibility in a dynamic and international environment. As a Senior Associate within our FATCA/CRS dedicated team, you will be a trusted advisor to financial institutions navigating complex regulatory landscapes — from private equity and real estate to banking and asset management.

Your mission:

Your role sits at the intersection of tax, operations, and compliance. Concretely, you will:
Advise and support clients on their FATCA, CRS, QI and DAC6 obligations - from entity classification and investor on-boarding to due diligence and annual reporting. You will be their go-to contact for technical questions, guiding them through regulatory requirements with clarity and confidence.
Review and validate a wide range of client documentation - self-certification forms, U.S. withholding certificates, account opening forms, master files, and XML FATCA/CRS reports - ensuring accuracy, consistency, and compliance with applicable legislation.
Drive quality and oversight by preparing gap analyses, controls reports and sign-off reports, QI  and DAC6 reports, monitoring regulatory update impacting our clients and consulting and reporting services.
Contribute to projects and initiatives that shape how the team operates - from building and refining internal processes and methodologies to exploring how to bring more efficiency and intelligence to compliance work.  
Collaborate and grow in close cooperation with colleagues across the Operational Tax department and beyond. You will contribute to tailored client solutions, support junior team members, and benefit from a training programme that you can shape according to your own development goals.

Let's talk about you

You will thrive in this role if you:

• Hold a Master's degree in Tax, Law, Economics, Business Administration or a related field;
• Bring at least 3 years of relevant experience, ideally gained in the financial services industry;
• Have solid knowledge of FATCA, CRS and/or QI legislation;
• Are comfortable working with data — databases, structured reports, and XML environments;
• Are a strong communicator who enjoys daily client interactions and can explain complex topics with clarity;
• Have a proactive mindset and a genuine interest in process improvement, project work, and new technologies including AI;
• Are fluent in English and French - any additional language is a plus.

PwC Luxembourg (www.pwc.lu) is the largest professional services firm in Luxembourg with over 3,600 people employed from 90 different countries. PwC Luxembourg provides audit, tax and advisory services including management consulting, transaction, financing and regulatory advice. The firm provides advice to a wide variety of clients from local and middle market entrepreneurs to large multinational companies operating from Luxembourg and the Greater Region. The firm supports its clients in creating the value they are looking for by contributing to the smooth operation of the capital markets and providing advice through an industry-focused approach.

At PwC, we help clients build trust and reinvent so they can turn complexity into competitive advantage. We're a tech-forward, people-empowered network with more than 364,000 people in 136 countries and 137 territories. Across audit and assurance, tax and legal, deals and consulting, we help clients build, accelerate, and sustain momentum. Find out more at www.pwc.com and www.pwc.lu.

• GRM-covered relationships (supporting and, where applicable, co-managing selected strategic relationships in partnership with the Global Relationship Manager), and

You will focus on delivering sustainable revenue growth through the sale of transactional banking products booked in Luxembourg and Continental Europe, notably Cash Management (GPS) and Securities Services (SSv), as well as identifying opportunities across Global Markets (GM), Credit & Lending, and Asset Management.


In this role, you will (but not limited to):

• Manage and grow revenues from the assigned hybrid portfolio (GRM-supported and GNB inbound corporate clients), including identifying cross-sell opportunities and supporting new client acquisition where relevant.
• Act as a key point of contact for day-to-day relationship coverage for designated clients, ensuring a consistent client experience across GRM, GNB and product partners.
• Support Global Relationship Manager (GRM) on selected strategic relationships by coordinating local execution in Luxembourg/Continental Europe (e.g., product delivery, pipeline tracking, client service issues, and internal stakeholder alignment).
• Cover GNB inbound corporate relationships end-to-end, including client engagement, solutioning, and coordination of onboarding and account maintenance activities.
• Take ownership of onboarding, KYC/CDD, periodic reviews and renewals, working closely with internal teams to ensure timely completion and high-quality submissions.
• Support credit-related activities (where applicable) and regularly monitor the portfolio and generate quality assets by utilising appropriate risk management tools, ensuring alignment with HSBC's risk appetite and pricing appropriately for risk.


You should apply if you have:

• Relevant experience in a client-facing relationship management role, ideally with exposure to global coverage models (e.g., GRM/local coverage) and international stakeholders.
• Strong business acumen and commercial awareness, including economic, cultural, procedural and regulatory issues.
• Ability to interact with Corporate and Institutional customers; product knowledge of credit – experience of writing draft credit applications and performing credit analysis is an advantage.
• Solid knowledge of onboarding, KYC and CDD processes, with a track record of driving timely completion across multiple stakeholders.
• Good knowledge of transaction banking products, primarily Cash Management and Payment Solutions (GPS), Securities Services (SSv) and Global Markets (GM) products.
• Strong IT skills to produce quality presentations and other material for client meetings/pitches (Excel, PowerPoint etc.) and strong written and spoken communication skills in English - knowledge of French or German is not mandatory but can be an asset.

Even if you feel you do not meet 100% of our qualifications, we encourage you to apply, if you believe this role is right for you.


What you'll get in return:

The pay range for this role is EUR 87,200 – 120,000.

HSBC operates multiple variable pay plans, to reflect the diverse nature of the businesses, roles and markets in which we operate. Variable pay is designed to reward colleagues for their individual performance and contribution, as well as the performance of their relevant Business / Infrastructure, and the overall Group.

We offer a comprehensive and competitive package of benefits usually covering health support, life assurance, pension, and family friendly leaves, as well as many other benefits to support your wellbeing.

If you're looking for a career where you will be respected as an individual and valued for the contributions you make, please visit our career page, and discover how diversity drives our success.

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we're dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Please note that every selected candidate will have to provide us with a valid criminal record check in due time.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website. For any GDPR request, please send it to: lux.data.privacy@hsbc.com

How will you contribute?

As a Junior R&T Engineer at LIST, you will work under close supervision, performing tasks according to plans and directions. You will contribute to RDI projects, manage laboratory equipment, and develop your skills in RDI methodologies and technical instruments.

Among other responsibilities, you will:
·                  In coordination with the Head of R&T Group, you will perform RDI engineering duties.
·                  Under the supervision of scientific staff, you will organise the group's laboratories and equipment, order chemicals and other materials, and introduce new group members to the team and institute's way of working
·                  Develop the ability to generate RDI results under supervision
·                  Manage the group's strain, enzyme and plasmid collection
·                  Independently perform short subprojects under general supervision of the group leader or group scientists.
·                  Document test or experiment proceedings and ensure the traceability and quality of results.
·                  Support the group in experimental tasks, especially in more routine experiments.
·                  Perform R&T tasks, under supervision when required: evaluate, select, and applytechnical methods; make critical analysis, evaluation, and synthesis of data obtained from tests/experiments; propose improvements to methods, techniques, or practices; evaluate the feasibility and effectiveness of solutions provided; explain methods, practices and procedures related to their work; explain the functioning, usage, and maintenance of specialised tools/equipment
·                  Provide support to on-going funding efforts.
·                  Assit in the dissemination, valorisation, and transfer of RDI results. Presents work results in team meetings and workshops.
·                  Organise own work, defining timelines, and interacting collaboratively with team members.
·                  Learn to use specialized tools/equipment and advanced analytical techniques or methods.
·                  Respect and apply LIST-HSE rules. Alert potential dangers or risks. Take care of their own safety and that of others.


Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

Education

•                   MSc (or equivalent) in molecular biology or biotechnology
•                   First experience (eg during studies) with molecular methodologies, such as cloning, RNA/gDNA isolation, PCR, etc.
•                   Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
•                   Experience with enzymes assays and/or HPLC analysis is an asset
•                   Experience with fungi is an asset
•                   Ability and willingness to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment
•                   Strong interpersonal and communication skills

Language skills

•                   Strong knowledge of English (both spoken and written) is required.

Your LIST benefits

·        An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
·        Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
·        Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square metres, including innovations in all that we do
·        An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas
·        Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills
·        Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce
·        Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfil their personal and professional ambitions
·        Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science
·        32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance
·        Flexible working hours, home working policy (not remote) and access to Digital lunch vouchers

Apply online

Your application must include:
·        A motivation letter oriented towards the position and detailing your experience
·        A scientific CV with contact details
·        List of publications (and patents, if applicable)
·        Contact details of 2 references
Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by email will not be considered.

Application procedure and conditions

We kindly request applicants to provide their nationality for statistical purposes only, as part of our commitment to promoting diversity and ensuring equal opportunities in our workforce. This information will be kept confidential and will not be used for any discriminatory purposes.
LIST is dedicated to maintaining an inclusive work environment and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, hiring, and retaining a diverse workforce. All applicants will be considered for employment without discrimination based on national origin, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, religion, age, or disability.
Applications will be continuously reviewed until the position is filled. An assessment committee will thoroughly evaluate applications, adhering to guidelines designed to ensure equal opportunities. The primary criteria for selection will be the alignment of the applicant's existing skills and expertise with the requirements mentioned above.
As part of our recruitment process, the selected candidate might be subject to a background check in accordance with applicable laws and institutional policies. Further checks and restrictions might apply to candidates in compliance with export controls requirements
This position offers a gross monthly salary between €5043 and €6132, paid over 13 months (€65559–€79716 annually) based on full time employment. The final salary offer within this range will be determined based on the candidate's overall profile, qualifications and professional experience.
For part time employment, the salary is adjusted pro rata.

jobs.title: Director Finance, Operations & Supply Chain (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Husky Technologies is a global leader in Injection Molding Manufacturing, committed to delivering high-quality products and services to our customers. Based in Bolton, Canada, we are seeking a Finance Director to join our dynamic team. This role will play a crucial part in providing financial leadership for our Operations and Supply Chain divisions, working closely with various functions including Purchasing, Logistics, Manufacturing, Quality, and Central Operational Support.

You will be responsible for overseeing and managing all financial aspects of our Operations & Supply Chain, ensuring that financial goals are met and that financial strategies align with the company's broader objectives. Reporting to the VP Finance, FP&A, you will serve as the right-hand finance partner to the Chief Operating Officer. This role will be based in Bolton, Canada. With five direct reports and a team of ~10 individuals based in Bolton and Luxembourg, you will have the opportunity to make a significant impact on our organization's financial performance.

Key Accountabilities:

1.      Financial Planning and Analysis:

    Develop and manage the annual budget for the Operations and Supply Chain divisions.
    Provide financial guidance and insights to support decision-making processes.
    Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide monthly financial reports to the executive team.
    Lead the review and analysis of month-end and year-end financial close processes.
    Identify and analyze variances between actual results and budget/forecast, insights into the drives for variances.
    Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand the underlying factors contributing to financial performance.
    Proactively identify financial risks and opportunities, making recommendations to mitigate risks and capitalize on opportunities.
    Work closely with the executive team to refine financial strategies based on month-end and year-end insights.

2.      Cost Management:

    Transform current costing and methodology standards to improve transparency to product margins, life cycle costing and governance.
    Data and process design- Defining costing rules, master data requirements, controls, reporting definitions, and system-enabled workflows.
    Transformation accountability- Owning roadmap, requirements, testing, change management, adoption, and benefits realization.
    Collaborate closely with Supply Chain leaders to identify cost-saving opportunities and implement cost control measures across various aspects of the supply chain, including procurement, logistics, warehousing, and production.
    Develop and monitor cost reduction initiatives and targets, ensuring alignment with the company's financial goals.
    Monitor and report on key cost-related performance indicators to the executive team, providing recommendations for continuous improvement.

3.      Strategic Planning:

    Work closely with the Leadership team to develop long-term financial strategies for the Operation and Supply Chain divisions.
    Transformation accountability- Owning roadmap, requirements, testing, change management, adoption, and benefits realization.
    Assess financial impacts of potential investments in supply chain infrastructure, technology, and capabilities to improve cost and lead time.

4.      Cross Functional Leadership:

    Ability to lead Finance, Operations, IT, Service, Commercial, and regional teams through process/system change.

5.      Inventory Management:

    Collaborate with Supply Chain leaders to establish appropriate inventory targets, and improve inventory forecasting.
    Analyze the financial impact of inventory-related decisions and provide recommendations for improvement.

6.      Financial Support CAPEX (Capital Expenditures):

    Collaborate with the Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) team to assess the financial feasibility and impact of proposed capital projects within the Supply Chain division.
    Conduct thorough financial analysis and risk assessments for CAPEX investments, ensuring alignment with the company's financial goals and strategies.
    Assist in the preparation of CAPEX budgets, forecasts, and business cases.
    Provide financial insights and recommendations to guide decision-making on CAPEX projects, ensuring efficient allocation of resources and optimal return on investment (ROI).

Qualifications:

    Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field; MBA or CPA preferred.
    Proven experience (10+ years) in a senior finance role within a supply chain or manufacturing environment.
    Strong financial analysis, budgeting, and forecasting skills.
    Systems / ERP capability
        Hands-on or leadership experience with ERP costing modules, project accounting, service costing, data structures, integrations, and reporting architecture.
    Excellent leadership and communication skills.
    Ability to work collaboratively across functional teams.
    Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities.
    Fluent in English
    Additional language skills considered an asset

jobs.title: SAP S/4HANA Rollout Cutover Lead (f/m/d) (IT-Manager/in)
jobs.employer: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

As the SAP S/4HANA Rollout Cutover Lead (f/m/d), you will play a pivotal role in ensuring successful business transitions across Siemens Energy's global S4E Unify transformation program. You will define and govern the overall cutover strategy, coordinate global and local deployment activities, and ensure all business, IT, and third-party teams are fully prepared for go-live.

Working closely with Rollout Managers, Template Teams, Cluster Cutover Managers, business stakeholders, and external partners, you will oversee integrated cutover planning, manage critical dependencies and risks, and drive business readiness throughout every rollout wave. Your leadership will help ensure smooth, controlled, and low-risk transitions into the new SAP S/4HANA environment.

How You’ll Make an Impact

* Own and drive the global SAP S/4HANA cutover strategy, ensuring a controlled, business-ready transition across all rollout waves
* Develop and maintain integrated cutover plans covering data migration, system validation, go-live activities, legacy system integration, and decommissioning
* Define governance, readiness criteria, key milestones, and decision gates while ensuring all deployment dependencies are managed effectively
* Identify cutover risks early, develop contingency and fallback strategies, and lead issue resolution to minimize business disruption during critical go-live periods
* Guide and support Cluster Cutover Managers by providing standardized methodologies, coordinating execution, and ensuring alignment with global deployment objectives
* Monitor cutover performance through KPIs, status reporting, and governance meetings while providing clear, decision-oriented updates to Program Management and executive stakeholders

What You Bring

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience
* Extensive experience leading SAP S/4HANA cutover, deployment, transition, or large-scale ERP transformation programs in complex global environments
* Strong expertise in integrated cutover planning, data migration, system validation, go-live management, legacy system integration, and operational readiness
* Proven experience in risk management, contingency planning, business continuity, milestone tracking, KPI reporting, and executive-level communication
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and coordinate business stakeholders, global delivery organizations, Cluster Cutover Managers, and external implementation partners
* Fluent English is required; German or additional languages relevant to the rollout regions are considered an advantage

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

The S4 program at Siemens Energy, formally called S4E or S4E‑Unify, is one of the major global Business- & IT Transformation Programs within Siemens Energy (SE). Its key objective is to transform our historical patchwork of 23 legacy SAP systems into a completely new platform based on the latest state-of-the-art SAP S/4 HANA technology. At the same time, S4E-Unify is aiming for the optimization and harmonization of SE’s worldwide Business Processes across all Business Areas, Regions and Functions. Goal is to significantly reduce complexity, increase speed and flexibility, foster cross-organizational collaboration and finally drive significant cost reductions. The S4E-Unify core team consists of roughly 300 colleagues around the globe plus a substantial extended community of subject matter experts (SME), change network ambassadors and other contributors. It affects 40,000 global users and follows an implementation roadmap through 2030.  The S4E program is delivered through phased “Unify” rollout waves, bringing sites and business areas live step by step on SAP S/4HANA. It includes standardized business templates, a defined operating model with strong governance and board‑level sponsorship, and an enhanced user experience that modernizes how employees work.

jobs.title: Technischer Support Niederlande (m/w/d) (Reklamationssachbearbeiter/in)
jobs.description:
GGM Gastro, wer sind die eigentlich?

Wer liebt es nicht? In Restaurants, Imbissen und Bars gutes Essen und Drinks genießen! Aber hast du dich eigentlich schon einmal gefragt, wo dein Lieblings-Restaurant sein ganzes Küchenequipment herhat? Die Antwort darauf sind wir – GGM Gastro!!

Als Europas Marktführer für Gastronomiebedarf erleichtern wir seit nunmehr 20 Jahren unzähligen Gastronomen mit professionellem Equipment den Arbeitsalltag.

30 Standorte, 1200 Mitarbeitende und die Reise hat gerade erst begonnen.

Werde auch du Teil der GGM-Familie und wachse gemeinsam mit uns weiter.

Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für technische Anliegen unserer niederländischen Kunden nach dem Kauf. Du sorgst dafür, dass Reklamationen sauber aufgenommen, technisch eingeordnet, transparent kommuniziert und gemeinsam mit allen Beteiligten schnell und nachhaltig gelöst werden.

Die Rolle verbindet technisches Verständnis, Prozesssicherheit und echte Serviceorientierung - genau an dieser Schnittstelle entsteht ein spürbarer Mehrwert für unsere Kunden und für GGM Gastro.

Bei uns kannst du Großes schaffen! Deine Aufgaben im Überblick

- Annahme, Prüfung und Bearbeitung technischer Kundenanfragen und Reklamationen im After-Sales-Bereich über Telefon, E-Mail und CRM-System.
- Erste technische Fehleranalyse anhand von Kundeninformationen, Fotos, Videos und Produktdaten sowie strukturierte Einordnung des Sachverhalts.
- Einleitung passender Maßnahmen wie Störungsbehebung, Ersatzteillieferung, Retoure, Ersatzlieferung oder Weitergabe an relevante Fachbereiche.
- Technische und prozessuale Betreuung von Reklamationskunden - remote sowie bei Bedarf im Showroom in Ochtrup.
- Strukturierte Dokumentation aller Vorgänge in Salesforce sowie aktive Nachverfolgung offener Fälle und Service-Level.
- Transparente Statuskommunikation gegenüber Kunden und internen Schnittstellen entlang desgesamten Lösungsprozesses.
- Koordination mit Logistikpartnern bei Warenrückholungen, Retouren, Lieferabweichungen und Ersatzlieferungen.
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Einkauf, Qualität, Produktmanagement und externen Servicepartnern, um Ursachen zu identifizieren und nachhaltige Lösungen umzusetzen.
- Erkennen wiederkehrender Fehlerbilder und Einbringen von Verbesserungsvorschlägen für Prozesse, Kommunikation und Servicequalität.
- Mitwirken beim Ausbau von Wissen im Team, zum Beispiel durch Fallbeispiele, FAQs oder standardisierte Abläufe.

Dein Know-how zählt! Unser Wunschprofil

- Du hast eine kaufmännische oder technische Ausbildung abgeschlossen, zum Beispiel in den Bereichen Groß- und Außenhandelsmanagement, Büromanagement, E-Commerce, Support oder in einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.
- Du bringst idealerweise Berufserfahrung im After Sales, technischen Kundenservice oder Reklamationsmanagement mit; engagierte Quereinsteiger mit starker Technikaffinität sind ebenfalls willkommen.
- Du verfügst über technisches Verständnis und arbeitest dich schnell in erklärungsbedürftige Produkte, Prozesse und Zusammenhänge ein.
- Du beherrschst den sicheren Umgang mit MS Office; Erfahrung mit CRM-Systemen – idealerweise Salesforce - ist von Vorteil.
- Du sprichst sehr gut Niederländisch und zusätzlich Deutsch oder Englisch und kannst dich schriftlich wie mündlich sicher ausdrücken.
- Belastbarkeit, Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Organisationstalent und eine lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise zeichnen dich aus.
- Du arbeitest gerne im Team, übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Fälle und bringst dich aktiv in bereichsübergreifende Abstimmungen ein.

Wir kümmern uns um dich! Deine Vorteile bei GGM Gastro

Eine strukturierte Einarbeitung

- Einen reibungslosen Einstieg – Klare Abläufe und dein persönlicher Buddy helfen dir, dich schnell zurechtzufinden.
- Individuelle Einarbeitung – Du bekommst eine gezielte Einführung in deine Aufgaben, unsere Tools und Unternehmensprozesse
- Schnelle Integration – Wir fördern den Austausch im Team, damit du dich direkt als Teil von GGM Gastro fühlst.
- Gezielte Weiterentwicklung – Schulungen und regelmäßiges Feedback unterstützen dich in deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung.

Verpflegung

- Firmeneigene Kantine mit frischem, preiswerten Mittagessen für 4€ pro Mahlzeit
- Kostenlose Kaffeebar, Getränke und frisches Obst

Für deine Gesundheit

- EGYM Wellpass für über 13.500 Sport- und Wellness Studios
- Zuschuss von 125,00 € für eine Arbeitsplatzbrille

Etwas für deinen Geldbeutel

- Jubiläumsprämien
- Gesundheitsbonus (5 % des Halbjahres-Bruttoeinkommens bei vollständiger krankheitsfreier Anwesenheit)
- Weihnachtsgeld
- Mitarbeiterangebote und -Rabatte über Corporate Benefits
- Großzügiger Zuschuss zu deinem eclara E-Auto Leasing

Freue dich außerdem auf zusätzliche Benefits, die wir dir im Kennenlerngespräch näherbringen.

jobs.title: Servicetechniker (m/w/d) (Servicetechniker/in - IT)
jobs.description:
Über uns

TIME to Care – bei TimePartner setzen wir uns seit über 30 Jahren dafür ein, Karrieren voranzubringen. Unsere Mission ist es, dich bestmöglich zu unterstützen, damit du deinen beruflichen Zielen näherkommst. Eine schnelle Rückmeldung liegt uns besonders am Herzen: Innerhalb von 24 Stunden erhältst du eine Antwort auf deine Bewerbung. Wir hören zu, verstehen deine Bedürfnisse und begleiten dich auf deinem Weg nach vorne – mit Leidenschaft und Empathie, weil uns deine Zukunft wichtig ist.

Als Servicetechniker (m/w/d) übernimmst Du die Inbetriebnahme, Wartung und Reparatur technischer Systeme rund um die Sicherung von LKW und Wechselbrücken. In dieser Rolle arbeitest Du nah an der Praxis und sorgst dafür, dass Anlagen zuverlässig funktionieren und Kunden im Logistikumfeld sich auf sichere Abläufe verlassen können.

- Du nimmst technische Systeme fachgerecht in Betrieb und prüfst deren Funktion vor Ort.
- Wartungen führst Du planmäßig durch und erkennst technische Auffälligkeiten frühzeitig.
- Bei Störungen analysierst Du Fehler und übernimmst Reparaturen an elektrischen, mechanischen oder steuerungstechnischen Komponenten.
- Deine Einsätze führen Dich zu Logistikkunden aus dem Lebensmittelbereich, zu großen Online-Logistikern und zu weiteren anspruchsvollen Einsatzorten.
- Die Arbeit im Außendienst verbindet technisches Know-how mit direktem Kundenkontakt und einem abwechslungsreichen Einsatzalltag.
- Mit Deinem Blick für sichere und funktionierende Anlagen trägst Du dazu bei, dass Materialflüsse reibungslos laufen.
- Dokumentation von durchgeführten Arbeiten, Prüfungen und Ergebnissen gehört ebenfalls zu Deinem Tagesgeschäft.
Das suchen wir

Gesucht wird ein technischer Allrounder mit Elektroerfahrung, der Serviceeinsätze strukturiert und zuverlässig umsetzt. Wenn Du bereits im technischen Kundendienst, Außendienst oder an vergleichbaren Anlagen gearbeitet hast, passt dieses Profil gut zu der Position.

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im technischen Bereich oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit Elektroerfahrung.
- Berufserfahrung von 3 bis 5 Jahren im Service, in der Instandhaltung oder in einem technischen Außendienst.
- Kenntnisse in elektrischen, mechanischen oder steuerungstechnischen Komponenten.
- Erfahrung mit Verladetechnik, Tor- und Rampenanlagen oder ähnlichen technischen Systemen ist von Vorteil.
- Sicheres und serviceorientiertes Auftreten im Kontakt mit Kunden vor Ort.
- Selbstständige, sorgfältige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.
- Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit.
- Schichtmodelle: Frühschicht.
- Bereitschaft für Einsätze im technischen Umfeld und Freude an praktischer Arbeit.
Das bieten wir

Das Angebot verbindet eine faire Vergütung mit verlässlichen Rahmenbedingungen und einer guten Einarbeitung in den technischen Alltag. So erhältst Du einen Einstieg, der Dir Sicherheit und Entwicklung im Servicebereich bietet.

- Attraktive Vergütung von bis zu 18,08 € pro Stunde.
- Corporate Benefits.
- Vergütung nach Tarifvertrag.
- Strukturierte Einarbeitung durch ein unterstützendes Team.

jobs.title: Senior Expert Corporate Lean Management (m/f/d) (Lean-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Your vision is ambitious. Just like ours.
Our people are our success. As one of us, you will contribute to engineering excellence for the high-tech markets of the future, including semiconductors, batteries, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and data centers. At Exyte, you will be part of a global community of challenge seekers who are ambitious and passionate about innovation. Together, we will build on our company's long history and keep on leading the way to a better world
Discover your exciting role

As a Senior Expert Corporate Production Management (m/f/d) at Exyte, you will play a key role in implementing and further developing our Lean philosophy across international projects.

Explore your tasks and responsibilities

- Implementing Lean Design and Lean Construction methods across all project phases using PPM (Project Production Management), LPS (Last Planner System), and Exyte standard software.
- Training project team members and key users on Lean Construction methods, tools, and software.
- Continuously improving and optimizing standardized Lean tools and methods in close collaboration with stakeholders.
- Driving the transformation and development of high-performance teams by inspiring enthusiasm for Lean principles and production control.
- Acting as the first point of contact for all Lean Design and Construction-related topics within projects.

Show your expertise

- A degree in engineering or project management.
- Extensive expertise in Lean principles.
- 10+ years experience in construction projects and the implementation of Lean project delivery methodologies.
- Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to facilitate workshops and trainings.
- A hands-on mentality and the motivation to drive sustainable improvements.
- Readiness to undertake regular weekly travel to our project sites for up to five days per week to support and train teams in the implementation of Lean principles and production control.
- Fluency in both German and English (written and spoken).

What we offer you

- Your start at Exyte: Take part in a two-day onboarding event with new colleagues.
- Attractive location: Our location in Stuttgart features spacious workstations with height-adjustable desks.
- Buddy-System: Several weeks of close familiarisation with your colleagues in the team.
- Work-life balance: There is always the possibility of switching to mobile working.
- Catering: Free coffee specialities as well as water dispensers are accessible on every floor.
- Keep fit: Exyte subsidises your fitness contract through EGYM Wellpass at over 5,000 locations in Germany.

Contact:

You want to be part of the Exyte team? We look forward to receiving your application!
For further questions and information, please do not hesitate to contact Gerd Fleischmann via E-Mail at gerd.fleischmann@exyte.net.

Please note that we only consider applications submitted through our application portal. Applications sent via email will not be considered due to data protection regulations.

jobs.title: Kernel/Hypervisor Engineer, AWS, EC2 Live Migration (Informatiker/in)
jobs.employer: Amazon Web Services Developmen t Center Germany GmbH
jobs.description:
Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) is a fast-growing business that provides cost effective easy-to-use cloud computing resources to businesses of all sizes around the world. At the Amazon Development Center in Dresden, Germany, we develop and operate Live Migration. This technology enables seamless migration of EC2 instances between physical hosts, helping our customers maintain their applications' availability and resilience.

Are you interested in working where low level programming and large-scale distributed services meet? Are you curious and willing to dive deep to innovate across the various layers that make up EC2? Do you see ambiguous decisions a challenge rather than an obstacle? If so, join our team of highly skilled developers, help us raise the bar to give our customers the best experience a cloud can offer!

We are looking for a highly motivated low level Software Development Engineer to join our EC2 Live Migration team. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing software at the kernel and hypervisor level. In this role, you will work with a team of experienced engineers to build, maintain, and operate our server-side technology that enables Live Migration in EC2. The role involves working with low-level technologies and pushing the limits of what is possible in cloud computing.

Utility Computing (UC)
AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

Key job responsibilities

- Design and develop low-level software for Live Migration in EC2 (mainly in C).
- Write high-quality code that is reliable, scalable, and efficient.
- Work closely with multiple teams to identify, debug, and resolve issues in a timely manner.
- Conduct testing and debugging of software releases.
- Actively participate in code reviews and provide feedback to team members.
- Collaborate with other teams to ensure seamless integration of new features.
- Keep up-to-date with emerging trends and technologies in cloud computing.

A day in the life
At Amazon, we highly value Ownership. As a Software Development Engineer, you will take responsibility for designing, implementing, and delivering projects in a timely manner. Given our strategic position, execution requires daily collaboration with peers at various sites around the world. Being a team player is a must! We care about your career growth. We will find and assign you projects that fit your experience and help you grow your career.

We do not split development and operations. As part of this role, you will be part of an on-call rotation. We relentlessly work to deliver the best quality software to avoid getting paged during our off hours, and expect you to do the same.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic Qualifications

- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
- Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
- Experience in computer architecture
- Strong programming skills in C.
- Experience developing code for the Linux Kernel and/or hypervisors. E.g. device drivers, working with ISR, etc.

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build.
Nur schwerbehinderte oder ihnen gleichgestellte Personen

jobs.title: Business Controller (f/m/d) (Vertriebscontroller/in)
jobs.employer: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

As a Business Controller (f/m/d) within the TI CP Business Controlling team, you serve as a trusted advisor to the Compression Service Region Europe & Africa, supporting a business spanning more than 35 countries. Working closely with regional leadership, finance teams, and operational stakeholders, you provide transparency on financial performance, drive forecasting and budgeting processes, and enable data-driven decision-making across a dynamic and diverse business environment.

Beyond core business controlling, you contribute to key strategic initiatives, including Enterprise Risk Management (ERM), sustainability reporting, central function controlling, and high-impact transformation projects. By combining financial expertise with business acumen and cross-functional collaboration, you help drive sustainable growth, operational excellence, and long-term value creation across the region.

How You’ll Make an Impact

* Acting as the primary Finance Business Partner for the Compression Service Europe & Africa management team, providing financial transparency and actionable insights to support strategic decision-making
* Leading regional forecasting, budgeting, financial performance reviews, and financial planning & analysis activities across a network of more than 35 countries while identifying risks and opportunities
* Strengthening the Enterprise Risk Management framework and partnering with sustainability teams to support ESG initiatives, including EU Taxonomy reporting and compliance requirements
* Providing financial governance and controlling support for central functions, ensuring cost transparency, effective resource allocation, and sound financial governance
* Leading and supporting strategic projects and transformation initiatives, delivering financial insights, business case analyses, and value-creating recommendations
* Promoting process harmonization, digitalization, and automation to improve reporting quality, operational efficiency, and decision-making capabilities

What You Bring

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field; an MBA or other advanced degree is considered an advantage
* Proven experience in controlling, financial planning & analysis (FP&A), business partnering, or finance leadership within an international environment
* Strong expertise in forecasting, budgeting, financial reporting, variance analysis, performance management, and financial governance, ideally complemented by knowledge of Enterprise Risk Management, ESG, or sustainability reporting
* Proven analytical and strategic capabilities with the ability to translate complex financial data into actionable business recommendations and influence management decisions
* Hands-on experience with SAP, financial planning systems, business intelligence tools, and Microsoft Office, combined with excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills in multicultural organizations
* Fluent English skills; additional language skills are considered an advantage

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

Are you passionate about transforming data into powerful insights and driving smarter business decisions?

KWS Berlin GmbH is looking for a Data Analyst with focus on Source-to-Pay (m/w/d) who is keen on translating business requirements into analytics solutions and operating and optimizing data pipelines with strong governance and Master Data standards. - Translate business requirements into analytics solutions and collaborate across the full project lifecycle.
- Operate and optimize data pipelines (ERP, S2P suite, AP, vendor master) with strong governance and master data management standards.

- Support process mining and advanced analytics use cases (e.g., Celonis) to uncover inefficiencies.

- Experience working with large datasets and translating business requirements into scalable analytics solutions.
- Desirable experience in Power Apps, Power Automate and SAP Ariba.
- Proficiency in BI tools (Power BI, SAP SAC, Datasphere) and process mining (Celonis).
- Strong SQL skills; Python or R is a plus.

Ihre Rolle auf einen Blick

Als Senior Director - Construction (m/w/d) verantworten Sie die erfolgreiche Umsetzung von Hyperscale-Rechenzentrums-Campi sowie geschäftskritischen Infrastrukturprojekten. In Ihrer Funktion als leitende Führungskraft am Standort steuern Sie mehrere parallel laufende Projekte und Bauphasen und stellen höchste Standards hinsichtlich Arbeitssicherheit, Qualität, Termin- und Budgeteinhaltung, Inbetriebnahme, Betriebsbereitschaft sowie Stakeholder-Management sicher.

Die Position ist hauptsächlich an unserem Standort FRA6 angesiedelt. Darüber hinaus besteht die Möglichkeit, bei Bedarf weitere Standorte im Raum Frankfurt zu unterstützen. Obwohl die Rolle überwiegend vor Ort ausgeübt wird, ist gelegentliches mobiles Arbeiten möglich, sofern dies mit den operativen und projektbezogenen Anforderungen vereinbar ist.

Bitte reichen Sie Ihren Lebenslauf in englischer Sprache ein.

Ihre Aufgaben

- Führung und Weiterentwicklung interdisziplinärer Teams in den Bereichen Bau, Projektmanagement, Planung, Projektsteuerung, Inbetriebnahme und Lieferantenmanagement
- Strategische Gesamtverantwortung für die erfolgreiche Realisierung von Hyperscale-Rechenzentrums-Campi und zugehöriger Infrastruktur
- Steuerung sämtlicher Bauaktivitäten, einschließlich Tief- und Hochbau, Gebäudehülle und Rohbau, technischer Gebäudeausrüstung (MEP), Innenausbau, Versorgungseinrichtungen und externer Infrastruktur
- Förderung einer ausgeprägten Sicherheits-, Gesundheits- und Umweltkultur unter Einhaltung aller Unternehmensstandards sowie relevanten gesetzlichen Vorgaben
- Verantwortung für Terminplanung, Budgetkontrolle, Qualitätsmanagement, Risikomanagement, Änderungsmanagement sowie Berichterstattung an das Senior Management
- Koordination von Generalunternehmern, Spezialsubunternehmern, OFCI-Lieferanten, Versorgungsunternehmen, Behörden und weiteren wesentlichen Stakeholdern
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Bereichen Engineering, Procurement, Operations, Commissioning, Commercial und HSE über den gesamten Projektlebenszyklus hinweg
- Sicherstellung von Standardisierung, Konsistenz und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung innerhalb aller Campus-Realisierungsaktivitäten
- Überwachung der Leistung von Auftragnehmern, Personalplanung, Produktivität und termingerechter Erreichung von Meilensteinen
- Steuerung von Inbetriebnahmen, integrierten Systemtests sowie phasenweisen Übergaben zur Sicherstellung der Betriebsbereitschaft

Ihr Profil

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Bauingenieurwesen, Construction Management, Projektmanagement, Betriebswirtschaft oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung beziehungsweise eine gleichwertige Kombination aus Ausbildung und Berufserfahrung
- Umfangreiche Erfahrung in der Leitung von Bau- und Infrastrukturprojekten, davon mindestens 10 Jahre in geschäftskritischen Branchen wie Rechenzentren, Industrie- oder Infrastrukturprojekten
- Nachweisliche Erfolge bei der Umsetzung großvolumiger Campusentwicklungen oder geschäftskritischer Projekte, idealerweise mit einer kritischen Kapazität von mehr als 100 MW
- Fundierte Kenntnisse im Bauprojektmanagement, Projektcontrolling, Terminplanung, Beschaffung, Vertragsmanagement und Inbetriebnahme
- Erfahrung in der Projektabwicklung nach Design & Build-, EPC-, Management Contracting- und/oder klassischen Vergabemodellen
- Gute Kenntnisse gängiger Vertragswerke, insbesondere FIDIC und vergleichbarer Vertragsstandards
- Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, komplexe Stakeholder-Beziehungen im Umfeld von Kunden, Auftragnehmern, Lieferanten und Behörden erfolgreich zu managen
- Ausgeprägte Führungs-, Kommunikations-, Verhandlungs-, Organisations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten
- Sicherer Umgang mit Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, Excel, PowerPoint sowie Projekt-Reporting-Tools
- Fähigkeit zur erfolgreichen Zusammenarbeit in internationalen und multikulturellen Teams
- Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Wer wir sind

Als drittgrößter Betreiber von Rechenzentren weltweit betreiben wir mehr als 150 Rechenzentren in über 20 Ländern und Regionen. Wir wissen, dass jedes Unternehmen, unabhängig von seiner Größe, individuelle Anforderungen und Ziele hat. Mit unserer lokalen und globalen Rechenzentrumsexpertise sowie einer vernetzten Plattform aus KI-fähigen Rechenzentren entwickeln wir Lösungen, die es unseren Kunden ermöglichen, ihre digitalen Geschäftsmodelle jederzeit und überall nahtlos zu skalieren.

Hochvolt- und Sicherheitsschulungen sowie weitere Technische Trainings)

jobs.title: Head of Electrical Engineering (m/w/d) (Leiter/in - Engineering)
jobs.description:
Die expertum Gruppe bietet technischen und kaufmännischen Fach- und Führungskräften attraktive Aufgaben und Karrierechancen in der Industrie. Für unsere Mitarbeiter sind wir ein zuverlässiger und fairer Partner - gehen Sie mit expertum den Weg zu neuen beruflichen Herausforderungen bei namhaften und wertschätzenden Kunden!

HIER WERDEN SIE ARBEITEN:
Als international erfolgreiches Technologieunternehmen im Bereich Umwelt- und Recyclingtechnik entwickelt und produziert unser Mandant innovative Maschinen und Anlagen für die Aufbereitung von Abfällen, Biomasse und Wertstoffen. Zur strategischen und technologischen Weiterentwicklung des Bereichs Electrical Engineering suchen wir eine erfahrene Führungspersönlichkeit für unseren Mandanten als Head of Electrical Engineering (m/w/d) am Standort Frohnleiten.

DIES SIND IHRE AUFGABEN:

- Zu Ihrem Aufgabenbereich gehört die fachliche und disziplinarische Führung eines Teams aus Elektrokonstrukteuren sowie Softwareentwicklern mit den Schwerpunkten SPS, HMI und EPLAN. Dabei fördern Sie die fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung Ihrer Mitarbeitenden und schaffen die Voraussetzungen für eine erfolgreiche Zusammenarbeit.
- Sie definieren und entwickeln die technologische Roadmap im Bereich Electrical Engineering und legen Standards für die Hard- und Softwarearchitektur fest. Dabei stellen Sie eine zukunftsorientierte Ausrichtung der eingesetzten Technologien und Entwicklungsprozesse sicher.
- Darüber hinaus verantworten Sie die termingerechte Planung und Steuerung von Entwicklungs- und Projektierungsaufgaben - von der Konzeptphase über die Umsetzung bis hin zur Serienreife der Produkte und Anlagen.
- Sie arbeiten eng mit den Bereichen Mechanik-Konstruktion, Smart Products, Digital Solutions, Kundenservice und Fertigung zusammen und sorgen für effiziente, modulare sowie skalierbare Lösungen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette.
- Außerdem treiben Sie die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Maschinensteuerung als zentrales Element unserer Anlagen aktiv voran. Dabei entwickeln Sie innovative Hard- und Softwarekonzepte und schaffen die Voraussetzungen für eine standardisierte Bereitstellung von Maschinendaten für nachgelagerte Systeme.
- Sie identifizieren Optimierungspotenziale in Prozessen, Technologien und Standards und leisten einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur nachhaltigen Weiterentwicklung des Unternehmens.

DAS BRINGEN SIE MIT:

- Sie verfügen über ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Elektrotechnik, Automatisierungstechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung beziehungsweise über eine gleichwertige Qualifikation.
- Sie bringen mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Elektro- oder Softwareprojektierung im Maschinen- oder Anlagenbau mit und konnten idealerweise bereits Führungserfahrung in einer leitenden oder stellvertretenden Führungsfunktion sammeln.
- Darüber hinaus verfügen Sie über fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich der Standardisierung technischer Lösungen und Prozesse sowie über Erfahrung in der Umsetzung entsprechender Projekte.
- Sie besitzen einen sicheren Umgang mit gängigen CAE-Systemen wie EPLAN P8 oder CREO sowie mit SAP und bringen ein gutes Verständnis für moderne Engineering-Prozesse mit.
- Außerdem verfügen Sie über grundlegende Kenntnisse in der SPS-Programmierung und Antriebstechnik sowie über einen sicheren Umgang mit relevanten Normen, Richtlinien und regulatorischen Anforderungen.
- Sie haben Kenntnisse oder Weiterbildungen im Bereich Functional Safety absolviert und verfügen idealerweise über ein grundlegendes Verständnis von OT-Security sowie der damit verbundenen Anforderungen, beispielsweise im Kontext des Cyber Resilience Act (CRA).
- Sie zeichnen sich durch eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte und entscheidungsstarke Arbeitsweise aus und verstehen es, komplexe Sachverhalte zu analysieren, Prioritäten zu setzen und zielgerichtete Entscheidungen zu treffen.
- Darüber hinaus überzeugen Sie durch eine klare und wertschätzende Kommunikation sowie durch Ihre Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Stakeholder erfolgreich zusammenzubringen und Teams zu motivieren.
- Sie verfügen über verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse und kommunizieren souverän mit internationalen Kunden, Partnern und Lieferanten.

WIR GARANTIEREN IHNEN:

- Sie erwartet eine direkte Festanstellung bei unserem wertschätzenden Kunden.
- Um Sie bestmöglich bei unserem Kunden zu präsentieren, optimieren wir gemeinsam Ihre Bewerbungsunterlagen und bereiten Sie gründlich auf das Vorstellungsgespräch im Unternehmen vor.
- Damit Sie zu den besten Konditionen eingestellt werden, stehen wir Ihnen im Voraus zur Verhandlung Ihres Arbeitsvertrags beratend zur Seite.
- Darüber hinaus beraten wir Sie auch gern kostenfrei zu weiteren passenden Karrieremöglichkeiten.

LEBENSLAUF GENÜGT:
Die Online-Bewerbung bei expertum dauert nur wenige Minuten. Laden Sie einfach Ihren Lebenslauf hoch, überprüfen Sie die übernommenen Daten und schicken Sie die Bewerbung ab - fertig. Alternativ können Sie uns Ihre Bewerbung auch per E-Mail zukommen lassen. Wir freuen uns auf Sie!

jobs.title: Recepcionista de noche (Nachtportier (Gaststätte, Hotel))
jobs.description:
Recepcionista de noche

Descripción de la empresa

Nuestro corazón es turquesa.

Trabajar para Motel One es como estar en casa de un amigo, donde el reconocimiento y el apoyo gozan de la máxima importancia y las cualidades personales son bien acogidas. Nos tratamos de igual a igual y formamos equipo: desde la dirección hasta los becarios.

Con nuestra pasión conjunta por el diseño moderno y la alta calidad de servicio, creamos un hogar para nuestros huéspedes en Motel One. Nuestros más de 80 hoteles en doce países impresionan por su diseño exclusivo, los altos estándares de servicio y las ubicaciones privilegiadas en el centro urbano, siempre a un precio atractivo.

Como fundadores y embajadores del concepto de diseño asequible, nos estamos expandiendo con éxito por las ciudades de Europa y más allá. Únase a nuestro equipo y demos forma juntos a Motel One.

Descripción del empleo

Atender a nuestros huéspedes de forma profesional en la recepción es muy importante en todo momento: desde una cálida bienvenida en el check-in hasta su salida. Por lo tanto, su trabajo consistirá en ayudar a nuestros huéspedes más madrugadores y trasnochadores. Sus responsabilidades también incluirán las siguientes:

- Preparar saldos diarios de cierre
- Realizar transacciones en efectivo y cobros
- Procesar solicitudes de reserva
- Ayudar en la preparación del desayuno

Benefits:

- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!
- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.
- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.
- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.
- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.

Requisitos

Tanto si es un profesional del mundo de los hoteles como si está cambiando de carrera profesional, ¡estamos seguros de que su perfil encajará en nuestra empresa! ¡La personalidad y los dotes de anfitrión son nuestra prioridad! También tendrá que reunir los siguientes requisitos:

- Tener formación en el sector de los hoteles y/o tener experiencia profesional en la industria hotelera/catering o estar buscando un cambio de carrera profesional
- Tener un excelente sentido de la calidad y el servicio, así como dotes de anfitrión y pasión por la industria hotelera
- Ser una persona abierta, comunicativa y segura de sí misma, y tener un sólido dominio del inglés
- Ser una persona a la que le guste trabajar en equipo y que esté dispuesta a proporcionar asistencia en todos los departamentos: ¡en Motel One, los objetivos son conjuntos, así que nos ayudamos entre todos!

Vous êtes passionné(e) par la restauration, le management d’équipes et la création d’expériences mémorables ? Vous souhaitez relever un nouveau défi dans un hôtel dynamique de 347 chambres, doté de deux concepts bar à forte identité, spécialité en gin, dont un spectaculaire Skybar avec rooftop, ainsi qu’une activité petit-déjeuner à fort volume et 3 salles de réunion.

Votre mission:

- L’élaboration des plannings et des calendriers de congés

Au-delà de votre expérience, c’est votre énergie, votre leadership et votre passion pour l’hôtellerie qui feront la différence.

Nous recherchons une personnalité capable d’inspirer ses équipes, de créer des expériences mémorables pour nos clients et de faire rayonner nos différents points de vente avec enthousiasme et exigence.

jobs.title: Recepcionista (Empfangskraft)

Recepcionista

Descripción de la empresa

Nuestro corazón es turquesa.

Trabajar para Motel One es como estar en casa de un amigo, donde el reconocimiento y el apoyo gozan de la máxima importancia y las cualidades personales son bien acogidas. Nos tratamos de igual a igual y formamos equipo: desde la dirección hasta los becarios.

Con nuestra pasión conjunta por el diseño moderno y la alta calidad de servicio, creamos un hogar para nuestros huéspedes en Motel One. Nuestros más de 80 hoteles en doce países impresionan por su diseño exclusivo, los altos estándares de servicio y las ubicaciones privilegiadas en el centro urbano, siempre a un precio atractivo.

Como fundadores y embajadores del concepto de diseño asequible, nos estamos expandiendo con éxito por las ciudades de Europa y más allá. Únase a nuestro equipo y demos forma juntos a Motel One.

Descripción del empleo

El objetivo de este puesto es ofrecer una atención profesional a nuestros huéspedes, desde una cálida bienvenida en el check-in hasta una bonita despedida en el check-out. Sus responsabilidades también incluirán las siguientes:

- Atender a nuestros huéspedes, incluyendo la realización del check-in y check-out
- Revisar y procesar reservas, sobrerreservas y otras opciones
- Gestionar la facturación, incluida la gestión de pagos, así como transacciones y cobros en efectivo
- Realizar tareas organizativas y administrativas en el front-office y back-office (por ejemplo, gestión de ausencias, respuesta a correos electrónicos)
- Adquirir conocimientos interdepartamentales sobre nuevas áreas de actividad mediante el trabajo en nuestros equipos multiculturales

Benefits:

- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!
- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.
- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.
- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.
- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.

Requisitos

Tanto si es un profesional del mundo de los hoteles como si está cambiando de carrera profesional, ¡estamos seguros de que su perfil encajará en nuestra empresa! ¡La personalidad y los dotes de anfitrión son nuestra prioridad! También tendrá que reunir los siguientes requisitos:

- Tener formación en el sector de los hoteles y/o tener experiencia profesional en la industria hotelera/catering o estar buscando un cambio de carrera profesional
- Tener un excelente sentido de la calidad y el servicio, así como dotes de anfitrión y pasión por la industria hotelera
- Ser una persona abierta y comunicativa y tener un sólido dominio del inglés
- Ser una persona a la que le guste trabajar en equipo y que esté dispuesta a proporcionar asistencia en todos los departamentos: ¡en Motel One, los objetivos son conjuntos, así que nos ayudamos entre todos!
