JAVNI NATJEČAJ

za radna mjesta

5. Stručni radnik u sustavu socijalne zaštite 2 - socijalni radnik na određeno nepuno radno vrijeme (4 sata dnevno)

Uvjeti pod 5.

  • završen preddiplomski i diplomski sveučilišni studij socijalnog rada ili preddiplomski sveučilišni studij socijalnog rada i diplomski sveučilišni studij socijalne politike ili integrirani preddiplomski i diplomski sveučilišni studij socijalnog rada u Republici Hrvatskoj ili mu je priznata inozemna stručna kvalifikacija za obavljanje regulirane profesije-socijalni radnik u skladu s propisima kojima se regulira djelatnosti socijalnog rada.
  • 1 godina radnog iskustva u struci
  • poznavanje rada na računalu
  • položen stručni ispit
  • odobrenje za rad nadležne komore
  • probni rad: 6 mjeseci

U dokumentaciji za natječaj kandidati su dužni priložiti:

- Vlastoručno potpisanu zamolbu sa kontakt podacima (broj telefona/mobitela, email adresa) za sva radna mjesta - Vlastoručno potpisan životopis za sva radna mjesta - Važeću osobnu iskaznicu, vojnu iskaznicu ili putovnicu, a u slučaju da ne posjeduje ni jednu od navedenih isprava – domovnicu za sva radna mjesta - Diploma o završenom akademskom obrazovanju za radna mjesta pod točkom 1. i 5. - Dokaz o položenom stručnom ispitu i važeće odobrenje za samostalan rad - licenca za radna mjesta pod točkom 1., 2. i 5. - Dokaz o radnom stažu (elektronički zapis Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje) za sva radna mjesta - Vlastoručna potpisana izjava o poznavanju rada na računalu za radna mjesta pod točkom 1., 2. i 5. - Dokaz o ostvarenom radnom iskustvu na poslovima traženog obrazovanja (potvrda poslodavca, ugovor o radu i sl.) za radna mjesta pod točkom. 1., 2. i 5. - Uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak, ne starije od 30 dana od dana predaje natječaja za sva radna mjesta

Deficitarni kadar ostvaruje prava iz Programa mjera za zadržavanje i privlačenje ljudskih resursa u javnim zdravstvenim ustanovama i domovima za starije osobe kojima je osnivač Istarska županija u 2026. godini. Detalje o pravima koje ostvaruju deficitarni kadrovi možete pronaći na poveznici:https://www.istra-istria.hr/hr/izdvojene-stranice/program-mjera-za-zadrzavanje-i-privlacenje-ljudskih-resursa-u-jz/

Kandidati cjelokupnu dokumentaciju dostavljaju u preslici na hrvatskom jeziku, dok će izabrani kandidati biti pozvani da iste dostave u izvorniku ili ovjerenoj preslici. Dostavljena dokumentacija neće se vraćati. Potpunom prijavom smatra se ona koja sadržava sve podatke, kontakt podatke i priloge navedene u natječaju.

Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu ili potpunu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom u postupku natječaja i prijave se neće razmatrati.

Napomena: Dokaz da kod pojedinog kandidata/kinje ne postoji zapreka iz članka 261. st. 1 Zakona o socijalnoj skrbi ( Narodne novine br. 18/22, 46/22, 119/22, 71/23, 156/23, 61/25) pribaviti će po službenoj dužnosti i Dom.

Svi kandidati podnošenjem prijave daju svoju suglasnost Domu za starije osobe Novigrad, Domovinskih žrtava 14, 52466 Novigrad da u njoj navedene osobne podatke prikuplja, obrađuje i pohranjuje u svrhu zapošljavanja, te da ih može koristiti u svrhu sklapanja ugovora, kontaktiranja i objave na internetskim stranicama i oglasnoj ploči. Sve pristigle prijave biti će zaštićene od pristupa neovlaštenih osoba te pohranjene na sigurno mjesto i čuvane u skladu s uvjetima i rokovima predviđenim zakonskim propisima, aktima i odluka voditelja obrade.

Prava kandidata i postupanje u odnosu na njegove osobne podatke može vidjeti na web stranici doma www.dzsino-novigrad.hr (zaštita privatnosti).

Na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola sukladno Zakonu o ravnopravnosti spolova.

Osobe koje prema posebnim propisima ostvaruju pravo prednosti moraju se u prijavi pozvati na to pravo, odnosno uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu.

Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, br. 121/17., 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), dužni su prilikom prijave na natječaj, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji, a koji su objavljeni na web-stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja, na poveznici: http://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju na temelju članka 48.  Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj 84/21 i 13/26) dužan je uz prijavu priložiti sve dokaze iz stavka 1. članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata.

Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarenje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf

Kandidati koji se pozivaju na prednost prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanja osoba s invaliditetom (NN, br.: 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) uz prijavu na natječaj dužan/a je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom.

Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti prema posebnim propisima imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Za kandidate koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete mogu se obaviti razgovori te po potrebi provesti dodatno testiranje u svrhu provjere znanja, vještina i sposobnosti bitnih za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta za koje se kandidati/kinje primaju u radni odnos.

Kandidati koji se u prijavi pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju po posebnom zakonu, Dom neće dati prednost pri zapošljavanju ukoliko se po provedenom dodatnom testiranju utvrdi da se kandidat/kinja ne preporuča ili da se izrazito ne preporuča.

Prijave na natječaj s dokazima o ispunjavanju uvjeta natječaja dostavljaju se isključivo u pisanom obliku, preporučenom pošiljkom ili poštom ili osobnom dostavom radim danom od ponedjeljka do petka od 08:00 – 15:00 sati na adresu: Dom za starije osobe Novigrad – Casa per anziani Cittanova, Domovinskih žrtava 14, 52466 Novigrad, s naznakom: „Javni natječaj za zapošljavanje za radno mjesto (navesti radno mjesto za koje se podnosi prijava) - ne otvaraj“ u roku od 15 dana od dana objave natječaja.

Natječaj je objavljen putem Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje, na web stranici i oglasnim pločama Doma, te Narodnim novinama.

Dom za starije osobe Novigrad – Casa per anziani Cittanova pridržava pravo poništenja natječaja, odnosno pravo ne odabrati ni jednog kandidata, bez obveze obrazlaganja svoje odluke i bez ikakve odgovornosti prema kandidatima.

O rezultatima natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni putem web-stranice Doma za starije osobe Novigrad – Casa per anziani Cittanova, www.dzsino-novigrad.hr, objave – natječaji, a sukladno članku 10. st.1. t. 10 Zakona o pravu na pristup informacijama („Narodne novine“ broj 25/13, 85/15, 69/22).

RAVNATELJICA

Morena Stanivuković, mag.act.soc.

jobs.title: VODIČ / VODIČICA E-BIKE TURA / NAJMOVA – S MOGUĆNOŠĆU STALNOG ZAPOSLENJA
jobs.description:
Opis posla: Tražimo odgovornu, poduzetnu i komunikativnu osobu za rad na otoku Mljetu u turističkoj sezoni 2026., s namjerom dugoročne suradnje. Posao obuhvaća vođenje e-bike tura, upravljanje najmom električnih bicikala, brigu o opremi te aktivno sudjelovanje u prodaji usluga agencije. Ovaj oglas nije samo za sezonski rad; tražimo osobu koja će preuzeti odgovornost za punkt i, u slučaju obostranog zadovoljstva, postati stalni član našeg tima. Što nudimo:
  • STALNI RADNI ODNOS: Nakon uspješno odrađene sezone, nudimo mogućnost stalnog zaposlenja ili ugovora za stalnog sezonskog radnika.
  • VRHUNSKA PRIMANJA: Fiksna plaća + stimulativni dio (provizija) od svakog ostvarenog prometa. Vaš trud izravno utječe na visinu ukupne plaće.
  • PLAĆENI TROŠKOVI: Potpuno besplatan smještaj, hrana i putni troškovi.
  • EDUKACIJA: Profesionalna obuka za rad s e-bike opremom i vođenje tura na moru.
Što tražimo:
  • Visoka razina odgovornosti i "domaćinski" odnos prema opremi i poslu.
  • Izvrsno poznavanje engleskog jezika (C1).
  • Vozačka dozvola B kategorije.
  • Spremnost na rad od travnja/svibnja do studenog, uključujući pripremu i raspremu sezone.
  • Iskustvo u turizmu ili prodaji je velika prednost.

  • pronalaziti vlasnike, direktore i druge osobe odgovorne za donošenje odluka
  • istraživati osnovne podatke o tvrtki prije prvog kontakta
  • kontaktirati potencijalne korisnike putem e-maila i telefona
  • predstaviti razlog javljanja i provjeriti postoji li interes za razgovor
  • voditi komunikaciju od prvog kontakta do dogovaranja prodajne prezentacije
  • zakazivati termine i pripremati prodaji informacije o potencijalnom korisniku
  • voditi urednu evidenciju svih kontakata i aktivnosti u HubSpotu
  • pratiti dogovorene rokove i planirati ponovne kontakte
  • pripremati i slati ponude, ugovore i fakture prema postojećim predlošcima
  • surađivati s prodajom i osobom zaduženom za odnose s korisnicima
  • na početku ćete upoznati Insidico, postojeće korisnike i probleme koje aplikacija rješava
  • proći ćete naš način pronalaska potencijalnih korisnika, primjere dosadašnjih e-mailova i poziva, pravila rada u hubspotu te način na koji se dogovorena prezentacija predaje prodaji
  • prve popise kontakata, e-mailove i pozive prolazit ćemo zajedno. Cilj je da nakon razdoblja uhodavanja možete samostalno organizirati svoj rad i voditi pretprodajne aktivnosti
  • opseg aktivnosti i očekivani rezultati prilagođavat će se dogovorenom broju radnih sati
Poslodavac traži:
  • tražimo osobu koja zna jasno komunicirati, dobro organizirati svoj rad i samostalno doći do potrebnih informacija
  • važno nam je da nemate problem nazvati osobu s kojom prethodno niste razgovarali.U ovom poslu bit će neodgovorenih e-mailova, odbijenih poziva i odgovora da tvrtka trenutačno nije zainteresirana. Očekujemo da takve situacije prihvatite kao normalan dio prodajnog procesa i nastavite raditi bez nepotrebnog pritiska na potencijalnog korisnika.
  • prethodno iskustvo u prodaji nije uvjet. Spremni smo raditi i s osobom koja tek ulazi u prodaju, ali očekujemo interes za učenje, samostalnost i odgovornost prema dogovorenim zadacima.
Uvjeti:
  • najmanje završena srednja škola
  • razvijene usmene i pisane komunikacijske vještine
  • organiziranost i sposobnost određivanja prioriteta
  • samostalnost, upornost i snalažljivost
  • urednost u vođenju podataka i praćenju rokova
  • dobro poznavanje rada na računalu
  • korištenje programa Microsoft Office i Outlook
  • spremnost na rad u HubSpotu, Google kalendaru, Google Meetu i internim alatima
  • aktivno znanje hrvatskog jezika
  • B2B prodaji ili telefonskom kontaktiranju potencijalnih korisnika
  • istraživanju tržišta i izradi baza kontakata
  • radu u CRM sustavu, posebno HubSpotu
  • građevinskoj industriji
  • prodaji softvera ili drugih poslovnih usluga
Poslodavac nudi:
  • rad na nepuno radno vrijeme uz mogućnost kasnijeg prelaska na puno radno vrijeme
  • mogućnost rada putem ugovora o radu ili studentskog ugovora
  • fleksibilan raspored unutar unaprijed dogovorenog broja sati
  • rad iz našeg ureda u Osijeku
  • mogućnost djelomičnog rada od kuće nakon razdoblja uhodavanja
  • dogovoreni sustav nagrađivanja prema rezultatima
  • rad u malom timu u kojem ćete izravno surađivati s prodajom i Customer Successom
  • detaljan onboarding i podršku tijekom prvih mjeseci
  • mogućnost napredovanja prema samostalnom vođenju prodajnih prezentacija i prodajnih procesa
Postupak odabira: Kandidati koji uđu u uži izbor bit će pozvani na razgovor i praktično testiranje. Testiranje će uključivati zadatke povezane s istraživanjem potencijalnih korisnika, pisanom komunikacijom, organizacijom rada i kratkom simulacijom telefonskog razgovora. Ne očekujemo da prije razgovora poznajete sve funkcionalnosti Insidica. Zanima nas kako razmišljate, pronalazite informacije, komunicirate i organizirate zadatke. Prijava Pošaljite životopis na matej@insidico.com najkasnije do 01. rujna 2026. Planirani početak rada je tijekom rujna 2026., prema dogovoru s odabranim kandidatom.

jobs.title: SOBAR/SOBARICA U HOTELU
jobs.description:
Opis poslova:
- pripremanje hotela i ostalih prostorija za početak rada
- briga o čistoći i estetskoj uređenosti
- primjenjivanje mjera i sredstava zaštite na radu
- provođenje aktivnosti u skladu sa zakonskim propisima, internim propisima, procedurama te ciljevima

Od kandidata se traži:
- ljubaznost i gostiljubivost
- sklonost timskom radu

Pogodnosti koje pružamo:
- rad u jutarnjoj smjeni
- cjelogodišnji posao
- konkurentnu plaću u turizmu
- dodatne stimulacije – mjesečne nagrade
- organiziran i plaćen smještaj za zaposlenike koji imaju prebivalište izvan lokacije rada
- plaćen putni trošak za zaposlenike koji imaju prebivalište/boravište izvan lokacije rada
- osigurani topli obroci
- ulaganje u razvoj zaposlenika i mogućnost napredovanja unutar odjela i kompanije
- rad u stabilnoj i uspješnoj kompaniji te profesionalnoj i pozitivnoj atmosferi

Poželjne kvalifikacije i kompetencije:
- iskustvo u radu na istim ili sličnim poslovima u ugostiteljstvu

jobs.title: KUHAR/KUHARICA
jobs.description:
Opis poslova:
- priprema jela prema standardima rada
- pridržavanje svih propisa za skladištenje namirnica i održavanje higijenskih standarda
- briga o skladištu
- pridržavanje normativa u pripremi i kuhanju hrane
- briga o ujednačenom izgledu tanjura

Poslodavac nudi:
- mogućnost zapošljavanja na sezonu, na godinu dana ili na neodređeno
- strukturirano uvođenje u posao
- kontinuirano ulaganje u edukaciju i daljnji profesionalni razvoj
- rad u sredini koja vodi računa o zadovoljstvu zaposlenika i gostiju
- radnu odjeću i obuću
- topli obrok
- po potrebi osiguravamo smještaj

jobs.title: RECEPCIONAR/RECEPCIONARKA U HOTELU
jobs.description:
Opis poslova:
- prijem, prijava, odjava gostiju
- točan unos i ažuriranje podataka gostiju u sistem
- naplata usluga i izdavanje računa
- pružanje svih informacija gostima hotela
- zaprimanje pohvala i pritužbi te profesionalno rješavanje istih
- bliska suradnja sa odjelom domaćinstva kao i suradnja s ostalim osobljem hotela u cilju boljeg poslovanja
- ispunjavanja svih zahtjeva od strane gosta
- svi ostali poslovi prema uputama voditelja recepcije
- odgovaranje na upite pisanim i telefonskim putem

O rezultatima provedenog natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni pisanim putem u zakonskom roku. Zadržava se pravo poništenja natječaja. Natječaj je objavljen dana 6. kolovoza 2026. i traje do 14. kolovoza 2026. godine.

jobs.title: ODGOJITELJ/ICA
jobs.description: Na temelju članka 26. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (“Narodne novine” broj 10/97., 107/07., 94/13., 98/19., 57/22., 101/23. i 22/26.) i Odluci Upravnog vijeća (KLASA: 112-02/26-01/28, URBROJ: 2163-4-12-04-26-1 od 23. srpnja 2026. godine), Upravno vijeće Dječjeg vrtića “Pjerina Verbanac” Labin, raspisuje: NATJEČAJ ZA RADNO MJESTO ODGOJITELJ/ICA ♦ 2 (dva) izvršitelja/ice – na određeno, puno radno vrijeme, za pedagošku godinu 26./27. Na natječaj se mogu prijaviti osobe oba spola, sukladno članku 13. stavku 3. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova (“Narodne novine”, broj 82/08. i 69/17.). Izrazi koji se koriste u natječaju, a imaju rodno značenje koriste se neutralno i odnose se jednako na muški i ženski rod. UVJETI za radno mjesto odgojitelja/ice su: Prema članku 24. i 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju („Narodne novine“ broj 10/97., 107/07., 94/13., 98/19., 57/22., 101/23. i 22/26.) i Pravilniku o odgovarajućoj vrsti i razini obrazovanja odgojno-obrazovnih i ostalih radnika u dječjem vrtiću, ustanovama te drugim pravnim i fizičkim osobama koje provode programe ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja (“Narodne novine” broj 145/24. i 62/25.), završen studij odgovarajuće vrste za rad na radnome mjestu odgojitelja, a koji može biti: a) sveučilišni prijediplomski studij, b) stručni prijediplomski studij, c) studij kojim je stečena viša stručna sprema u skladu s prijašnjim propisima, d) sveučilišni diplomski studij, e) stručni diplomski studij. Ako se na natječaj ne javi osoba koja ispunjava navedene uvjete, poslove odgojitelja može obavljati osoba koja je završila učiteljski studij, i to: sveučilišni integrirani prijediplomski i diplomski studij, stručni diplomski studij ili četverogodišnji stručni studij primarnoga obrazovanja i koja je završila program za stjecanje odgojno-obrazovnih kompetencija za rad s djecom rane i predškolske dobi. Ako se na natječaj ne javi osoba koja ispunjava gore navedene uvjete, poslove odgojitelja može obavljati osoba koja je završila učiteljski studij, i to: sveučilišni integrirani prijediplomski i diplomski studij ili stručni diplomski studij ili četverogodišnji stručni studij primarnoga obrazovanja, uz uvjet da u roku od dvije godine od dana zasnivanja radnoga odnosa završi program za stjecanje odgojno-obrazovnih kompetencija za rad s djecom rane i predškolske dobi. Kandidati na natječaj trebaju dostaviti: - vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu na natječaj s kontakt podacima (e - mail adresa i broj mobitela ili telefona), - životopis, - dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi, - uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak (ne starije od dana raspisivanja natječaja), - uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi prekršajni postupak (ne starije od dana raspisivanja natječaja), - potvrdu Hrvatskog zavoda za socijalni rad (prema mjestu stanovanja/prebivališta) da kandidatu nisu izrečene zaštitne mjere iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (ne stariju od dana raspisivanja natječaja), - dokaz o državljanstvu (preslika važeće osobne iskaznice, putovnice ili domovnice), - elektronički zapis o radno pravnom statusu (ispis iz evidencije Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje), ne starije od dana raspisivanja natječaja. Prilikom eventualnog zaposlenja kandidata poslodavac utvrđuje zdravstvenu sposobnost radnika. Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja prema posebnim propisima dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu te imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema odredbama članka 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“, broj 121/17., 98/19., 84/21. I 156/23.), dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj pored navedenih isprava odnosno priloga priložiti i sve potrebne dokaze iz članka 103. stavka 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji koji su dostupni na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata („Narodne novine“ broj 84/21.), uz prijavu na natječaj pored navedenih isprava odnosno priloga dužni su priložiti i dokaze iz stavka 1. članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanja prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48.f. Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata („Narodne novine“ broj 33/92., 57/92., 77/92., 27/93., 58/93., 2/94., 76/94., 108/95., 180/96., 82/01., 103/03., 148/13. i 98/19.), dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj pored navedenih isprava odnosno priloga priložiti potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo te dokaz o tome na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod prethodnog poslodavca. Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom („Narodne novine“ broj 157/13., 152/14., 39/18. i 32/20.) dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj pored navedenih isprava odnosno priloga priložiti dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom te dokaz o tome na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod prethodnog poslodavca. Prijavom na natječaj kandidati su suglasni da Dječji vrtić “Pjerina Verbanac” Labin kao voditelj zbirke osobnih podataka može prikupljati, obrađivati i koristiti osobne podatke u svrhu provedbe postupka natječaja sukladno odredbama Uredbe (EU) 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i vijeća od 27. travnja 2016. o zaštiti pojedinaca u vezi s obradom osobnih podataka i o slobodnom kretanju takvih podataka te o stavljanju izvan snage Direktive 95/46/EZ (Opća uredba o zaštiti podataka) i Zakona o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka („Narodne novine“ broj 42/18.). Rok za podnošenje prijave je osam (8) dana od dana objave natječaja. Prijave za natječaj s obveznom dokumentacijom dostavljaju se elektroničkom poštom na: tajnistvo@dvlabin.hr (uz naznaku: “Za natječaj”) ili osobno u ustanovu na adresu: Dječji vrtić “Pjerina Verbanac” Labin, Prilaz Kršin 2, Labin. Prijave koje se podnose osobno u ustanovu, dostavljaju se u zatvorenoj omotnici s naznakom: Dječji vrtić “Pjerina Verbanac” Labin – natječaj za odgojitelja/icu, za pedagošku godinu 26./27., ne otvarati.” Natječajna dokumentacija se neće vraćati kandidatima. Zakašnjele prijave kao i prijave s nepotpunom dokumentacijom neće se razmatrati. Kandidati koji ispunjavaju uvjete iz natječaja biti će pozvani na intervju. Kandidat koji ne pristupi intervjuu smatra se da je odustao od prijave na natječaj i više se ne smatra kandidatom u natječajnom postupku. O rezultatima provedenog natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni pisanim putem u zakonskom roku. Zadržava se pravo poništenja natječaja. Natječaj je objavljen dana 6. kolovoza 2026. i traje do 14. kolovoza 2026. godine.

jobs.title: VODITELJ/ICA SMJENE
jobs.description:
Opis posla:

  • Obavljanje svakodnevnih zadataka u vođenju prodavaonice i njenih odjela.
  • Dostizanje prodajnih ciljeva i maksimizacija profita.
  • Selekcija, zapošljavanje, edukacija, ocjenjivanje i podrška zaposlenicima prodavaonice.
  • Dogovaranje, organiziranje i delegiranje zadataka zaposlenicima.
  • Osmišljavanje i primjena metoda ocjenjivanja rada zaposlenika te plana poboljšanja učinka.
  • Odgovornost da se svi zadaci u prodavaonici provode sukladno hrvatskim zakonima.
  • Efikasno upravljanje fluktuacijom zaposlenika. Briga o pozitivnom radnom okruženju i odgovorno rješavanje svih relevantnih pitanja u adekvatnom roku.
  • Rješavanje reklamacija ili prigovora kupaca pronalaženjem optimalnih rješenja.
  • Briga o unutarnjem i vanjskom prodajnom prostoru prema standardima kompanije.
  • Maksimizacija produktivnosti, profitabilnosti i marže metodama upravljanja zaposlenicima.
  • Podrška zaposlenicima u preuzimanju odgovornosti za prodajne rezultate kao i u planovima razvitka karijere te praćenje plana.
  • Briga o vrhunskoj usluzi kupcima i podrška zaposlenicima u ostvarivanju visokog nivoa usluge.
  • Komunikacija, izvršavanje i upravljanje smjernicama marketinga i logistike.,
  • Održavanje redovitih sastanaka sa zaposlenicima,
  • Upoznavanje zaposlenika s važnosti zaštite na radu i postupaka evakuacije,
  • Održavanje i korištenje uređaja video nadzora,
  • Održavanje adekvatnih zaliha potrošnog materijala prodavaonice.
  • Održavanje razine stručnog i tehničkog znanja prisustvovanjem radionicama i pregledom stručnih publikacija,
  • Uspostavljanje osobnih mreža kontakata, sudjelovanje u profesionalnim udruženjima.
  • Upravljanje prihodom prodavaonice, uključujući odgovornost za gotovinski novac, provjeru i polaganje depozita u banku,
  • Izvršavanje i nadziranje provođenja programa prevencije manjka.
  • Upravljanje svim operativnim pitanjima prodavaonice, uključujući održavanje prostora, administraciju, inventure, promjene cijena i slično,
  • Ostali poslovi po nalogu poslodavca.

Uvjeti:

  • Izvrsno znanje engleskog jezika
  • Napredno poznavanje računala
  • Dobre komunikacijske vještine
  • Profesionalan stav
  • Dobra organizacija radnog vremena.
  • Održavanje, oplemenjivanje i posjedovanje «mentaliteta vlasništva».
  • Raspoloživost za poslovna putovanja nekoliko puta godišnje u skladu s potrebama prodavaonice.
  • Interes za modu
  • Proaktivnost i samoinicijativnost
  • Sklonost učenju i osobnom razvoju i rastu

jobs.title: POMOĆNI/A KUHAR/ICA
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 26. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (Narodne novine broj 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22 i 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 146/25, 22/26), Upravno vijeće Dječjeg vrtića „Savica“ raspisuje

NATJEČAJ ZA IZBOR POMOĆNI/A KUHAR/ICA 1 IZVRŠITELJ/ICA – rad na neodređeno vrijeme s punim radnim vremenom

Uvjeti: Uvjeti prema čl. 24. i čl. 26. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 146/25, 22/26) i Pravilniku o odgovarajućoj vrsti i razini obrazovanja odgojno-obrazovnih radnika u dječjem vrtiću, ustanovama te drugim pravnim i fizičkim osobama koje provode programe ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja (NN 145/24, 62/25-ispravak). Poslove pomoćnog/e kuhara/ice može obavljati osoba koja je završila: • kvalifikacija pomoćni kuhar razine 3, stečena završetkom strukovnog obrazovanja u trajanju od tri godine u sektoru Turizam i ugostiteljstvo. Za oglašena radna mjesta mogu se prijaviti osobe oba spola koje ispunjavaju propisane uvjete.

Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu na natječaj kandidat/kinja mora priložiti sljedeće dokumente u preslici: 1. životopis 2. dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi 3. dokaz o državljanstvu 4. dokaz o radnom stažu (elektronički zapis ili potvrda Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka HZMO) - ne starije od dana objave natječaja 5. potvrdu nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak za neko od kaznenih djela iz čl. 25. st. 1. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97,107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22,101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 146/25, 22/26) - ne starije od dana objave natječaja 6. potvrdu nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi prekršajni postupak za neko od prekršajnih djela iz čl. 25. st. 3. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 146/25, 22/26) - ne stariju od dana objave natječaja 7. potvrdu Hrvatskog zavoda za socijalni rad (prema mjestu stanovanja/prebivališta) da kandidatu nisu izrečene zaštitne mjere prema članku 25. st.10. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22,101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 146/25, 22/26) - ne stariju od dana objave natječaja. Osoba koja prema posebnim propisima ostvaruje pravo prednosti mora se u prijavi pozvati na to pravo, odnosno priložiti propisane dokaze o tom statusu.

Kandidati/kinje koji/e mogu ostvariti pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 102. Zakona o braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članova njihovih obitelji (NN 121/2017), članku 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (NN 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03 i 148/13), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (NN 157/13 i 152/14) i članku 22. Ustavnog Zakona o pravima nacionalnih manjina (NN 155/02, 47/10 – Odluka Ustavnog suda Republike Hrvatske, 80/10 i 93/11 – Odluka Ustavnog suda Republike Hrvatske), dužni su se u prijavi na natječaj pozvati na to pravo te imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Pozivaju se kandidati/kinje koji/e ostvaruju pravo na prednost pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim branitelja iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji, da uz prijavu na natječaj dostave dokaze o ostvarivanju prava prednosti iz članka 103. stavak 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN 121/17). Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva: https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843, a dodatne informacije o dokazima koji su potrebni u svrhu ostvarivanja prednosti pri zapošljavanju potražiti na sljedećoj poveznici: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/POPIS%20DOKAZA%20ZA%20OSTVARIVANJE%20PRAVA%20PRI%20ZAPO%C5%A0LJAVANJU.pdf

Kandidati/kinje koji/e se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom, uz prijavu na natječaj dužni su osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i rješenje o utvrđenom invaliditetu, odnosno drugu javnu ispravu o invaliditetu na temelju koje se osoba može upisati u očevidnik zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom te dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (rješenje, ugovor, sporazum i sl.).

Kandidati/kinje koji/e se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata, uz prijavu na natječaj dužni su osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti rješenje ili potvrdu o priznatom statusu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, izjavu da do sada nisu koristili pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju po toj osnovi te dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (rješenje, ugovor, sporazum i sl.). Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenom presliku, a prije izbora kandidata predočit će se izvornik. Kandidati/kinje koji/e podnesu potpunu i urednu prijavu i ispunjavaju formalne uvjete iz natječaja mogu biti pozvani na razgovor i/ili provjeru sposobnosti i vještina bitnih za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta.

Plaća za obavljeni rad radnika sastoji se od osnovne plaće i dodatka na plaću za rad u posebnim situacijama, ako su za tu namjenu osigurana posebna sredstva. Visina osnovice za obračun plaće i koeficijent složenosti poslova radnog mjesta određeni su Kolektivnim ugovorom za zaposlene u predškolskim ustanovama Grada Zagreba. Osnovica za obračun mjesečne plaće iznosi 1.075,94 eura bruto. Koeficijent složenosti poslova radnog mjesta pomoćnog kuhar/ice iznosi 1,22. Osnovna bruto plaća radnika za puno radno vrijeme predstavlja umnožak osnovice za obračun plaće i koeficijenta složenosti poslova radnog mjesta uvećan za iznos dodatka na radni staž koji se izračunava tako da se umnožak osnovice i koeficijenta složenosti poslova radnog mjesta pomnoži sa 0,5% za svaku navršenu godinu radnog staža. Urednom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u natječaju. Potpunom prijavom smatra se uredna i pravovremena prijava koja je vlastoručno potpisana. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravovremenu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz javnog natječaja ne smatra se kandidatom/kinjom prijavljenim/om na natječaj. Do donošenja odluke o izboru natječaj može biti poništen. Prijave na natječaj (vlastoručno potpisane) s popratnom dokumentacijom dostavljaju se osobno ili poštom na adresu: Dječji vrtić „Savica“, Ulica Vladimira Ruždjaka 7, 10 000 Zagreb, uz naznaku: „Za natječaj – pomoćni/a kuhar/ica, 1 izvršitelj/ica za rad na neodređeno vrijeme“. U skladu s Uredbom EU 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 27. 4. 2016. te Zakonom o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti osobnih podataka (Narodne novine, broj 42/18), prijavom na natječaj osoba daje privolu za prikupljanje i obradu podataka iz natječajne dokumentacije, a sve u svrhu provedbe natječaja za zapošljavanje. Rok za podnošenje prijava na natječaj iznosi osam (8) dana od dana objave natječaja. O rezultatima provedenog natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni u roku od osam (8) dana od dana donošenja odluke o odabiru kandidata na sjednici Upravnog vijeća Vrtića putem mrežne stranice Vrtića. Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnoj stranici i oglasnim pločama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje te mrežnoj stranici i oglasnim pločama Vrtića 6. 8. 2026. i traje do 14. 8. 2026.

jobs.title: Solution Specialist (German-speaking) - On-site - Cloud Solutions MT03 (Cloud-Architect)
jobs.description:
Experience the power of a game-changing career

Are you looking for what’s next? We’re a global technology and services leader that powers the brands of the future. We help well-known brands — the ones you use every day — improve their businesses with technology and integrated solutions, in over 70 countries.

If you’re looking to grow and be inspired, as a Solution Specialist in Malaga (on-site), you will be part of our team of game-changers who are powering the brands of the future in tech where you will drive the sales cycle, nurture client relationships and showcase your expertise in advanced cloud technologies.

Career growth and personal development

jobs.title: Global Supplier Quality Manager (m/w/d) (Supply-Chain-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Kelvion

Unsere Mission ist es, mit Innovationskraft und Nachhaltigkeit die industrielle Transformation voranzutreiben. Ob bei der Optimierung von Rechenzentren, der Weiterentwicklung der Wasserstoffproduktion oder der Neugestaltung von Kühl- und Klimatechniksystemen – unsere thermischen Schlüsseltechnologien stärken zahlreiche Branchen weltweit. Als „One Kelvion“ arbeiten wir kontinuierlich an Lösungen, die unsere Kunden noch erfolgreicher machen und gleichzeitig zu einer nachhaltigeren Zukunft beitragen.

Wir gestalten Zukunft – gemeinsam

Stellenbeschreibung

Ihre Aufgaben:

➢ Globale Supplier-Quality-Strategie: Definition und Umsetzung einer global ausgerichteten Supplier-Quality-Strategie im Einklang mit den Qualitätszielen, operativen Prioritäten und Wachstumsanforderungen von Kelvion.

➢ Standardisierung & Governance: Entwicklung, Einführung und Harmonisierung globaler Supplier-Quality-Prozesse über Produktionsstandorte, Regionen und Business Units hinweg.

➢ Lieferantenqualifizierung & -entwicklung: Aufbau durchgängiger Standards für Lieferantenqualifizierung, Onboarding, Audits, APQP, PPAP, Lieferantenänderungsmanagement, Wareneingangsqualität, Non-Conformance-Management, CAPA und Performance Monitoring.

➢ Supplier Performance Excellence: Durchführung und Steuerung von Lieferantenentwicklungs- und Recovery-Programmen zur Verbesserung von Qualität, Liefertreue, Prozessfähigkeit und nachhaltiger Lieferantenperformance.

➢ Präventive Qualitätsarbeit: Weiterentwicklung der Supplier-Quality-Organisation von einem reaktiven, prüfungsgetriebenen Ansatz hin zu einem präventiven, strukturierten und datenbasierten Qualitätsmodell.

➢ Problemlösung & kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Stärkung von Root-Cause-Analysen, 8D-Problemlösung, CAPA-Disziplin und nachhaltiger Umsetzung von Korrekturmaßnahmen innerhalb der Lieferantenbasis.

➢ KPI, Reporting & Transparenz: Definition von Supplier-Quality-KPIs, Reporting-Strukturen, Dashboards und Governance-Routinen zur Schaffung von Transparenz, Verbindlichkeit und kontinuierlicher Steuerung.

➢ Schnittstellenmanagement: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Procurement, Manufacturing, Engineering, Logistics, Operations sowie regionalen Quality-Teams zur frühzeitigen Identifikation und Reduzierung lieferantenbezogener Risiken.

➢ Audits & Compliance: Durchführung und Koordination von Lieferantenaudits, Prozessaudits, Performance Reviews und Benchmarking-Aktivitäten unter Berücksichtigung relevanter Kunden-, regulatorischer, Industrie- und Qualitätsmanagementanforderungen, insbesondere ISO 9001.

➢ Funktionale Führung: Fachliche Führung lokaler Supplier Quality Engineers und Förderung einer globalen Qualitätskultur, die auf Prävention, Verantwortung, kontinuierlicher Verbesserung und operativer Disziplin basiert.

Ihr Profil:

➢ Abgeschlossenes Masterstudium im Bereich Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung.

➢ Mindestens 6 Jahre Erfahrung im Supplier Quality Management, Manufacturing Quality oder Quality Management in einem industriellen Produktionsumfeld.

➢ Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Aufbau, in der Weiterentwicklung oder Harmonisierung von Supplier-Quality-Organisationen über Standorte, Regionen oder Business Units hinweg.

➢ Fundierte Expertise in Supplier Quality Management, Lieferantenentwicklung, Lieferantenaudits, Prozessaudits, Lieferantenqualifizierung und Performance Improvement.

➢ Praktische Erfahrung mit APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC, 8D, CAPA, Root Cause Analysis, Risikomanagement und Qualitätsmanagementsystemen.

➢ Erfahrung in globalen Produktions- und Lieferantenstrukturen; Erfahrung aus der Automobilindustrie oder einem vergleichbar reifen Qualitätsumfeld ist von Vorteil.

➢ Fähigkeit, in einer Matrixorganisation fachlich zu führen, Stakeholder über Funktionen und Regionen hinweg zu beeinflussen und globale Standards pragmatisch umzusetzen.

➢ Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse sowie Bereitschaft zu internationalen Reisen von ca. 30–50 %.

Unser Erfolg basiert auf Zusammenarbeit – wir fördern vielfältiges Denken, hören einander zu und schätzen jede einzelne Stimme. Kreativität entfaltet sich bei Kelvion dort, wo Menschen gehört, ihre Ideen willkommen geheißen und ihre Beiträge anerkannt werden.

Mit einem flexiblen Arbeitsansatz stellen wir das Wohlbefinden und die Zufriedenheit unserer Mitarbeitenden in den Mittelpunkt. Dies stärkt die Bereitschaft sich einzubringen und eröffnet damit neue Karrierechancen Wir ermutigen engagierte Persönlichkeiten ihre Entwicklung selbst in die Hand zu nehmen, neue Wege zu gehen und gemeinsam mit uns Zukunft zu gestalten.

Wir gestalten Zukunft – gemeinsam

English Version

Global Supplier Quality Manager (m/w/d)

Kelvion

Our mission is to lead the industrial transformation by championing innovation and sustainability. From optimising data centres and advancing hydrogen production to revolutionising refrigeration and HVAC systems, our mission-critical thermal solutions empower industries around the globe. United as “One Kelvion,” our global team delivers innovative solutions that drive customer success and support a sustainable future.

Together, We Shape the Future

Job Description

Your responsibilities:

➢ Global supplier quality strategy: Define and execute the global supplier quality strategy in line with Kelvion’s quality objectives, operational priorities and business growth requirements.

➢ Standardisation & governance: Develop, implement and harmonise global supplier quality processes across manufacturing sites, regions and business units.

➢ Supplier qualification & development: Establish end-to-end standards for supplier qualification, onboarding, audits, APQP, PPAP, supplier change management, incoming quality control, non-conformance management, CAPA and performance monitoring.

➢ Supplier performance excellence: Drive supplier development and recovery programmes to improve quality, delivery reliability, process capability and long-term supplier performance.

➢ Preventive quality approach: Further develop the supplier quality organisation from a reactive, incoming-inspection-driven approach towards a preventive, structured and data-driven quality model.

➢ Problem solving & continuous improvement: Strengthen root cause analysis, 8D problem solving, CAPA discipline and sustainable corrective action follow-up across the supplier base.

➢ KPIs, reporting & transparency: Define supplier quality KPIs, reporting structures, dashboards and governance routines to create transparency, accountability and continuous performance management.

➢ Stakeholder collaboration: Work closely with Procurement, Manufacturing, Engineering, Logistics, Operations and regional Quality teams to proactively identify and mitigate supplier-related risks.

➢ Audits & compliance: Conduct and coordinate supplier audits, process audits, performance reviews and benchmarking activities, ensuring compliance with customer, regulatory, industry and quality management system requirements, including ISO 9001.

➢ Functional leadership: Provide functional leadership to local Supplier Quality Engineers and strengthen a global quality culture focused on prevention, accountability, continuous improvement and operational discipline.

Your profile:

➢ Master’s degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain or a related technical discipline.

➢ At least 6 years of experience in Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Quality or Quality Management within an industrial manufacturing environment.

➢ Proven experience in building, developing or harmonising supplier quality organisations across sites, regions or business units.

➢ Strong expertise in supplier quality management, supplier development, supplier audits, process audits, supplier qualification and performance improvement.

➢ Practical experience with APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC, 8D, CAPA, root cause analysis, risk management and quality management systems.

➢ Experience in global manufacturing and supplier environments; experience in the automotive industry or a similarly mature quality environment is an advantage.

➢ Ability to lead functionally in a matrix organisation, influence stakeholders across functions and regions and implement global standards pragmatically.

➢ Fluent English skills and willingness to travel internationally, approximately 30–50 %.

At Kelvion we thrive on collaboration, embracing diversity of thought, and valuing every voice. Within Kelvion creativity shines because people are listened to, their contributions recognised, and their ideas welcomed. Our flexible approach to the way we work places people’s health and satisfaction as a priority, enhancing engagement and fostering career opportunities. We empower engaged individuals to grow, progress and carve their own paths within the company.

Together, We Shape the Future

We are recruiting for a skilled E-Bike Mechanic to join a growing urban mobility team in Paris. You will maintain, diagnose, and repair a fleet of electric bicycles and light electric vehicles, ensuring safe, reliable service for customers. This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on technician who enjoys troubleshooting electrical and mechanical systems in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

- Proven experience as a bicycle mechanic, ideally with specific experience repairing e-bikes or light electric vehicles.

- Competence with standard mechanical tools and workshop equipment, and experience with wheel truing, brake adjustment, and gear indexing.
- Fluent in French; good English is an advantage. Communication should be clear and customer-focused.
- Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Valid right to work in France and willingness to work occasional early starts or weekends as required by operations.
- Relevant vocational qualifications (e.g., cycle mechanic certificate, electrical or mechanical apprenticeship) are desirable but practical experience will be considered.

The Offer

- Permanent full-time contract based in Paris with competitive salary depending on experience.
- Paid training on company-specific e-bike systems and safety procedures.
- Comprehensive benefits package including health coverage contributions and transport allowances.
- Opportunity to work with a sustainable mobility provider and contribute to greener urban transport.
- Supportive, multicultural team environment and clear progression routes within operations and technical roles.
- Modern workshop facilities in Paris, with supplied tools and PPE.

jobs.title: ein wissenschaftlicher Referent / eine wissenschaftliche Referentin (m/w/d) (Archäologe/Archäologin)
jobs.description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Bauforscher*in

Stellenbeschreibung:
Gestalten Sie die Zukunft der internationalen Forschung

Das Deutsche Archäologische Institut (DAI) ist eine weltweit führende Forschungseinrichtung im Bereich der Archäologie und Altertumswissenschaften. Es ist dem Auswärtigen Amt, einer obersten Bundesbehörde, nachgeordnet und leistet an seinen insgesamt 20 Standorten europa- und weltweit einen wichtigen Beitrag zum Schutz und Erhalt sowie zur Vermittlung von kulturellem Erbe. Sie finden uns im Internet unter http://www.dainst.org (http://www.dainst.org) .

An der Abteilung Madrid des Deutschen Archäologischen Instituts (DAI) ist zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt die Stelle

eines wissenschaftlichen Referenten / einer wissenschaftlichen Referentin (m/w/d)

(Kennziffer: 08/2026)

in Vollzeit im Rahmen eines unbefristeten Beschäftigungs- bzw. Dienstverhältnisses. Eine Teilzeitbeschäftigung ist grundsätzlich möglich. Gehen entsprechende Bewerbungen ein, wird für den Arbeitsplatz geprüft, ob den Teilzeitwünschen im Rahmen der dienstlichen Möglichkeiten (insbesondere hinsichtlich der Anforderungen des Arbeitsplatzes und der gewünschten Gestaltung der Teilzeit) entsprochen werden kann.

Für Tarifbeschäftigte richtet sich das Entgelt beim Vorliegen der persönlichen Voraussetzungen bis Entgeltgruppe 13 TVöD Bund. Bei Vorliegen der laufbahn- und haushaltsrechtlichen Voraussetzungen besteht die Möglichkeit der Ernennung in das Beamtenverhältnis. Für Beamt*innen erfolgt die Besoldung bis Besoldungsgruppe A 13 BBesO. Bei Tarifbeschäftigten des Bundes sowie Beamtinnen und Beamten ist zunächst eine Abordnung mit dem Ziel der Versetzung zum DAI vorgesehen. Der Dienstort ist Madrid.

Das Arbeitsgebiet der Abteilung Madrid umfasst Spanien, Portugal und Marokko. Dieser geografische Raum bildet mit der Meerenge von Gibraltar eine zentrale Brücke zwischen Europa und Afrika sowie zwischen der Mittelmeerwelt und der Atlantikküste. Die Abteilung widmet sich der Erforschung von rund 7.000 Jahren Archäologie in diesen Kulturzonen, vom Neolithikum bis zum Beginn der Neuzeit. Seit ihrem Bestehen hat die Abteilung Madrid leistungsfähige Forschungsinfrastrukturen aufgebaut. Dazu zählen eine der größten archäologischen Fachbibliotheken der Iberischen Halbinsel mit mehr als 90.000 Bänden, umfangreiche Archiv- und Fototheksbestände sowie eine Forschungsstelle in Lissabon.

Aufgabenbeschreibung

Der Aufgabenbereich umfasst insbesondere:

- Entwicklung eigener Forschungsfragen im westlichen Mittelmeerraum (mit Fokus auf Austausch- und Entwicklungsprozesse zwischen Nordafrika und der Iberischen Halbinsel).
- Konzeption und Leitung eines eigenen Forschungsprojektes in Nordafrika (in Marokko und/oder Algerien).
- Leitung und Koordination des Forschungsdatenmanagements und des Archivs/Fotothek der Abteilung Capacity building und Netzwerkarbeit, z. B. Durchführung von Schulungen und/oder Summerschools und Mitwirkung in der Verbundforschung des DAI, (z. B. TANA-Netzwerk, TANMed).
- Eigenverantwortliche Budgetplanung und Mittelabrechnung für die betreuten Projekte und Arbeitsbereiche.
- Fachliche Leitung unterstellter Mitarbeiter sowie Anleitung von Hilfskräften und Praktikanten.
- Einwerbung von Drittmitteln.

Ihr Profil

Vorausgesetzt werden:

- Ein mit hervorragender Promotion abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium auf dem Gebiet der Archäologie (Ur- und Frühgeschichte/Vor- und Frühgeschichte, Klassischen Archäologie, Archäologie der römischen Provinzen, Spätantike und frühes Christentum/Christliche Archäologie) oder Bauforschung.
- Deutsch verhandlungssicher in Wort und Schrift (mind. Niveau C2).
- Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Forschungs- und/oder Feldforschungsprojekten in Nordafrika.
- Erfahrung im Bereich Forschungsdatenmanagement und/oder in der Arbeit mit wissenschaftlichen Archiven/Fototheken.
- Vorlage eines überzeugenden Konzeptes zu den wissenschaftlichen Perspektiven und Capacity building für die ersten drei Jahre der Anstellung.

Wir freuen uns über:

- Kenntnisse einer für den Forschungsraum relevanten Sprachen bzw. Bereitschaft zum Erlernen dieser Sprachen.
- Bereitschaft zur Koordinierung von Arbeitsgruppen, Kolloquien und Mitarbeit in internationalen Kooperationen.
- Bereitschaft zum aktiven Auslandsdienst, d. h. internationale Kontaktpflege in Spanien und Nordafrika, enge Zusammenarbeit mit den deutschen Auslandsvertretungen in den Gastländern, Teilnahme an institutseigenen Kolloquien, Tagungen usw.

Als Mitarbeiterin oder Mitarbeiter des DAI bringen Sie eine hohe Sensibilität für Gleichstellung und Antidiskriminierung mit. Sie verfügen über interkulturelle Kompetenz und sind in der Lage, mit Menschen unterschiedlicher Herkunft respektvoll und offen zu kommunizieren und zu kooperieren.

Ihre Vorteile:

Abwechslungsreiche und kulturnahe und Aufgaben

Sie arbeiten in einer national wie international angesehenen Forschungseinrichtung des Bundes, die die weltweite Forschung und Nachwuchsförderung, den Schutz von kulturellem Erbe sowie die kulturelle Verständigung und Zusammenarbeit zum Ziel hat.

Arbeitsplatzsicherheit

Auch in Krisenzeiten bieten wir Ihnen ein sicheres Beschäftigungsverhältnis im öffentlichen Dienst.

Flexibles und familienfreundliches Umfeld

Wir fördern eine gute Vereinbarkeit von Beruf, Familie und Pflege durch:

• flexible Arbeitszeiten (Rahmenarbeitszeit von 6:00 bis 22:00 Uhr)

• Gleitzeit mit Stundenausgleich (z. B. durch Gleittage)

• Möglichkeiten zur Teilzeit und mobilen Arbeit

• kostenfreien Familienservice mit Beratungs- und Vermittlungsangeboten.

Motivierendes Arbeitsumfeld

Unsere Zusammenarbeit ist geprägt von gegenseitigem Respekt, Vertrauen, flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Eigeninitiative, Mitgestaltung und kreative Ideen sind ausdrücklich erwünscht.

Entwicklungs- und Karriereperspektiven

Wir bieten Ihnen ein breites Spektrum an Fort- und Weiterbildungen sowie individuelle Maßnahmen zur Personalentwicklung.

Urlaubsregelung

Sie erhalten 30 Tage Erholungsurlaub (bei einer Teilzeitbeschäftigung wird der Urlaubsanspruch entsprechend der tariflichen/gesetzlichen Vorgaben gewährt). Zusätzlich besteht die Möglichkeit von Sonder- und Bildungsurlaub.

Mobilitätszuschuss

Sie erhalten bei einem Dienstort in Deutschland von uns einen Zuschuss zu einem ÖPNV-Ticket (DeutschlandJobTicket o.a.).

Betriebliche Gesundheitsförderung

Wir bieten eine Mitgliedschaft im Sozialwerk des Auswärtigen Amtes an und ermöglichen so den Zugang zu vergünstigten Freizeit- und Erholungsangeboten. Zusätzlich profitieren Sie von der Kooperation mit Wellhub und erhalten über diese Wellness-Plattform Zugang zu zahlreichen Fitness-Studios, Online-Kursen zu Themen wie z. B. Meditation oder Ernährung und weiteren Angeboten.

Interessenvertretungen

Ihre Interessen werden bei uns von den Personalräten, der Schwerbehindertenvertretung und der Gleichstellungsbeauftragten vertreten.

Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt?

Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung! Senden Sie Ihre Unterlagen (Motivationsschreiben, Lebenslauf, Ausbildungsnachweis, Arbeitszeugnisse etc.) bis zum

26.08.2026

in einer zusammengefassten PDF-Datei unter Angabe der Kennziffer 08/2026 an bewerbung@dainst.de. (https://mailto:bewerbung@dainst.de) Bitte fügen Sie Ihren Bewerbungsunterlagen weiterhin den auf der Homepage des DAI unter https://www.dainst.org/karriere/bewerben-am-dai (https://www.dainst.org/karriere/bewerben-am-dai) (Formularcenter) eingestellten Bewerbungsbogen „Wissenschaft“ ausgefüllt sowie, sofern Sie bereits im öffentlichen Dienst tätig sind, eine Einverständniserklärung zur Einsicht in Ihre Personalakte bei.

Wir bitten um Verständnis, dass wir nur vollständige Bewerbungen berücksichtigen können.

Haben Sie noch Fragen zu unserem Stellenangebot?

Dann kontaktieren Sie uns für weitere Auskünfte. Schreiben Sie eine E-Mail an bewerbung@dainst.de oder rufen Sie Herrn Sternbeck unter 030/187711-295 an. Für fachliche Fragen wenden Sie sich bitte an Paul Scheding, Leitender Direktor der Abteilung Madrid, E-Mail: paul.scheding@dainst.de.

Weitere Hinweise:

Bewerber*innen (m/w/d) mit Schwerbehinderung oder diesen gleichgestellte Personen werden bei gleicher Eignung entsprechend den gesetzlichen Grundlagen bevorzugt berücksichtigt.

Das DAI gewährleistet gemäß BGleiG die berufliche Gleichstellung unabhängig vom Geschlecht und unterstützt die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie, indem flexible Arbeitszeiten gelebt und Teilzeitmodelle im Rahmen der dienstlichen Möglichkeiten realisiert werden.

Vielfalt ist einer unserer zentralen Organisationswerte. Deshalb begrüßen wir Bewerbungen unabhängig von Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion und Weltanschauung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.

Im Zusammenhang mit Ihrer Bewerbung behandeln wir Ihre personenbezogenen Daten mit größter Sorgfalt und Diskretion. Unsere Datenschutzinformation finden Sie auf unserer Webseite unter www.dainst.org/datenschutz (http://www.dainst.org/datenschutz) . Diese informiert Sie gemäß Art. 13 DSGVO über den Umfang und die Art und Weise der Verarbeitung sowie über Ihre diesbezüglichen Rechte.

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Zwingend erforderlich: Forschung, Archäologie, Ausgrabungen, Quellenmaterial auswerten (Geschichte)

jobs.title: CFD Software Developer (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description:
CFD Software Engineer (f/m/d)
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the
world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation—helping innovative
global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a
large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together
while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages
creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our
business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.
Position Overview
Are you a passionate Software Engineer who enjoys working at
the intersection of numerical methods, high-performance computing, and
real-world engineering applications? We are searching for a talented CFD
Software Engineer to join our solver development team for Simcenter Ultrafluid (formerly Altair ultraFluidX, https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/) ), a small, dynamic, and agile team delivering world-class CFD software to
industries including automotive, heavy industry, and consumer electronics.
Simcenter Ultrafluid features a native GPU-based
implementation of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM), allowing users to run
fully transient, high-fidelity aerodynamics and aeroacoustics simulations
overnight on a single compute server. The solver is designed to handle complex
geometries and demanding industrial use cases, delivering high-fidelity,
predictive simulations of real engineering processes, including turbulent
flows, thermal transport, and complex geometry handling.
If you are seeking a role where you can contribute directly
to solver development, algorithm implementation, and GPU acceleration, while
translating cutting-edge academic research in numerical methods into a
high-performance, easy-to-use software product, and collaborating closely with
the whole development team on the advancement of the code and its capabilities,
then we'd love to hear from you!
Responsibilities

- Contribute
to the code development of Simcenter Ultrafluid as part of the agile
development team
- Specify,
implement, test, and document new high-quality features of the solver in
close collaboration with the other team members
- Contribute
to performance benchmarking and code optimization in a massively parallel
GPU environment, while collaborating with other development teams across
HPC, pre/post-processing, and meshing to integrate Simcenter Ultrafluid
into the broader Simcenter ecosystem
- Collaborate
with product management, application specialists, and QA engineers to
ensure the solver meets real-world industrial needs
- Participate
in daily stand-ups as well as regular review, retrospective, and planning
meetings

Required Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience

- M.Sc.
or Ph.D. degree in mechanical engineering, computational mechanics,
computer science, or a comparable physics-based discipline
- At
least two years of hands-on experience in CFD solver development in a
commercial or academic environment
- High
proficiency in C++ and parallel programming
- Excellent
English communication skills
- Passion
for numerical simulation and a drive to find creative solutions for
challenging industrial use cases with a focus on customer value
- Willingness
to work in a close-knit, agile development team

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience
with scripting or scientific programming languages such as Python or Julia
- Solid
understanding of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM) and its application in
CFD
- Solid
understanding of GPU architectures and experience with the CUDA toolkit

Why us?
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by
default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than
200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through
real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale
and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and
inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring you curiosity
and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Hyderabad Infra team builds and maintains Notion's internal async task runner and configuration management platform. The async task runner plays a critical role in ensuring our millions of users have a fast, reliable, and secure experience. The configuration management platform enables safe, explicit configuration management for Notion's product and infrastructure engineers.



As part of the Hyderabad Infra Team, you’ll have a unique opportunity to shape how Notion manages and scales its async task runner and configuration management platform, enabling innovation across the company.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - You will contribute to the evolution and maintenance of our async task runner to meet the needs of over 100 million global users and support the rapid growth of our product and business. 

 - With guidance from senior team members, you'll help ensure our systems remain reliable, efficient, and scalable. You'll evaluate and integrate new technologies to keep us ahead of emerging challenges. 

 - Your work will empower our engineering team to build features confidently while you grow your skills in distributed systems and infrastructure.

 - You will develop the skills and confidence to debug live production systems with minimal disruption, whether replacing components or managing failovers. You will participate in an on-call rotation, responding to incidents to uphold service reliability and quickly restore normal operations.

 - You will partner with product engineers and other infra teams to ensure our platforms align with evolving business needs and product goals.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - A software developer with at least 4 years of experience and the ability to perform well in a fast-paced environment.

 - Systems thinker: You understand distributed systems and can design solutions that account for tradeoffs like consistency, latency, and scalability.

 - Pragmatic problem-solver: You prioritize business impact and understand the balance between craft, speed, and long-term maintainability. You’re opinionated but not ideological, and you learn new technologies as you go.

 - Ownership and initiative: You thrive in a fast-moving, unstructured environment and are comfortable taking ownership of ambiguous problems. You act with a bias toward action and focus on results.

 - Customer Empathy: You excel at collaborating across teams, offering guidance and solutions to unblock engineers and support them in building reliable systems. With empathy at the core of your approach, you focus on addressing the needs of those who depend on the async task runner.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

Senior Etch Process Engineer  
Focuslight Switzerland is one of the leading manufacturers of high\-end micro\-optics. We have more than 20 years of experience in the fields of optical design, micro manufacturing, and metrology. Our micro\-optical components meet the highest requirements for applications in photolithography, optical networks, medicine, and metrology. To allow us to integrate last generation technology faster we are looking for a  
Senior Etch Process Engineer  
The position will be a subject matter expert on etched optics at the corporate research and development level. The Senior Etch Process Engineer will lead hands\-on development and manufacturing of high\-performance etched optics within state\-of\-the\-art cleanroom facilities. The candidate will participate in and has the opportunity to take ownership of establishing a new pilot product line, contribute to strategic R\&D initiatives, and strengthen Focuslight’s etched optics capabilities to expand and enhance the company’s product portfolio. One main task here is to transform conceptual optical designs into functional, manufacturable products by advancing the etch optics processing capabilities, while implementing robust quality control measures throughout the process. This role offers a unique opportunity to grow into an influential leader at Focuslight by strengthening Focuslight’s competitiveness in the global etched optics market.  
Job Responsibility  
In more detail the Senior Etch Process Engineer should,  
Lead the development and fabrication of high\-end etched optics products on the pilot production line.  
Design, develop, and validate process flows tailored to optical product requirements, ensuring manufacturability and performance.  
Drive the full product lifecycle—from conceptual optical design to functional product.  
Work with the production team as one team to resolve process issues in mass production and implement new processing capabilities developed on the pilot line to improve product optical performance or reduce production costs.  
Strategically leverage global internal and external resources to deliver competitive optical solutions in a fast\-paced market, with a strong focus on rapid and successful execution.  
Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation to support process development, product qualification, and knowledge transfer.  
Provide hands\-on support for R\&D activities in Focuslight’s cleanroom facility in Hauterive, contributing to innovation and continuous improvement.  
Build and manage a new product pilot line bridging R\&D development and production.  
Key Competences  
Have the ideas, methodology, and ownership needed to build the team and capabilities to become the best in etched\-optics production.  
Have a “fail fast, fail cheap” mindset to quickly identify the optimal solution.  
Goal\-oriented and self\-driven, with a strong sense of commitment and accountability.  
Proactive and innovative mindset, consistently seeking improvements and new solutions.  
Excellent technical and analytical skills, with the ability to understand and solve complex problems.  
Experienced in collaborative project environments, integrating diverse competencies.  
Capable of planning and executing experiments that combine multiple technology platforms.  
Professional skills  
, , or in Microtechnology, Physics, Optics, Electrical Engineering, or related fields.  
Practical industrial experience in the microfabrication of etched silicon and fused silica lenses, with required expertise in dry etching and photolithography.  
In\-depth theoretical knowledge of micro\- and nanofabrication technologies.

jobs.title: Director, Global Commodity Management & Analytics
jobs.description:
Ready to make your next big professional move? Join us on our journey to achieve our big dream of building the most loved restaurant brands in the world.  

Restaurant Brands International Inc. is one of the world's largest quick service restaurant companies with nearly $45 billion in annual system-wide sales and over 32,000 restaurants in more than 120 countries and territories.

RBI owns four of the world's most prominent and iconic quick service restaurant brands – TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES®, and FIREHOUSE SUBS®. These independently operated brands have been serving their respective guests, franchisees and communities for decades. Through its Restaurant Brands for Good framework, RBI is improving sustainable outcomes related to its food, the planet, and people and communities.

RBI is committed to growing the TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES® and FIREHOUSE SUBS® brands by leveraging their respective core values, employee and franchisee relationships, and long track records of community support. Each brand benefits from the global scale and shared best practices that come from ownership by Restaurant Brands International Inc.

RBI’s Global Commodities & Intelligence Centre of Excellence

RBI is strengthening its global procurement organization by establishing a Global Commodities & Intelligence Centre of Excellence (CoE).

The CoE will provide commodity intelligence, data, risk management, and commercial decision support to procurement teams across RBI’s brands and markets. It will act as the analytical backbone of the global procurement function, helping regional teams make faster, data-driven sourcing and negotiation decisions.

Our Opportunity:

The Director, Global Commodity Management & Analytics will build and lead RBI’s newly established CoE, including its operating model, governance, analytical capabilities, tools, and team.

This is a newly created global role for a commercially minded commodity leader with deep market expertise, strong negotiation experience, advanced analytical capabilities, and an interest in using AI and data to improve procurement decisions.

The role will focus primarily on the following direct commodity categories:

Sugar, Wheat, Soy, Corn, Pork, Beef, Chicken, Paperboard, and Potatoes

The CoE will own market intelligence, forecasting, cost modelling, risk management, sourcing strategy, and upstream commercial negotiations for these categories, depending on the market.

The role will also provide advisory intelligence and risk support for selected indirect categories, including metals, steel, engineering, energy, maintenance, repair and operations, and industrial gases.

The CoE will lead or support negotiations for upstream raw materials, including raw meat cuts, agricultural commodities, and packaging feedstocks.

RBI follows a five-day, in-office work schedule to support collaboration. Candidates should be comfortable working onsite five days per week.

Your Roles & Responsibilities:

Build and lead the Global Commodities & Intelligence CoE, establishing its operating model, governance, team structure, priorities, and ways of working with regional and global procurement teams.
Define RBI’s global commodity intelligence strategy, including frameworks for market monitoring, price forecasting, risk assessment, scenario planning, and procurement timing recommendations.
Develop and deploy AI-enabled intelligence capabilities, including forecasting models, real-time market monitoring, should-cost tools, scenario analysis, and executive risk dashboards.
Own RBI’s global commodity risk management strategy, covering forward contracting, index-linked pricing, supplier diversification, pooling opportunities, hedging considerations, and spot, forward, and long-term supply arrangements.
Lead upstream commodity negotiations across the direct category portfolio, from market analysis and strategy development through to supplier engagement and commercial execution, as appropriate by market.
Lead RBI’s Global Contingency and Risk Management Programme, including supply-chain stress testing, inventory and business-continuity planning, geopolitical and weather-risk analysis, reporting, and executive escalation.
Establish global should-cost models, cost benchmarks, and pricing mechanisms that help procurement teams validate supplier proposals and strengthen sourcing and negotiation decisions.
Manage external commodity consultancies, market-data providers, and intelligence platforms, while building an integrated and scalable data infrastructure across markets and functions.
Act as RBI’s global commodity intelligence leader, delivering market outlooks, cost-impact analysis, sourcing recommendations, and executive briefings to senior procurement, finance, and brand leaders.
Partner with Procurement, Finance, Treasury, Supply Chain, Operations, R&D, Quality Assurance, Sustainability, and Brand teams to deliver cost savings, cost avoidance, supply resilience, responsible sourcing, and stronger procurement governance.

Your skills & experience:

10+ years of progressive experience in global commodity procurement, trading, supply chain risk management, or commodity market intelligence within a large-scale FMCG, food service, QSR, or agri-food business.
Demonstrable expertise across at least three of the nine Direct categories; proven track record of executing upstream raw commodity negotiations at significant scale, including proteins (Beef, Chicken, Pork), grains, oilseeds, or packaging feedstocks.
Strong working knowledge of commodity markets, exchange mechanics (CME, CBOT, ICE), financial risk instruments (futures, options, swaps), and price risk management frameworks.
Proven experience deploying or commissioning AI, machine learning, or advanced analytics tools for commodity forecasting, market monitoring, or procurement decision support.
Experience building or leading a Centre of Excellence, intelligence function, or data capability within a complex global organization.
Track record of managing external consultancies, market data vendors, and analytics platform relationships at enterprise scale.
Experience operating within global matrixed organizations with multiple brands, procurement cooperatives, or franchise networks; able to influence without direct authority across regional structures.
Strong commercial acumen with the ability to translate commodity market dynamics into clear business recommendations and financial impact models.
Excellent communicator and executive presence; comfortable presenting to C-suite and Board-level audiences.
Fluent in English; additional languages (French, German, Spanish, Portuguese) are an asset.

We are looking for:

A seasoned commodity professional who can build and lead a high-impact global intelligence function while also owning the commercial execution of RBI’s upstream raw commodity portfolio. You operate at the intersection of markets, data, and strategy. You are as comfortable at the negotiating table as you are presenting a risk scenario to the Board. You influence regional teams through the quality of your intelligence and the rigor of your commercial outcomes. You are energized by complexity, clarity, and building things that others depend on.

Operate and maintain physical server and storage infrastructure across Intellico’s colocation sites

Support Cisco networks, Palo Alto firewalls, VPNs and general connectivity troubleshooting  
Administer Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory and Exchange Online  
Support employee devices, office infrastructure, Wi\-Fi, telephony and meeting\-room equipment where required

Requirements  
Practical experience with Linux system administration and server infrastructure  
Experience with virtualization platforms such as Proxmox, VMware or comparable technologies  
Understanding of storage technologies, preferably Ceph, ZFS or distributed storage systems  
Good knowledge of server hardware, operating\-system installation, patching and monitoring  
Understanding of backup, restore, high availability and disaster\-recovery concepts  
Good knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, NTP and general network services

Informatiker/in EFZ, Fachrichtung Plattformentwicklung

What We Offer  
A broad technical role with direct access to data\-center infrastructure, networking, virtualization and corporate IT  
The possibility to gradually develop into a systems, network, security or platform specialization  
Meaningful responsibility in a small team without unnecessary organizational layers

jobs.title: Production Designer
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

We’re looking for a Designer with strong visual taste to help scale Linear’s creative work across web, brand, and marketing. You’ll create polished, high-quality designs across a wide range of surfaces — from landing pages and ad campaigns to sales decks and launch materials — helping bring Linear’s visual language to life everywhere people experience our brand.

When it comes to design, we’re looking to work with people who can pick up any problem and solve it. For us, it’s both how it works and how it looks. At its core, Linear is a developer tool where speed, interactions, and small details matter. We expect a broad set of design skills and the ability to create high-quality designs, interactions, and prototypes.

In this role, you will help communicate Linear's story (what we're building and why it matters) as part of our internal creative agency: the Magic Team.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company. This role is open to candidates based in North American or European time zones. You can work from anywhere within those regions. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you'll do

 - Work with Marketing to design landing pages, ad campaigns, sales decks, and launch materials

 - Partner with the Magic Team to extend and scale Linear’s visual language across new campaigns and creative surfaces

 - Collaborate with designers, developers, and copywriters to create cohesive marketing experiences across web, social, and brand

What we're looking for

 - Around 2+ years of experience designing for web, marketing, or brand.

 - Excellent visual, UI, motion and interactive design skills

 - Eye for good design, attention to detail, and a genuine love for the craft

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Learn how we think and work
