jobs.title: (Junior) Structurer Capital Markets (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
At Raiffeisen Bank International, we are pleased to have more than 17 million customers in Austria and 12 other CEE countries - what got us here, are our talented people. 1 (Junior) Structurer Capital Markets (f/m/x)

We are seeking a highly motivated Structurer with a focus on corporate clients to join our innovative Data & Solutions team within the Capital Markets division. In this exciting role, you will contribute to the development of tailor-made solutions that help corporate clients effectively hedge interest rate and foreign exchange risks. Whether you are an early-career professional looking to grow or already have relevant experience in financial markets, this is an excellent opportunity to further develop your expertise in a dynamic and international environment. If you are passionate about financial markets and enjoy creating customized strategies, we want to hear from you.

Your mission:

* Develop and structure fixed income and foreign exchange (FX) derivatives for clients.

* Analyze market trends, economic data, and corporate balance sheets to create tailor-made solutions.

* Design and implement hedging strategies for interest rate and currency risks.

* Prepare detailed presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal risk management policies.

* Provide ongoing support and advice to clients on structured products and market developments.

* Collaborate with various teams to ensure seamless execution of deals and integrate market insights into product development.

Your core competencies:

* Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, or a related field.

* Skilled and enthusiastic in creating client pitches and presentations.

* Solid understanding of fixed income and FX markets.

* Proficiency in derivatives (interest rate and FX), including swaps, cross-currency swaps, caps & floors, FX forwards, FX swaps, and options.

* Excellent communication and presentation skills.

* Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet tight deadlines.

* Understanding of balance sheets, where knowledge of IFRS 9 and hedge accounting is a plus.

What's in it for you:

* Global community: 75+ nationalities, English as the company language, and work permit support.

* Career growth: We believe in continuous learning and proactive career development. Take on challenging work that stretches your abilities, attend trainings, and use new technologies to make a lasting impact.

* Stay healthy: Subsidized canteen, well-being programs, check-ups, and sport allowances.

* Save money: Discounts, exclusive banking terms, and a heavily subsidized public transport pass.

* Family support: Child allowances, gender-neutral parental leave, bilingual company kindergarten, and holiday childcare.

* Competitive salary: In accordance with Austrian legal requirements, the minimum salary for this position is EUR 2981,98 gross per month under the applicable Banking Collective Agreement. The actual salary is typically higher and will be determined individually based on your qualifications, professional experience, and the specific requirements of the role.

Gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsleitung gestaltest du eine zukunftssichere CRM-Infrastruktur, treibst Projekte eigenverantwortlich voran und befähigst unsere Sales-, Marketing- und Customer-Success-Teams durch smartes Enablement, das volle Potenzial unserer Systeme und Daten auszuschöpfen.

¿ HubSpot-Core-Management: Du übernimmst die Konfiguration, Bereitstellung und das fortlaufende Management unseres HubSpot CRM-Systems entlang der gesamten Customer Journey von Lead bis Retention.

jobs.description:

Duration of employment: 1st of October 2026, limited to 30th of September 2030
Workplace: 1190 Vienna

B1
Gross monthly salary: (depending on previous eligible experience) at least: € 3.776,10
(payable 14 times per year)


PhD Position in Forest Regeneration and Nutrient Dynamics
Tree regeneration success is a key determinant of forest resilience and long-term ecosystem
stability. While light availability has been widely studied as a driver of regeneration dynamics,
the role of the forest floor as a regulator of nutrient supply to seedlings has received far less
attention. The Forest floor is the interface between the above- and below-ground parts of forest
ecosystems. It serves as a seedbed and rooting zone for vegetation, and acts as a hub of the
ecosystem where organic matter, nutrients and water are stored, absorbed, and transformed.
In the context of climate change, the Forest floor and its associated ecosystem services appear
as particularly at risk. As part of the research group "Humus layer: Function, dynamics and
vulnerability in transition" (https://gepris.dfg.de/project/457330647), the goal of our project is
to investigate how forest floor characteristics, root and mycorrhizal connectivity to mature
trees, and drought jointly regulate nutrient availability and regeneration performance. For more
information, please contact: emilie.fleurot@boku.ac.at.


Responsibilities
º Conducting lab work (measurement of soil and leaf nutrient concentration,
measurement of 15N concentration, ...)
º Conducting 2 weeks of field work per year in Germany (collecting leaf and soil
samples, measuring the condition and height of the plants)
º Conducting 1 week of fieldwork in an old growth forest (Rothwald) (mapping of forest
soil properties)
º Performing data analysis and writing scientific publications
º Writing and defending a doctoral thesis is desired
Required skills and qualifications


º Diploma degree in MSc ecology, biology, forestry or other equivalent university degree
º Language skills: Strong proficiency in English, both written and verbal
º Training and experience in statistical analysis and the R software
º Experience in field work and motivation to work under harsh conditions
º Experience in scientific writing


Desirable skills and qualifications
º Background in forest ecology and/or soil biology
º Highly motivated candidate with strong analytical and problem-solving skills and the
ability to work independently and as part of a team
º Driving licence type B
º Ability to perform fieldwork in adverse conditions
º Laboratory experiment, preferably with stable isotopes


Applications can be submitted until: 21st of August 2026


University of Natural Resources and Life Sciences Vienna seeks to increase the number of its
female faculty and staff members. Therefore qualified women are strongly encouraged to
apply. In case of equal qualification, female candidates will be given preference unless
reasons specific to an individual male candidate tilt the balance in his favour.


People with disabilities and appropriate qualifications are specifically encouraged to apply.
Please send your job application incl.
º motivation letter

º Two references [letters] will be required during the second stage of the selection
process
to HR Management, BOKU University, Peter-Jordan-Straße 70, 1190 Vienna;
E-Mail: recruiting@boku.ac.at. (Reference code: 151)
We regret that we cannot reimburse applicants travel and lodging expenses incurred as part of

Du wartest, prüfst und reparierst unsere Geräte und Baugruppen. Du analysierst Fehler, tauschst Komponenten, programmierst Platinen und kontrollierst, ob danach wieder alles so funktioniert, wie es

jobs.title: Senior Expert Innovation Management, all genders
jobs.description:
1 Senior Expert Innovation Management, all genders Your responsibilities:
Innovation Strategy & Business Development

* You will identify and evaluate emerging technologies, market trends, and business opportunities with a focus on media, streaming, cloud, and digital platforms.
* You will proactively drive new innovation initiatives, develop strategic partnerships, and explore disruptive business models for Big Blue Marble.
* You will translate innovative ideas into concrete business opportunities by initiating and managing pilot projects, prototypes, and Proofs of Concept (PoCs).
* You will contribute to strategic R&D initiatives and innovation projects together with internal teams and external partners.

Innovation Lab & Stakeholder Coordination

* You will coordinate the Big Blue Marble Innovation Lab, organize sprint planning, and align priorities with Product Owners, technical teams, and business stakeholders.
* You will ensure the successful execution of innovation initiatives by driving collaboration, removing roadblocks, and maintaining transparency across projects.
* You will actively contribute yourself where needed-whether by preparing concepts, validating technologies, coordinating partners, or supporting technical discussions.

Innovation Ecosystem & Knowledge Sharing

* You will build and maintain relationships with research institutions, universities, startups, industry associations, and technology partners.
* You will represent Big Blue Marble at conferences, trade fairs, workshops, and industry events while identifying new collaboration opportunities.
* You will prepare presentations, market analyses, technical reports, and strategic recommendations and promote knowledge sharing across the organization.

Your skills that inspire us:
* Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Industrial Engineering, Telecommunications, or a comparable technical discipline.
* Minimum of 5 years of professional experience, including at least 3 years in Business Development, Innovation Management, Technology Strategy, Product Management, or a comparable role.
* Strong understanding of emerging technologies, digital platforms, cloud computing, media technologies, streaming, or telecommunications.
* Experience driving innovation projects, pilot implementations, Proofs of Concept, or research initiatives from idea to execution.
* Familiarity with agile methodologies and coordinating cross-functional teams.
Interest in AI trends and AI-assisted software development, with the ability to assess their business and technological impact.
* You are a proactive, hands-on self-starter who enjoys taking ownership, driving initiatives independently, and transforming innovative ideas into tangible business outcomes.
* Strong analytical thinking, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
* Fluent German (C1/C2) and English language skills at a minimum of B2 level are mandatory.

Remote work
Good communication and direct cooperation are very important to us. You can work from home, from the modern office or hybrid. In practice, this means that, according to your preferences, you will benefit from working remotely or from an office in Vienna with a great location and a cool atmosphere. We are happy to talk about the details in a meeting.

Travel

This position includes occasional national and international business travel, with an expected travel commitment of up to four weeks per year, primarily for conferences, trade fairs, workshops, partner meetings, and industry events.
For legal reasons, we are required to state the minimum salary as per the collective agreement. For this position, it is € 3.523,02 gross/month (Qualification Group 4, Specialist Level, Telekom collective agreement 2026, full-time).

jobs.title: Head Chef / Ravintolatoiminnasta vastaava
jobs.description:
**Tehtävän kuvaus**

Haemme North Resort Oy:lle Head Chefia vastaamaan keittiötoiminnan kokonaisuudesta. Tehtävässä vastaat keittiön johtamisesta, henkilöstöstä, laadusta, kannattavuudesta ja turvallisuudesta sekä kehität ravintolapalveluja osana kansainvälistä matkailukeskusta.

**Keskeiset työtehtävät**

- Keittiön päivittäinen johtaminen, keittiöhenkilöstön esihenkilötyö ja päivittäiseen keittiötoimintaan osallistuminen

- Työvuorosuunnittelu ja henkilöstöresurssien organisointi.

- Hankinnat, toimittajayhteistyö ja varaston hallinta.

- Ruokalistojen suunnittelu ja kehittäminen North Resortin strategian mukaisesti

- Katelaskenta, kustannusseuranta ja kannattavuuden kehittäminen.

- Omavalvonta, elintarviketurvallisuus, työturvallisuus ja laadunvalvonta.

- Juomavalikoiman suunnittelu yhteistyössä Resort Managerin kanssa.

- Raportointi Resort Managerille


**Odotamme hakijalta**

- Soveltuvaa koulutusta ja kokemusta ravintolan keittiötoiminnan johtamisesta.

- Esihenkilökokemusta ja hyviä organisointitaitoja.

- Voimassa olevaa hygieniapassia.

- Mahdollisia muita tehtävän edellyttämiä lakisääteisiä pätevyyksiä ja lupia.

- Omavalvonnan, elintarvikelainsäädännön ja työturvallisuusmääräysten hyvää tuntemusta.

- Sujuvaa englannin kielen taitoa; muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi.


**Tarjoamme**

- Mahdollisuuden rakentaa uuden kansainvälisen matkailukohteen ravintolatoimintaa.

- Monipuolisen ja vastuullisen johtamistehtävän.

- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa ravintolan ruoka- ja juomakonseptien kehittämiseen.

- Ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön ja nykyaikaisen työympäristön.


**Työsuhteen ehdot**

- Työsuhde on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva tai määräaikainen tehtävän mukaan.

- Työaika määräytyy työvuoroluettelon mukaisesti.

- Työsuhteessa noudatetaan Matkailu-, ravintola- ja vapaa-ajan palveluita koskevaa työehtosopimusta (MaRa TES).

- Työsuhteessa sovelletaan 6 kuukauden koeaikaa työsopimuslain ja työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti.

- Palkka määräytyy osaamisen, kokemuksen sekä MaRa TES:n mukaisesti.

- Valitun henkilön tulee ennen työsuhteen alkamista toimittaa hyväksyttävä lääkärintodistus terveydentilastaan.

jobs.description:
Tööülesanded: *Õppe- ja kasvatustöö igapäevane juhtimine ning arendamine.
*Õpetajate professionaalse arengu toetamine, nõustamine ja innustamine. *Õppetöö kvaliteedi tagamine ning õppeprotsessi planeerimine, analüüsimine ja arendamine. *Õppekava arendamise ja rakendamise koordineerimine. *Koostöö õpetajate, tugispetsialistide, õpilaste, lapsevanemate ja koolipidajaga. *Kooli arengueesmärkide elluviimisse panustamine ning kaasaegse ja toetava õpikeskkonna kujundamine. *Õppekorraldust puudutava dokumentatsiooni koostamine ja õigusaktide järgimise tagamine.

Omalt poolt pakume: *Võimalust kujundada oma tööd, juhtida õppevaldkonna arengut ja panustada Kallavere Keskkooli tuleviku kujundamisse.
*Võimalust olla osa toetavast ja kokkuhoidvast kooliperest. *Kaasaegset töökeskkonda ning võimalust viia ellu oma ideid ja algatusi. *Mitmekülgseid erialase arengu ja täienduskoolituse võimalusi. *Toetavat sisseelamist ning koostöövalmis meeskonda. *Kuni 5 tasustatud tervisepäeva aastas. *Kooli spordirajatiste tasuta kasutamise võimalust. *Võimalust panustada kooli väärtuste, õpikeskkonna ja koostöökultuuri arendamisse. Tutvu lähemalt meie väärtuspakkumisega: https://kallavere.ee/meie-vaartuspakkumine/

Muud nõuded: *Magistrikraadi või sellele vastavat kvalifikatsiooni ning õpetajakutset.
*Juhtimiskompetentse ja võimekust juhtida ning arendada õppe- ja kasvatustööd. *Väga head eesti keele oskust (C1-tase). *Teadmisi haridusvaldkonda reguleerivatest õigusaktidest, hariduskorraldusest ja tugisüsteemidest. *Head analüüsi- ja planeerimisoskust, algatusvõimet ning valmisolekut uuendusteks. *Väga head suhtlemis- ja koostööoskust ning oskust toetada ja motiveerida meeskonda. *Väga head arvutikasutamise ja digivahendite rakendamise oskust.

Tööülesanded: Otsime Pesumaja teenindajat!
Kas oled korrektne, enesekindel ja naudid puhtuse loomist? Otsime oma meeskonda asjatundlikku töötajat, kes ei karda vastutust ja suudab hoida häid kliendisuhteid ka nõudlikes olukordades. Peamised ülesanded: Kliendinõustamine Rõivaste vastuvõtt ja hooldusmärkide lugemine. Oluline on suutlikkus selgitada kliendile reaalseid tulemusi - puhastame kantud riideid, mitte ei uuenda neid. Puhastus - viimistlus: Pesemine, keemiline puhastus ja korrektne triikimine - aurutamine. Kvaliteedi tagamine: Iga eseme hoolikas kontroll ja korrektne väljastus.

Põhjalikku kohapealset väljaõpet ja stabiilset töökeskkonda. Toetavat meeskonda, kes hindab Sinu panust ja ausat tagasisidet. Kandideeri, kui soovid teha väärtuslikku tööd ja oled valmis päriselt panustama!

Muud nõuded: Ootame Sinult:
Väga head eesti keelt - see on vajalik programmide mõistmiseks kui ka selgeks suhtluseks klientidega. Enesekindlust ja ausust - julgust hinnata plekke ja materjale ning juhtida kliendi ootusi professionaalselt. Täpsus - kohusetundlikku suhtumist tehnoloogiasse ja detailidesse. * Kasuks tuleb enesekindlus, täpsus, organiseeritus, kohusetunne ja korrektsus töös. * Meeldib töötada kollektiivis, koostöövalmidus töökaaslastega arvestamisel, enese väljendusoskus. * Tuleb kasuks töökogemus erinevate pesutoodete viimistlemises, triikimises, pesumajas töötamise kogemus. * Tervislikud eluviisid, rõõmsameelne, aus, rutiinne töö, alkoholi probleemideta, peab kinni lubadustest ja tööajast.

jobs.title: Part-time Tea House Assistant
jobs.description:
We're looking for a part-time Tea House Assistant.

You'll be working directly with the owner in a small independent tea house. This is a hands-on role where you'll be involved in every part of the daily operation. There isn't a separate person for each task, so everyone helps wherever needed.

Your responsibilities

Your responsibilities may include:

- Preparing and serving tea using Gongfu brewing methods

- Introducing our teas and sharing basic tea knowledge with customers

- Helping customers choose teas and tea products

- Preparing tea drinks and desserts

- Operating the cashier and processing payments

- Handling takeaway and delivery orders independently

- Packing loose-leaf tea for retail sales

- Restocking products and organising inventory

- Washing dishes and maintaining a clean workspace

- Cleaning the shop

- Supporting other day-to-day operational tasks as needed


During busy periods, you'll often be serving customers, preparing drinks, handling takeaway and delivery orders, and managing multiple tasks at the same time. During quieter periods, you'll help with packing tea, restocking, cleaning, organising, and preparing the shop for the next rush.

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone who is:

- Friendly, reliable, and responsible

- Comfortable talking with customers

- Able to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment

- Comfortable multitasking and adapting to different responsibilities

- Proactive and able to work independently

- Interested in learning about tea and providing excellent customer service


Language requirements

- Fluent Finnish

- Good English

- Basic Chinese listening skills are a plus, but not required


Position

- Part-time

- Weekend and evening availability is preferred

- Full training will be provided


Before you apply

This is an independent tea house, not a large chain with separate roles for each employee. You'll be working directly with the owner, and the role requires flexibility, efficiency, and the ability to manage different responsibilities throughout the day. If you're looking for a position with only one fixed responsibility or prefer a slower-paced working environment, this role is unlikely to be the right fit.

If this sounds like the kind of work you enjoy, we'd love to hear from you.

Please send your CV and a short introduction to \[info@teetao.fi\].

As we're a small independent business, we're unfortunately unable to reply to every application individually. If your experience matches what we're looking for, we'll contact you within **two business days** to arrange the next step.

If you don't hear from us within two business days, it means we've decided to move forward with other applicants. We sincerely appreciate your interest and thank you for taking the time to apply.

jobs.description:
A Note from the Founder

Why Sticky is Free to Use

Hey â I'm Hamza Saleem, the solo developer behind Sticky.today.

In May 2026, I made a decision most SaaS founders won't make: I fired our payment processor and made Sticky completely free for everyone.

Here's why.

Software Should Be Free

Sticky started as a paid product. Pro plans, trials, subscriptions â the usual SaaS playbook. And it worked. People paid. But something felt off.

The best tools I've ever used didn't ask for my credit card. They just worked. Obsidian, VS Code, Blender â tools that respected me enough to not put a gate between me and my work. I wanted Sticky to be that kind of tool.

So I tore out every line of billing code. No more trials. No more upgrade prompts. No more payment gateways. Just a fast, free canvas for your ideas.

The Internet Has Enough Gatekeepers

Look around â every productivity tool wants $10-20/month from you. Per seat. Per feature. It adds up. And for what? Most of them are glorified text editors with a subscription attached.

Sticky is different. It's a spatial thinking tool built by one person who actually uses it every day. There's no board of investors demanding recurring revenue. There's no pressure to add "enterprise features" nobody asked for. There's just me, building software I believe in, and you, using it however you want.

I don't think thinking should cost money. Your brain doesn't charge you rent. Neither should your canvas.

What You Get (For Free)

Unlimited Boards

Create as many canvases as you need. No caps, no limits.

Real-Time Collaboration

Share boards and work together with live cursors.

AI Idea Generator

Brainstorm with GPT-4o-mini. 10 free generations per day.

Self-Hosting

MIT licensed. Run it on your own infrastructure.

Dynamic Tables

Insert editable tables alongside your sticky notes.

Dark Mode

Easy on the eyes. Built in from day one.

What's Next?

Sticky will keep improving. I'm building it in public â follow along on Twitter/X or check out the source code on GitHub. No investors. No roadmap dictated by revenue targets. Just a guy building software he believes in, for people who actually want to use it.

If you read this far, thanks. If Sticky helps you think, that's the win.

Follow on X View on GitHub

â Hamza Saleem, May 2026

jobs.title: Förskollärare till Bolinders förskola
jobs.description:
På Utbildningsförvaltningen i Järfälla kommun arbetar omkring 3 100 medarbetare i någon av våra 39 förskolor, 22 skolor, gymnasium, vuxenutbildning och central förvaltning. Vår verksamhet präglas av våra ledord: professionalitet, kollegialitet och utvecklingskraft. Med mod och kompetens driver vi verksamheten framåt, och vi värdesätter ömsesidig respekt och förståelse mellan kollegor. Tillsammans strävar vi efter att göra varandra bättre, för vi vet att när vi gemensamt utvecklas och ständigt förbättras, så tar vi Järfälla framåt.

Ulvsättraenhetens förskolor är belägna i Kallhäll och Stäket och omfattar förskolorna Ulvsättra, Bolinder, Kopparvägen, Almarevägen samt Öppna förskolan i Kallhäll.  Enheten består av ca 355 barn och 65 medarbetare.

Vi erbjuder en inspirerande och utvecklande verksamhet med positiva och engagerade arbetslag. I vår verksamhet genomsyras all utbildning och undervisning av ett språkutvecklande arbetssätt där språk och kommunikation utgör en central grund för vår verksamhet. Vi arbetar systematiskt med våra lärmiljöer för att de ska främja både lek och lärande.

Under det senaste två åren har vi implementerat ett nytt fokusområde för hela enheten, som vi benämner ”Barn i rörelse”. Syftet är att ta vara på barns rörelseglädje, dels genom pulshöjande aktiviteter och planerad utomhuspedagogik. Målet är att öka barns fysiska och psykiska välbefinnande. Vid rekryteringen lägger vi stor vikt vid ens erfarenheter och kunskaper kring utomhuspedagogik och barns fysiska rörelseaktivitet.

1 plats(er).

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Arbetsuppgifter

Du samarbetar och kommunicerar med dina kollegor och skapar en pedagogisk lärmiljö som utmanar och stimulerar barns utveckling och lärande samt säkerställer att barnen erbjuds en trygg omsorg. Den pedagogiska verksamheten utgår från varje barns förutsättningar och bygger på undervisning som utformas i enlighet med läroplanens mål. Du organiserar arbetet utifrån ett helhetsperspektiv, där barnens utveckling och lärande kontinuerligt och systematiskt följs, dokumenteras och analyseras för att säkerställa kvalitén. På ett systematiskt sätt reflekterar du över det praktiska arbetet, enskilt och tillsammans med andra, samt håller dig uppdaterad och tar tillvara på ny forskning och händelser i omvärlden. Du är en tydlig och entusiasmerande ledare som hanterar förändrade situationer och olika människors agerande. Det är viktigt att du skapar en god relation till barn, vårdnadshavare och kollegor, som karaktäriseras av ömsesidig respekt och ett förtroendefullt förhållningssätt samt positiva förväntningar.

I Järfälla har vi en framtagen strategi för ökad kvalitet i Järfällas förskolor. Den är uppdelad i fyra strategiska områden:

    • Kompetens i förskolans alla led (ett av delmålen är minst en förskollärare per 15 barn)
    • Organisera förskolan så att förutsättningar finns för att främja lärande och trygghet
    • Väcka barns nyfikenhet och lust till lärande
    • Ett aktivt kvalitetsarbete i förskolan

KVALIFIKATIONER
Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som:

Är en pedagogisk ledare för arbetslaget som leder, motiverar, skapar delaktighet och förutsättningar för ett kollegialt lärande

Lyssnar, kommunicerar och löser konflikter på ett konstruktivt sätt. Du samarbetar och kommunicerar med dina kollegor i arbetslaget, om själva kunskapsuppdraget samt välja metoder för att nå uppsatta mål

Är utåtriktad och socialt aktiv i yrkesmässiga sammanhang. Tar kontakt med barn och vårdnadshavare och kan bygga upp och upprätthålla en trygg relation

Planerar, organiserar och prioriterar arbetet på ett effektivt sätt. Sätter upp och håller tidsramar

Har en positiv attityd till ditt arbete och handlar i enlighet med fattade beslut, verksamhetsplan, mål, policys och riktlinjer.

Förstår hur bakgrund, kultur och grupptillhörighet påverkar en själv och andra. Medveten om hur de egna värderingarna påverkar och styr ditt sätt att agera och reagera

Visar förståelse för kvinnors och mäns/flickors och pojkars olika förutsättningar i samhället. Bemöter alla på ett likvärdigt sätt och agerar för att främja likabehandling i fråga om t.ex. resurser, möjligheter och tillgänglighet

jobs.title: Community Management Intern
jobs.description:
Natural Cycles° is a leading women’s health company that developed the world’s first birth control app, used by millions globally. We are a fast growing startup, and we promote an international working environment filled with smart and ambitious colleagues based in Stockholm, Geneva, New York, and remotely. Our mission is to pioneer women’s health through research and passion, empowering every woman with the knowledge she needs to take charge of her health.

We are looking for a Community Management Intern to join our team. The primary focus of this role would initially be community management on social media, with the potential to expand into broader community listening and strategy over time.

Please note that we are hiring for this role in Stockholm, Sweden.

What you will be doing

    

Responding to comments, questions and messages on social platforms (primarily Instagram and TikTok)

    

Ensuring accurate and helpful responses, supported by training from the team

    

Engaging with relevant conversations and user-generated content

    

Building relationships with our community and encouraging positive interaction

    

Supporting the team with simple social media content when relevant

What skills and experience we think you have

    

Strong familiarity with Instagram and TikTok

    

Comfortable interacting with users and people and managing conversations online

    

Ability to respond clearly, accurately and empathetically to questions about the product

    

Ability to collaborate closely with the Customer Support team to ensure correct and consistent information is shared crossed platforms

    

Based in Stockholm

    

Fluent in Swedish

Nice to have

    

Experience across multiple social platforms

    

Strong awareness of trends, platform culture and emerging formats

    

Basic content production skills (e.g. filming, sound, lighting)

    

Ability to identify and engage potential ambassadors or micro-creators

What we offer

    

Flexible work arrangement - you will be part of a team based in and around Stockholm that values effective collaboration and transparent communication, irrespective of work location

    

Professional development - you will work alongside knowledgeable colleagues in the continuous growth and skill enhancement environment

    

Modern technology - you will leverage innovative technologies and tools, within an environment that empowers you to contribute ideas and take ownership of your work

    

Impactful projects - you will contribute to groundbreaking projects that redefine industry standards and create tangible value

    

Commitment to quality - you will join a dynamic and progressive organization that prioritizes profitable, long-term product development

Location

We are remote-friendly, but we find great value in being able to connect with our teams in person. Most of the Brand & Medical Marketing team you will work with is located in Stockholm, and the team occasionally meets in the office for collaboration and face-to-face time.

Sounds interesting?

If you want to be part of a successful team, we encourage you to apply for this position as soon as possible.

We look forward to hearing from you!

How to apply

To apply, just upload your CV and answer the questions on the application form. Keep in mind that we can't accept applications through email because of GDPR, and only applications submitted via the career site (and in English) will be considered.

At Natural Cycles we value diversity and inclusion because we know that teams with people from different backgrounds and experiences are stronger. We welcome candidates from all walks of life and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

Note: We are not looking for consultants or help from recruitment agencies

jobs.title: Associate Development Director and Advisor
jobs.description:
About Contradictum Advisory ehf.

Contradictum Advisory ehf. is a startup dedicated to advising international intellectual property holders in the management and licensing their assets with the objective to steer part of that revenue stream into underfunded projects in Iceland.  Particular emphasis is placed on projects that both serve an immediate domestic need in Iceland and that would meet eligibility requirements under the European Union Green Bond Standard and qualify for the Nordic Swan ecolabel.
Associate Development Director and Advisor.

This is a client-facing position comprised of two primary areas of competence.  The first is in providing advisory and consulting services to intellectual property owners in the North American Market with respect to the use, management, and monetization of their IP portfolios.  The second is in facilitating the investment of IP derived revenue into Iceland-based projects.  Our customer base is comprised of individuals, privately held companies, and family offices who are open diversifying their holdings in EEA and EFTA jurisdictions.  Your role will be to effectively assist clients with maximizing IP derived revenue and presenting opportunities to invest that revenue into target projects in Iceland.  A solid understanding of intellectual property, contracts, procurement processes is essential.  

Main tasks and Responsibilities:
•    Provide strategic direction to clients with respect to intellectual property licensing within the relevant jurisdictional frameworks of each client portfolio.
•    Prepare and present pitch decks to potential investment partners.  
•    Develop investment-ready Iceland-based project proposals.
•    Manage and develop local network of interested counterpart stakeholder and professional service providers related to each project proposal.
•    Identify and liaise with potential new high-net-worth individual investors and small-midsized family office clients in North, Central, and South American markets.
•    Demonstrate extraordinary discretion in all interactions with clients, maintaining the utmost in confidentiality and candor.

Education and licensing:
•    Advanced university-level business or legal education required.  Doctorate of Jurisprudence or Masters of Business Administration with coursework in contracts or international transactions from a top university strongly preferred.
•    Educational coursework in environmental or natural resources usage from an Icelandic University preferred.
•    Admittance to practice before to any US Federal Court.
•    Membership in any North America-based First Nation or Tribal Bar Association strongly preferred.

Qualification Requirements:
•    Minimum 3 years of experience in intellectual property licensing.
•    Minimum 3 years of experience in real property development or prime-contractor representation is highly desirable
•    Minimum 3years of experience in international transactions is highly desirable.
•    Solid Understanding of USPTO and EUIPO standards and procedures.
•    Knowledge of securities and BizOp regulatory standards and requirements is highly desirable.
•    Ability to operate effectively in a multi-time-zone framework convenient to international client domestic work hours.

Language Skills:  Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation English skills are essential.  Additional languages are beneficial.
English [Required] Expert Level
Icelandic [Optional] Intermediate
Spanish [Optional] Intermediate

Compensation:
Compensation is chiefly commission based plus a minimum base salary of 500,000 ISK per month.

Work Hours:
Flexible working hours generally overlapping with the North American Market.  Schedule is expected to vary based on specific client/project needs.
Contact:  For more information, please contact us at CAEHF@proton.me

jobs.title: Ögonspecialist sökes till ögonmottagningen, Halmstad
jobs.description:
Vill du vara med och utveckla framtidens ögonsjukvård i Halland? Vi söker nu en engagerad ögonläkare som vill bli en del av vårt kompetenta och sammansvetsade team i Halmstad – där kvalitet, samarbete och utveckling står i fokus. Här får du möjlighet att växa i din roll och göra verklig skillnad för våra patienter varje dag.

Om arbetet

Som ögonläkare på ögonmottagningen i Halmstad behöver du ha en bred kompetens inom allmän oftalmologi. Här kommer du arbeta teambaserat tillsammans med flera olika professioner, till exempel ögonsjuksköterskor, undersköterskor optiker, ortoptister och medicinska sekreterare.

I arbetet ingår mottagningsarbete och sedvanliga administrativa arbetsuppgifter som journalföring, granskning av bilder, sjukintyg och receptförskrivning.  

Tjänstgöringsgraden bestämmer vi tillsammans och arbetstiderna är förlagda vardagar under dagtid. Du ingår också i vår beredskapslinje för Halland med viss kvälls- och helgtjänstgöring med beredskap i hemmet.

Om arbetsplatsen

Ögonkliniken Halland har tre utbudspunkter med mottagningar i Kungsbacka, Halmstad och Varberg.  

Ögonkliniken i Halland fortsätter att växa och så även uppdraget till våra halländska invånare inom specialiserad ögonvård. Vi behöver bli fler för att fortsatt ha en stor tillgänglighet för våra patienter i Halland.  

Hos oss finns hög kompetens hos våra läkare, ögonsjuksköterskor, undersköterskor, optiker, ortoptister och medicinska sekreterare. Detta bidrar till en fin och nära relation mellan alla yrkesgrupper vilket i sin tur genererar ett gott och utvecklande arbetsklimat.  

Självklart arbetar vi aktivt med förbättringsarbeten både lokalt på mottagningen men också som helhet på ögonkliniken Halland. Här vill vi att du ska vara med oss i vårt fortsatta arbete framåt för att vi skall bli ännu bättre och vara i framkant!  

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som är specialistläkare/överläkare och är trygg i din yrkesroll, med några års erfarenhet inom allmän oftalmologi. Meriterande är kompetens inom kataraktkirurgi/glaukomkirurgi.

För att trivas i rollen behöver du uppskatta både att arbeta i team men också självständigt. Du ser det som en självklarhet med ett gott bemötande mot både patienter och kollegor, det är därför viktigt att du är kommunikativ och har god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska. Vi ser också att du har vilja och drivkraft att påverka utvecklingen inom oftalmologin på såväl kort som lång sikt.  Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet. 

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

I denna rekrytering tillämpar vi löpande urval och intervjuer.

Vårt erbjudande

För oss är det viktigt att du ska trivas och utvecklas i ditt arbete.

Läs mer om vilka förmåner Region Halland kan erbjuda dig som läkare här.

Om Hallands sjukhus

Vår målsättning är att erbjuda Sveriges bästa akut- och specialistsjukvård. På Hallands sjukhus arbetar närmare 4 000 personer, inom fler än 100 olika professioner. I Halmstad och Varberg finns akutsjukvård och planerad specialistvård. I Kungsbacka finns planerad specialistvård inom flera områden.

Verksamheter på Hallands sjukhus

Här hittar du information om våra kliniker och övriga verksamheter. Det ges även en inblick i kulturen, arbetsklimatet och vad som är unikt för varje verksamhet. Dessutom möter du några av våra medarbetare som berättar om hur de upplever sitt jobb. Verksamheter på Hallands sjukhus

Övrig information

Referenstagning är en del av vår rekryteringsprocess. Om du är eller tidigare har varit anställd i Region Halland kan vi komma att ta interna referenser från nuvarande eller tidigare chef. Referenstagning föregås alltid av dialog med dig som sökande.

Om Region Halland

jobs.title: Mechanical Testing Engineer (Hands-On Role)
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

Step into a hands-on role where you drive the future of materials reliability and safety. Join our dynamic team of 15 dedicated materials professionals and take the lead in planning and executing advanced mechanical and thermo-mechanical tests. You’ll collaborate closely with R&D and engineering teams, ensuring our test rigs and equipment are always ready for the next challenge. Imagine yourself evaluating test results with precision, supporting structural safety work, and making a real impact on the performance of critical components. If you’re passionate about innovation and eager to grow in a diverse, inclusive environment, this is your opportunity to shine.

How You’ll Make an Impact

    You perform advanced mechanical and thermo-mechanical tests, including Thermo-Mechanical Fatigue (TMF), Tensile, Impact, and Low Cycle Fatigue (LCF) testing.
    You evaluate and interpret test results, delivering clear and accurate insights.
    You plan and coordinate testing activities in partnership with R&D and engineering teams.
    You support and organize maintenance of mechanical test rigs and related equipment.
    You contribute to structural safety work, including risk assessments and integrity evaluations, and follow up with metallographic analysis when needed.

What You Bring

    You hold a Master’s degree (MSc) in Materials Technology or a closely related field, with at least 3 years of relevant experience.
    You have hands-on expertise with mechanical testing equipment and procedures, and are familiar with TMF, LCF, and metallographic techniques.
    You demonstrate strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
    You are fluent in English; Swedish language skills are a plus.
    You bring experience with MATLAB and Python for data analysis, and proficiency in Microsoft Office for documentation and reporting.

About the Team

You’ll join a collaborative and inclusive group of 15 materials technicians, engineers, and experts who are passionate about advancing materials and structural integrity. Our team thrives on diversity, drawing strength from a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives. We work closely together to deliver high-impact projects, support each other’s growth, and maintain a stimulating environment with cutting-edge testing capabilities. Inclusion and belonging are at the heart of our culture, and we believe that every voice matters.

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Application

Don’t hesitate – apply via https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/en_US/jobs , id nr 301372 not later than 2026-08-21.

Ongoing selection is applied, the role might be filled before last application date.

We refrain from all contact with staffing and recruitment companies, or advertising brokers.

Er du typen, der hader at sidde stille? Kan du lukke aftaler, skabe relationer og se muligheder, hvor andre ser begrænsninger? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Vi søger for et firma i Thy en sulten og resultatorienteret sælger, der vil være med til at udvikle forretningen. Du skal ikke bruge tiden på kold canvas – de har allerede etablerede samarbejdsaftaler med leverandører. Din opgave bliver at følge op på relationerne, udvikle dem og omsætte muligheder til forretning.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Skabe mersalg hos eksisterende samarbejdspartnere.

  • Følge op på indgåede aftaler og sikre, at muligheder bliver udnyttet.

  • Opsøge nye salgsmuligheder gennem dit netværk og dine idéer.

  • Arbejde aktivt med Facebook og LinkedIn som en del af salgs- og markedsføringsindsatsen.

  • Planlægge og gennemføre markedsføringsaktiviteter.

  • Arbejde målrettet med salg og levere synlige resultater.

  • Hele Danmark som salgsområde

De leder efter dig, der

  • Elsker at sælge og motiveres af resultater.

  • Er ærlig, troværdig og holder det, du lover.

  • Arbejder struktureret og følger dine aftaler helt til dørs.

  • Er idérig og ser muligheder frem for begrænsninger.

  • Trives med frihed under ansvar.

  • Har kørekort og lyst til at være tæt på kunderne.

De tilbyder

  • Attraktiv jobløn.

  • Fri firmabil.

  • Telefon og de nødvendige arbejdsredskaber.

  • Stor frihed til selv at planlægge din hverdag.

  • Gode udviklingsmuligheder og plads til dine idéer.

  • Et stærkt fundament med eksisterende samarbejdsaftaler, så du kan fokusere på at skabe resultater frem for kold canvas.

Er du klar til næste skridt?

Hvis du er typen, der skaber muligheder i stedet for undskyldninger, og du vil være en del af en virksomhed med ambitioner, så vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV allerede i dag til dg@kvr.dk evt. spørgsmål kontakt Dan Gyldenberg 25388406.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

jobs.title: Siivooja, Osuuskauppa Suur-Savon Siivouspalvelut Mikkelin alue
jobs.description:
Haemme siivoojaa Osuuskauppa Suur-Savon Siivouspalveluihin Mikkelin alueelle toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen, jossa työtunnit ovat keskimäärin 60 h / 3 viikossa. Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.

Me Suur-Savossa sanomme olevamme Ihan tavallisissa töissä. Työtä kuvaillaan usein erilaisin korulausein, jotka toivottavasti ovat myös totta, mutta meidän mielestämme ihan tavallinen työ on mahtavaa. Meillä on myös poikkeuksellisen kivoja työkavereita, erinomaisia henkilöstöetuja ja harvinaisen paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia.

Siivouspalveluissa työ on nopeatempoista, joten toivomme ripeää työskentelyotetta ja halua ottaa vastuuta oman työpäivän tehokkaaseen organisointiin vaihtuvissa kohteissamme. Siivousalan kokemuksesta on etua. Toivomme sinulta myös joustavuutta ja halua tehdä vaihtelevaa vuorotyötä, työvuorot alkavat useimmiten aikaisin aamulla. Työssä siivotaan hotellihuoneita ja hotellin yhteisiä tiloja, toimialueeseemme kuuluu myös muita ravintoloita ja myymälöitä Mikkelin alueella. Liikkuaksesi toimipisteiden välillä, tarvitset ajokortin ja auton. Työssä tarvitaan suomen tai englannin kielen taitoa.

Palkkaus tässä työssä on MaraTES:in mukainen ((10,37€ -14,33 €/h + vuorolisät). Meillä panostetaan työntekijöidemme työhyvinvointiin ja tarjoamme esimerkiksi laajan työterveyshuollon sekä vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutuksen. Työsuhteesi aikana pääset myös tulospalkkauksen piiriin ja saat käyttöösi Suomen monipuolisimmat henkilöstöedut. Osuuskauppa Suur-Savon työntekijänä olet oikeutettu saamaan alennusta S-ryhmän ravintoloista ja ABC:ltä -25% ravintolalaskun loppusummasta, S-ryhmän myymälöistä jopa -15%, autopesuista -50%, Sokoksen käyttötavaroista jopa -20%.

Haku on avoinna 20.8.2026 saakka. Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja etenemme tarvittaessa hakuprosessissa ennen hakuajan umpeutumista. Jos haluat liittyä Mikkelin Siivouspalveluiden huipputiimiin, lähetä sähköinen hakemuksesi nyt!

Lisätietoja työtehtävästä antaa siivouspäällikkö Katja Kiiliäinen puh: 010 7640136

Osuuskauppa Suur-Savon Siivouspalveluiden tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on auttaa hotelleitamme, ravintoloitamme ja myymälöitämme tarjoamaan täydellinen asiakaskokemus vieraillemme. Haluamme tehdä sen näkyvästi ja ylpeinä osaamisestamme. Toimialueemme Mikkelissä kuuluu Original Sokos Hotel Vaakuna sekä Osuuskauppa Suur-Savon toimipaikat Mikkelissä.

jobs.title: Inhoppare till hemvården i Ekenäs
jobs.description:
Vill du möjliggöra ett gott liv för de äldre? Vill du vara en del av ett mångprofessionellt team? Vi jobbar aktivt för jämlikhet, värdesätter mångfald på vår arbetsplats och uppmuntrar personer med olika bakgrund och som tillhör olika minoriteter att söka jobb hos oss. Kom och jobba med oss på Folkhälsan inom äldreomsorgen i Raseborg!

Folkhälsan Välfärd Ab söker inhoppare till hemvården i Ekenäs

Vi söker dig som studerar eller redan har utbildning inom social- och hälsovårdsbranschen.

Inom hemvården ger vi stöd att bo kvar hemma och leva ett självständigt liv. Vi hjälper till med dagliga sysslor, personlig omvårdnad, socialt stöd eller vård i hemmet. Arbetet är självständigt och du jobbar i två skift, arbetstiderna är mellan kl.7.00-21.00. Arbetet sker främst i de två olika Folkhälsan husen samt i närheten av dem i Ekenäs. Ett godkänt läkemedelslov och hygienpass är nödvändigt.

Arbetet kräver följande behörigheter:

- För närvårdare krävs en närvårdarexamen eller motsvarande tidigare examen, såsom hjälpskötare eller primärskötare, med registrering i Valvira. Vi förutsätter att du som närvårdare också har ett godkänt läkemedelslov.
- Vi tar gärna även emot studeranden inom social- och hälsovårdsbranschen med minst 60 studiepoäng.

jobs.title: Säljare
jobs.description:
Vi söker nu svensktalande säljare till vårt kontor i Málaga.

Det här är en möjlighet för dig som vill utvecklas inom försäljning, arbeta i en internationell miljö och samtidigt få uppleva livet i Spanien tillsammans med ett ambitiöst team.

Hos oss arbetar du med investeringsrelaterade tjänster och har daglig kontakt med både kunder som redan visat intresse och nya potentiella kunder. Rollen passar dig som är driven, social och motiveras av att utvecklas både professionellt och ekonomiskt.

Du behöver inte vara en färdig toppsäljare från dag ett — det viktigaste är att du har rätt inställning, disciplin och viljan att bli riktigt bra på det du gör.

Vi erbjuder en strukturerad arbetsmiljö med tydliga mål, coaching och goda möjligheter att påverka både din utveckling och din inkomst.

Arbetsuppgifter

    Kontakta och följa upp både varma och kalla kunder
    Presentera bolagets tjänster på ett tydligt och professionellt sätt
    Bygga långsiktiga kundrelationer
    Arbeta mot individuella och gemensamma mål
    Utvecklas löpande genom coaching och feedback

Vi söker dig som

    Talar flytande svenska i tal och skrift
    Är kommunikativ och trygg i telefon
    Har stark arbetsmoral och vill utvecklas
    Motiveras av mål, prestation och personlig utveckling
    Trivs i en miljö med tempo och ansvar
    Har tidigare erfarenhet av försäljning (meriterande men inget krav)
    Har svenskt eller europeiskt pass

Vi erbjuder

    Fast lön från 1 800 € per månad
    Provision och bonus utan lönetak
    Kontinuerlig coaching och utbildning
    Modernt kontor i centrala Málaga
    Internationell arbetsmiljö med stark teamkänsla
    Möjlighet till hjälp med flytt och etablering
    Tydliga utvecklingsmöjligheter för rätt person

Arbetet sker på plats i Málaga måndag till fredag enligt svenska arbetstider — vilket ger struktur i vardagen och friheten att njuta av livet i Spanien på kvällar och helger.

För rätt person kan detta bli starten på en långsiktig karriär inom försäljning och finans.

    Skicka in din ansökan med uppdaterat CV på svenska. Urval sker löpande.

jobs.title: Liikuntaleikkikoulun ohjaaja
jobs.description:
Etsimme kahta täysi-ikäistä liikkariohjaajaa ryhmillemme Mäkkylään. Ryhmät kokoontuvat Mäkkylän koulun liikuntasalissa torstaisin 3.9.2026 alkaen.

- 17:00-17:45 / 2024-2023-syntyneet (aikuisen kanssa)

- 17:50-18:35 / 2023-syntyneet (aikuisen kanssa)

- 18:40-19:25 / 2022-syntyneet


Liikuntaleikkikoulu eli liikkari on monipuolinen liikuntakerho 2-6-vuotiaille tytöille ja pojille. Liikuntaleikkikoulussa lapsi oppii kehon hallintaa, perusliikkeitä ja yhdessäoloa sekä kokee oivaltamisen iloa ja onnistumisen elämyksiä.

Liikuntaleikkikoulun ohjaajan tehtäviin kuuluu

- Tuntien suunnittelu ja näiden turvallinen toteuttaminen yhdessä ohjaajaparin kanssa

- Vanhempien kanssa kommunikointi, sekä mahdollisten ongelmatilanteiden selvittäminen


Seuraamme sopii ohjaajaksi täysi-ikäiset innostavat, positiiviset hakijat, joiden mielenkiinto on lasten liikunnassa. Erityisen tärkeää on myös välittävä asenne ohjauksessa lasten positiivisten liikuntakokemusten varmistamiseksi.

Eduksi katsotaan:

- kokemus lasten liikuntaryhmien ohjaamisesta

- alaa opiskelevat tai alalta valmistuneet (liikunnanohjaaja, liikuntaneuvoja, opettaja, varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja, lähihoitaja tms.)

- oma liikuntatausta

- liikuntaleikkikoulun ohjaajakoulutus


Edellytämme hakijalta liikuntaleikkikoulun ohjaajakoulutusta, jonka voi hankkia myös kauden käynnistyttyä. Maksamme liikuntaleikkikoulun ohjaajankoulutuksesta puolet tai koko koulutuksen ohjaajan sitoutumisen mukaisesti. Koulutuksesta on hyötyä myöhemminkin monessa alan työssä. jobs.title: Bilmekaniker på hjul - Servicebil og frihet - Trondheim
jobs.description:
Er du faglært bilmekaniker og ønsker en fleksibel ekstrajobb? Vanly søker en mobil mekaniker til 20–30 % stilling. Du får egen servicebil, konkurransedyktig timelønn og stor frihet til å kombinere jobben med annen verkstedstilling. Bli med på en spennende vekstreise!

Hva vi ser etter

  • Du har fagbrev som bilmekaniker eller arbeidserfaring som veier opp for dette

  • Du er trygg på diagnose og feilsøking og liker å løse tekniske utfordringer.

  • Du har et forebyggende tankesett og oppdager feil før de utvikler seg til driftsstans.

  • Du tar eierskap til bilene du har ansvar for og ønsker høyest mulig driftssikkerhet.

  • Du forstår viktigheten av at bilene er klare til avtalt tid -- hver eneste dag.

  • Du er pålitelig og liker å jobbe selvstendig

  • Du har førerkort klasse B

  • Snarlig oppstart, ikke vent med å søke, søk nå, enkel søknad!

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Diagnose og feilsøking med moderne diagnoseutstyr

  • Service og forebyggende vedlikehold

  • Reparasjon av mekaniske og elektriske feil

  • Skifte av slitedeler (bremser, batterier, sensorer, lyspærer m.m.)

  • Hjul- og dekkarbeid

  • Utrykning ved driftsproblemer

  • Bidra til høy oppetid og driftssikkerhet på Vanlys bilpark

Vi tilbyr

  • Konkurransedyktig timelønn

  • Fleksibel arbeidstid tilpasset din hverdag

  • Egen fullt utstyrt servicebil

  • Stor grad av frihet og selvstendighet

  • Moderne varebilpark med varierte oppdrag

  • Mulighet for fast ansettelse etter hvert som selskapet vokser

Lønn basert på erfaring og kompetanse:

  • Mekaniker: 320 kr/time

  • Senior mekaniker: 400 kr/time

  • Mastertekniker: 475 kr/time

  • Teknisk leder / Verkstedsleder: 550 kr/time

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vanly AS er et Trondheim-basert selskap som tilbyr fleksible løsninger innen utleie og bruk av varebiler og kjøretøy. Selskapet er etablert for å gjøre tilgang til bil enklere, mer tilgjengelig og bedre tilpasset dagens behov -- enten du er privatperson eller bedrift.

Vanly kombinerer lokal tilstedeværelse med et moderne og fremtidsrettet tankesett. I stedet for tunge og rigide leieavtaler, fokuserer Vanly på smidige løsninger som gir kundene frihet, forutsigbarhet og trygghet. Målet er å redusere friksjon, spare tid og tilby en sømløs opplevelse fra bestilling til bruk.

jobs.title: Associate in GC & IMM
jobs.employer: HSBC Continental Europe Bank, Sweden Filial
jobs.description:
Business:                         CIB

Location:                            Stockholm, Sweden



Role Purpose

As an Associate in GC & IMM, your main responsibilities will include:

    Supporting one or more Global Relationship Bankers on a defined portfolio of clients within Nordics Banking
    Collaborating with others across GC & IMM in order to manage the clients’ global relationships
    Origination: Identifying marketing opportunities, undertaking appropriate analysis and preparation of proposals, presentations and pitches for new products and services
    Execution: interacting with clients and various product teams in order to ensure smooth execution in a timely manner
    Client engagement: establishing strong relationship with the portfolio of clients
    Financial Analysis: Developing an understanding of clients’ financials in order to assess the capital markets needs and the credit strengths / weaknesses
    Client Materials: Assisting in the preparation of presentations and other materials for clients
    Sector knowledge: Keeping up to date with the markets and the sector developments to support business development, portfolio management and credit risk assessment
    Collaborating with product and country teams
    Portfolio management / HSBC Strategy: understanding GC & IMM internal return hurdles and identifying opportunities to reduce Risk Weighted Assets to enhance relationship returns



Customers / Stakeholders        

Deliver fair outcomes for our customers and ensure own conduct maintains the orderly and transparent operation of financial markets - First and foremost, a resource for the Strategic Innovation Investments senior investment professionals.

Portfolio companies – work with our existing and Target client base to develop strategic relevance with HSBC and value-add from HSBC

Internal businesses – work with internal business champions to develop strategic ties to our clients



Leadership & Teamwork

Support achievement of the HSBC vision, Values, goals and culture in personal behaviour, actions and decision making.

Take personal responsibility for understanding and agreeing performance expectations, completing the necessary mandatory training and developing the levels of capability and competence needed to be effective in the role.

Contribute to team development, effectiveness and success by sharing knowledge and good practice, working collaboratively with others to create a productive, diverse and supportive working environment.



Operational Effectiveness & Control

Suggest ideas and contribute to implementing actions that will improve customer service, quality or the way teams and individuals work together.

Adhere to HSBC policy, procedures and control requirements applicable to day-to-day working, exceptional and project activities, and raise any concerns about actual or potential issues promptly, in line with reporting and escalation procedures.

Continuously monitor relevant management information, gather information from Banking sources to assess potential impacts and identify risks, necessary changes and business opportunities.

Apply Banking policies, procedures, practices and standards to their allocated tasks, taking responsibility for their own actions, to ensure the achievement of high levels of quality, effective risk management and regulatory compliance.



Role Context

Management of Risk

The jobholder will ensure the fair treatment of our customers is at the heart of everything we do, both personally and as an organisation.

This will be achieved by consistently displaying the behaviours that form part of the HSBC Values and culture and adhering to HSBC risk policies and procedures, including notification and escalation of any concerns and taking required action in relation to points raised by audit and/or external regulators.

The jobholder is responsible for managing and mitigating operational risks in their day to day operations. In executing these responsibilities, the Group has adopted risk management and internal control structure referred to as the ‘Three Lines of Defence’. The jobholder should ensure they understand their position within the Three Lines of Defence, and act accordingly in line with operational risk policy, escalating in a timely manner where they are unsure of actions required.

Through the implementation the Global AML, Sanctions and ABC Policies, supporting Guidance, and Line of Business Procedures the jobholder will make informed decisions in accordance with the core principles of HSBC's Financial Crime Risk Appetite.

The following statement is only for roles with core responsibilities in Operational Risk Management (Risk Owner, Control Owner, Risk Steward, BRCM, and Operational Risk Function

The jobholder has responsibility for overseeing and ensuring that Operational risks are managed in accordance with the Group Standards Manual, Risk FIM, & relevant guidelines & standards. The jobholder should comply with the detailed expectations and responsibilities for their core role in operational risk management through ensuring all actions take account of operational risks, and through using the Operational Risk Management Framework appropriately to manage those risks.

This will be achieved by:

Continuously reassessing risks associated with the role and inherent in the business, taking account of changing economic or market conditions, legal and regulatory requirements, operating procedures and practices, management restructurings, and the impact of new technology.

Ensuring all actions take account of the likelihood of operational risk occurring, addressing areas of concern in conjunction with Risk and relevant line colleagues, and also by ensuring that actions resulting from points raised by internal or external audits, and external regulators, are correctly implemented in a timely fashion.



Observation of Internal Controls

The jobholder will adhere to, and be able to demonstrate adherence to, internal controls and will implement the Group compliance policy by adhering to all relevant processes/procedures.

The term ‘compliance’ embraces all relevant financial services laws, rules and codes with which the business has to comply. This will be achieved by adherence to all relevant procedures, keeping appropriate records and, where appropriate, by the timely implementation of internal and external audit points, including issues raised by external regulators.

The following statement is only for roles with managerial or specific Compliance responsibilities

The jobholder will implement measures to contain compliance risk across the business area. This will be achieved by liaising with Compliance department about business initiatives at the earliest opportunity. Also and when applicable, by ensuring adequate resources are in place and training is provided, fostering a compliance culture and optimising relations with regulators.



Candidate requirements:

    Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills
    Ability to undertake in depth review of industry, competitors, clients and products and provide a high quality analysis of credit risk
    Strong financial analysis capability
    Experience in developing marketing materials (pitch books)
    Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
    Understanding of HSBC Group and products
    High levels of motivation and strong work ethic
    Demonstrated capacity to build a network of contacts, both internal and external, in the context of interactions with colleagues and clients
    A strong understanding of the financial markets
    The position requires a self-confident person who is highly motivated and reliable, with strong team spirit
    Strong negotiation and presentation skills

Are you passionate about software development and experienced in Java? Do you thrive in a fun, friendly, and collaborative environment where learning and innovation are encouraged? Join our Corporate Lending team and help build business-critical solutions that make a real impact.

You'll be part of a highly experienced team with diverse technical backgrounds, creating an environment where you can learn from skilled colleagues, share your own expertise, and grow both professionally and personally. We value collaboration, curiosity, and an open mindset towards new technologies and innovative solutions.

We're looking for someone who brings strong technical expertise, a positive attitude, and a willingness to embrace new technologies and ways of working while contributing to a supportive and collaborative team culture.

In Swedbank you have the opportunity to:

• Be part of our cross-functional and Agile teams with deep knowledge in the Lending processes, particularly Corporate Lending.

• Participate in identifying customer needs and turning them into functionalities and business capabilities. 

• Define Corporate Lending specific APIs, frameworks and development processes according to best practices.

• Work with developing integrations with multiple source systems.

• Be full-stack, work with FDP development in Kundportalen along with Andromeda APIs and a SQL backend.

• Agree on launch activities together with the team, stakeholders and APO.

• Be a team player and contribute to the team's way of working constantly improving.

• Learn from others and share your skills and experiences in community of practice.

What is needed in this role:

• University degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology or equivalent

• 10+ years of experience in JAVA development and tools.

• Experience in agile way of working (preferable Scrum, SAFe frameworks).

• Experience in API design, microservices architecture, modular development, component identification and encapsulation of business capability.

• Business domain knowledge within the Corporate Lending area is considered an advantage

• Excellent communication skills and being fluent in English, both spoken and written.

• Demonstrate self-leadership and excellent interpersonal skills.

• Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

With us, you can experience:

    

Personal and professional growth through self-leadership and continuous development.

    

Meaningful work that positively impacts our workplace, our customers, and society.

    

An open and collaborative culture that encourages cross-functional teamwork and provides networking opportunities.

    

A supportive and inclusive environment that promotes a balanced and sustainable work-life, with flexible working conditions when suitable for the role.

    

Enjoy country-specific benefits, including banking offers, a pension plan, our share-based reward program, health insurance in the Baltics and a health allowance in Sweden.

"Join our team and...

become a part of a team that creates ever improving lending journeys for our customers and colleagues. We are an international team of professionals, who enjoy having a good time at work, being there for each other and work together to create a strong team spirit with a constant focus on delivery, quality and support. As your future manager, I work according to our values, Open, Simple and Caring, and believe having fun and developing yourself and your colleagues through your work is the best way to create value not only for our customers but also yourself”

Agnimitra Bhattacharyya, your future manager

jobs.title: Business Development Representative, MEA
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is rebuilding its go-to-market motion around a workflow-first, builder-led model—and the BDR is at the front of it. As a Business Development Rep, you'll be the force that turns the right accounts into the right conversations. You'll partner closely with Solutions Consultants to identify and target companies that are ready to rethink how they work—and your job is to get them in the room. This isn't generic pipeline work: you're qualifying for workflow-first, build-ready opportunities that set SCs up to win. If you're competitive, curious, and energized by outbound that actually means something, this is the role for you.



This role will be based in either Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Generate qualified, workflow-first pipeline by identifying and targeting high-potential accounts in your assigned book, partnering with your sellers on account and outbound strategy

 - Run multi-channel outbound campaigns—email, phone, LinkedIn, and events—to create urgency and secure first meetings with the right decision-makers

 - Conduct initial qualification to ensure meetings handed to sellers are "ready to build," not just "ready to talk"—validating ICP, intent, and workflow fit before the handoff

 - Document and deliver clean handoff packets in Salesforce with ICP signals, pain points, workflow hypothesis, and stakeholder context so sellers can hit the ground running

 - Leverage GTM System tooling and intent data to sharpen targeting, prioritize accounts by signal strength, and increase the quality and consistency of your outbound motion




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Proven track record in outbound pipeline generation, with hands-on experience in cold prospecting across phone, email, and social channels

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to craft compelling, persona-specific outreach that earns a response

jobs.title: Senior Plattformsspecialist inom Kafka och Confluent
jobs.description:
Om företaget

Hos Avaron får du tryggheten i en fast anställning kombinerat med variationen av att arbeta ute hos olika kunder. Vi tillsätter specialister inom allt från teknik, IT och industri till projektledning och affärsstöd – och oavsett uppdrag har du en konsultchef som finns där för dig och din utveckling.

Om rollen

Du kliver in i en miljö där gemensamma integrationsplattformar är en viktig del av koncernens informationsförsörjning. Här finns redan etablerade lösningar med Confluent Platform och Red Hat AMQ Broker i Red Hat OpenShift, och nu ligger fokus på att vidareutveckla Kafka-plattformen samt utvärdera hur Confluent Cloud kan komplettera det befintliga plattformserbjudandet.

Rollen spänner över implementation, vidareutveckling och förvaltning, men också över hur plattformen upplevs av utvecklingsteamen. Du är med och bygger ett mer sammanhållet erbjudande där automation, självbetjäning och standardiserade arbetssätt står i centrum. En viktig del är också integration med en intern utvecklarportal baserad på Backstage, så att utvecklare får en gemensam ingång till dokumentation, tjänster och funktioner. Det här är en spännande möjlighet för dig som vill kombinera djup plattformskompetens med tydlig påverkan på utvecklarupplevelsen.

Arbetsuppgifter

    Du implementerar, konfigurerar och vidareutvecklar Confluent Platform och Confluent Cloud.
    Du bidrar i utvärdering och etablering av Confluent Cloud som komplement till befintlig plattform.
    Du utvecklar och förbättrar automation kring installation, konfiguration och livscykelhantering.
    Du är med och formar ett sammanhållet plattformserbjudande tillsammans med övriga integrationsplattformar, bland annat Red Hat AMQ Broker.
    Du driver förbättringar inom Developer Experience genom automation, självbetjäning och standardiserade arbetssätt.
    Du integrerar plattformens funktioner och tjänster med Backstage för att förenkla onboarding, dokumentation och självbetjäning.
    Du säkerställer hög tillgänglighet, säkerhet och robust drift av plattformen.
    Du implementerar och förvaltar Kafka Connect, Schema Registry och andra centrala plattformskomponenter.
    Du bidrar till monitorering, felsökning, prestandaoptimering, kapacitetsplanering, dokumentation och kunskapsöverföring.

Krav

    Flerårig erfarenhet av implementation, konfiguration och förvaltning av Confluent Platform i produktionsmiljö.
    Praktisk erfarenhet av Confluent Cloud och dess tjänster.
    Djup kompetens inom Apache Kafka och Confluents plattformskomponenter, exempelvis Kafka Brokers, Kafka Connect, Schema Registry, Cluster Linking, RBAC och ACL.
    Erfarenhet av drift och livscykelhantering av Confluent Platform i Red Hat OpenShift.
    Erfarenhet av att etablera och förvalta Kafka Connect, inklusive connectorer mot vanliga integrationsmönster och datakällor.
    Erfarenhet av att automatisera plattformar med Infrastructure as Code, exempelvis Terraform, Git och CI/CD.
    Erfarenhet av monitorering, loggning, kapacitetsplanering och prestandaoptimering av Kafka-baserade plattformar.
    God kunskap om säkerhet inom Kafka och Confluent, exempelvis autentisering, auktorisering, certifikathantering, kryptering och integration med Identity Providers.
    Erfarenhet av att utveckla eller bidra till en god Developer Experience genom automation, självbetjäning och standardiserade arbetssätt.
    God förståelse för hög tillgänglighet, disaster recovery och resilienta plattformslösningar.
    Du arbetar självgående och strukturerat, samarbetar väl med utvecklingsteam och delar gärna med dig av din kunskap.

Meriterande

    Erfarenhet av integration med Backstage eller annan utvecklarportal.
    Erfarenhet av hybridlösningar där on-premise-plattformar samverkar med molntjänster.
    Erfarenhet av Confluent for Kubernetes (CFK).
    Erfarenhet från större organisationer.
    Erfarenhet från finans, försäkring eller annan reglerad verksamhet.
    Certifiering inom Confluent eller Apache Kafka.

Vi erbjuder

    Fast anställning hos Avaron AB
    Tjänstepension
    Friskvårdsbidrag på 5 000 kr per år

Ansökan

Vi tillsätter löpande – sök gärna så snart du kan.

jobs.description:
Työskentelet koulupsykologina Kaarinan opiskeluhuollossa S:t Karins svenska skolanissa ja Piispanlähteen koululla (1.-6. luokat) sekä näiden koulujen esiopetusyksiköissä. Tuot psykologista asiantuntijuutta esiopetuksen ja oppilaitoksen käyttöön ja olet mukana tukemassa lasten oppimista, kasvua, kehitystä ja hyvinvointia. Arjessasi yhdistyvät yksilötyö, yhteisöllinen työ ja monialainen yhteistyö koulun henkilöstön sekä opiskeluhuollon muiden ammattilaisten kanssa.

Työssäsi psykologin asiantuntemusta arvostetaan ja se nähdään kouluyhteisössä tärkeänä. Tukenasi ovat johtava koulupsykologi sekä alueen kokenut psykologitiimi, jotka ovat aina tarvittaessa saatavilla.

Tehtäviisi kuuluu:
-oppilaan yksilökohtainen tuki ja ohjaus asiakastyössä oppimiseen, kasvuun, kehitykseen ja hyvinvointiin liittyen
-osallistuminen monialaisen asiantuntijaryhmän työskentelyyn
-yhteisöllinen työ oppilaitoksella
-oppimisvaikeuksien kartoitus.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja merkityksellisen työn, jossa voit suunnitella työpäiväsi joustavasti liukuvaa työaikaa ja osittaista etätyötä hyödyntäen. Saat kattavan perehdytyksen tehtävään, mahdollisuuden perustellusti yksilötyönohjaukseen sekä halutessasi kokeneen psykologin mentoriksi. Tuemme osaamisesi kehittymistä ja tarjoamme mahdollisuuden kouluttautua esimerkiksi Terapiat etulinjaan -koulutuksiin. Työhyvinvointisi ja ammatillinen kasvu ovat meille tärkeitä.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Odotamme sinulta sujuvaa suomen ja ruotsin kielen taitoa, kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn sekä hyviä verkosto- ja tiimityötaitoja. Tehtävä edellyttää oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta. Eduksi katsotaan kokemus lasten, nuorten ja perheiden kanssa tehdystä työstä. Huomioimme myös opintojen loppuvaiheessa olevat hakijat.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain 559/94 mukainen psykologin laillistus.

Hae mukaan tekemään vaikuttavaa työtä lasten ja nuorten hyvinvoinnin ja oppimisen tueksi Kaarinaan - odotamme hakemustasi!

jobs.title: Part-time Veterinary Nurse
jobs.description:
Veterinary Nurse (Part-Time) - MyPeterinarian, Copenhagen

Are you an Authorised Veterinary Nurse with strong anaesthesia and surgical nursing experience?

MyPeterinarian is looking for an experienced Veterinary Nurse to join our Copenhagen team in a part-time role with a strong focus on anaesthesia, surgical nursing and high-quality patient care.

Founded in 2017, MyPeterinarian is an established independent veterinary clinic, grooming salon and pet-sitting company. We are a close-knit team focused on excellent patient care, strong client relationships and creating a positive working environment.

About the Role

The core responsibility of this role is independently managing anaesthesia monitoring - from patient preparation and induction through to recovery. You will play an important role in ensuring safe, calm and well-managed surgical procedures while working closely with the veterinary team.

This role is ideal for a nurse who enjoys surgical nursing, values careful patient monitoring and is confident taking responsibility within their area of expertise.

Please note: MyPeterinarian is planning to relocate to a new Copenhagen location between now and the end of September 2026 -the exact address will be shared during the interview process 

Schedule

Approximately 21 hours per week

  • Tuesday and Wednesday: 09:00-15:00

  • Monday, Thursday and Friday: 10:00-13:00

  • Exact schedule to be agreed with the successful candidate

This is a weekday-only position, with no evenings, weekends or night shifts scheduled as standard, supporting a healthy work-life balance.

Expected start date: 15 September 2026

Key Responsibilities

  • Independently monitoring anaesthesia, including induction and recovery

  • Preparing patients for surgery and providing surgical assistance

  • Supporting blood sample collection and other clinical procedures

  • Providing routine patient care, including nail clipping

  • Handling and supporting patients throughout their visit

  • Maintaining clinical hygiene standards and sterilising equipment

  • Supporting reception and administrative tasks when required

  • Assisting with stock checks and inventory management

Qualifications

We are looking for someone who:

  • Is an Authorised Veterinary Nurse

  • Has proven experience of independently monitoring anaesthesia

  • Is comfortable working independently during surgical procedures

  • Has excellent patient handling skills and a calm, professional approach

  • Has a good standard of spoken and written English (Danish is an advantage but not essential)

  • Enjoys being part of a small, collaborative team

What We Offer

  • A friendly and professional team environment

  • A varied clinical role with genuine responsibility

  • No evenings, weekends or night shifts scheduled as standard 

  • Salary: 200dkk/hr

  • Regular team gatherings and a supportive workplace culture

  • Opportunity to increase working hours over time, by mutual agreement

  • Staff discounts on MyPeterinarian veterinary, grooming and pet-sitting services for your own pets

Application Process

Application deadline: 15 August 2026

To apply, please send your CV to: jobs@mypeterinarian.com

Please note that applicants must already have the right to work in Denmark. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position.

If you have any questions, please contact us at: hej@mypeterinarian.com

By submitting your application, you consent to MyPeterinarian processing your personal data for the purpose of recruitment. Your information will be handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable data protection legislation.
