jobs.title: Regnskapsfører med ansvar for egne selskaper?
jobs.description:
Bli en nøkkelperson i Baudas regnskapsteam!

Er du en erfaren regnskapsfører som ønsker en rolle med ansvar, faglige utfordringer og mulighet til å påvirke? Da kan dette være muligheten for deg.

Hos Bauda AS får du ansvar for regnskapet i ett eller flere selskaper i konsernet, samtidig som du blir en del av et kompetent og inkluderende fagmiljø. I rollen bidrar du til kvalitet, gode prosesser og leveranser innen avtalte frister.

Hos oss står kunden i sentrum, og vår visjon er å ha Norges mest fornøyde bilkunder. Kontinuerlig forbedring og respekt for mennesket er grunnlaget for måten vi jobber på.

Hvorfor bli en del av Bauda AS?

Vi legger stor vekt på et positivt arbeidsmiljø og et sterkt fellesskap. Hos oss får du ikke bare muligheten til å jobbe med et av verdens ledende bilmerker, men også sjansen til å utvikle deg både profesjonelt og personlig. Vi verdsetter hver enkelt medarbeider og tror på å skape et arbeidsmiljø som inspirerer til samarbeid, innovasjon og suksess.

  • Kontinuerlig forbedring: Vi legger stor vekt på kontinuerlig forbedring av prosesser og produkter. Dette gir medarbeiderne våre muligheten til å være involvert i utfordrende prosjekter og stadig forbedre sin kompetanse.
  • Respekt for mennesker: Hos oss vektlegger verdien av respekt for hver enkelt medarbeider. Dette bidrar til et positivt arbeidsmiljø og en bedriftskultur som oppmuntrer til samarbeid og deltakelse.
  • Opplæring og utvikling: Vi investerer i opplæring og utvikling av våre medarbeidere. Gjennom Toyotas opplæringsprogrammer og sertifiseringsløp for våre medarbeidere, samt relevante kurs gjennom Videocation
  • Bærekraft og samfunnsansvar: Toyota har vist engasjement for bærekraft og samfunnsansvar og sammen med konsernet setter vi bærekraft og mangfold på tapetet.

Bli en del av Bauda AS, hvor dine ferdigheter blir verdsatt, og hvor vi sammen streber etter å levere den beste opplevelsen for våre kunder og medarbeidere.

Dette blir dine viktigste ansvarsområder:
  • Ansvar for regnskapsføring i ett eller flere selskaper – fra løpende bokføring til årsoppgjør
  • Månedsavslutning, rapportering og avstemminger
  • Internkontroll og kvalitetssikring innen eget ansvarsområde
  • Bidra til å forbedre rutiner, prosesser og arbeidsflyt
  • Samarbeide tett med regnskapsteamet for å sikre høy kvalitet i leveransene

Vi benytter blant annet Visma Business NXT som ERP-system, Power BI og Microsoft Office.

Vi ser etter deg som har:
  • 5-7 års erfaring med regnskapsføring og månedsavslutning fra større virksomhet, blant annet avstemminger, periodiseringer og kvalitetssikring
  • Høyere utdanning innen økonomi, bachelor eller tilsvarende
  • God systemforståelse og Excel-kunnskaper
  • God muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne på norsk
  • Strukturert, nøyaktig og kvalitetsbevisst
  • Evner å prioritere og opprettholde fremdrift i perioder med høyt tempo
  • Trives med å ta ansvar og arbeider godt både selvstendig og i team
Dette kan Bauda AS tilby deg
  • En sentral rolle med stort faglig ansvar
  • Et kompetent og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø
  • Mulighet til å påvirke og forbedre arbeidsprosesser
  • Fleksitid og mulighet for hjemmekontor
  • Kantine og parkeringsmuligheter
  • Moderne lokaler med sentral beliggenhet og gode kollektivforbindelser
  • Sosiale arrangementer og et godt arbeidsmiljø
  • En trygg jobb i et solid konsern med en av verdens sterkeste merkevarer

Vi behandler søknader fortløpende og ser frem til å høre fra deg.

Har du spørsmål om stillingen, er du velkommen til å kontakte:

Solveig Baardsen E-post: Solveig.baardsen@keystones.no








Om arbeidsgiveren:

Bauda AS

Bauda AS ble etablert i 1959 og driver forhandlerviksomhet av bilmerkene Toyota og Lexus. I dag eier de 19 Toyota-forhandlere, 6 Lexus-forhandlere og to skadesenter sentralt på Øst- og Sørlandet. Forhandlerne er fordelt på syv selskaper: Toyota Asker og Bærum AS, Toyota Buskerud AS, Toyota Hønefoss AS, Toyota Oslo AS, Toyota Romerike AS, Toyota Sør AS og Toyota Østfold AS.

Vi har stort fokus på kundeopplevelser og har en tydelig visjon «Vi vil ha Norges mest fornøyde bilkunder». Gjennom Toyotas globale utviklingsprogram jobber vi målrettet for å utvikle fremtidens medarbeidere og ledere – programmene er basert på våre kjerneverdier: kontinuerlig forbedring og respekt for mennesker. Bauda-forhandlerne står i dag for i overkant av 43 % av det totale Toyota-salget og 45 % av det totale Lexus-salget i Norge.

jobs.title: Kainuun vastaanottokeskuksen sosiaaliohjaaja
jobs.description:
**Oletko sosiaali- ja asiakaspalvelutyön osaaja? Haluatko tehdä ihmisläheistä ja merkityksellistä työtä monimuotoisessa työyhteisössä?**

**Haemme nyt sosiaaliohjaajaa yksikköömme Kainuuseen! Rooli on kokoaikainen ja työsuhde solmitaan toistaiseksi voimassa olevana.**

Babando tuottaa Maahanmuuttoviraston toimeksiantona vastaanottokeskuspalveluita Kajaanissa. Babando on moderni sosiaali- ja terveysalan kasvuyritys ja valtakunnallinen toimija, jonka tiimillä on vuosien kokemus vastaanottokeskusten menestyksekkäästä operoinnista ja johtamisesta. Tuotamme ensiluokkaisia vastaanottopalveluja sotaa paenneille tilapäistä suojelua saaville henkilöille sekä turvapaikanhakijoille. Nykyiset yksikkömme sijaitsevat Kainuussa ja Rovaniemellä.

**Sosiaaliohjaajan työnkuva** Vastaanottokeskuksen sosiaaliohjaajana vastaat vastaanottopalveluihin kuuluvista lakisääteisistä sosiaalihuollon palveluista. Työnkuvaasi kuuluu muun muassa turvapaikanhakijoiden ja tilapäistä suojelua saavien neuvontaa ja ohjausta, hyvinvoinnin seuraamista ja edistämistä, palvelun- ja tuen tarpeen arviointia, etuuskäsittelyä, lausuntojen laatimista ja tarvittavan avun tarjoamista ilmenneissä ongelma- ja kriisitilanteissa. Vastuullasi on vahvistaa vastaanottokeskuksessa majoittuvien yksilöiden ja perheiden toimintakykyä sekä luoda turvallista yleisilmapiiriä. Työ on päivätyötä. Tukenasi on Babandon valtakunnallinen sosiaalityöntiimi ja yksikössäsi työskentelee myös sosiaalityöntekijä. Työ on moniammatillista tiimityötä.

**Mitä edellytämme vastaanottokeskuksen sosiaaliohjaajalta?** Edellytämme sinulta sosiaalihuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain (817/2015) mukaista pätevyyttä ja oikeutta käyttää sosiaaliohjaajan ammattinimikettä. Vastaanottopalveluista ja sosiaalihuollosta säädettyjen lakien perusteellinen tuntemus on työssä tärkeää. Katsomme eduksi aiemman kokemuksen työskentelystä vastaanottokeskuksessa, monikulttuurisessa ja -ammatillisessa työyhteisössä sekä kokemuksen työskentelystä tulkin kanssa. Ajokortti, hyvä IT-osaaminen sekä hyvät suomen ja englannin kielen taidot ovat välttämättömiä työssä. Lisäksi arvostamme laajempaa kielitaitoa.

Saatat olla etsimämme henkilö, jos koet vastaanottokeskustyön merkitykselliseksi ja sinulla on aito halu olla vaikuttamassa positiivisesti ja ennaltaehkäisevästi apua tarvitsevien elämäntilanteeseen. Odotamme sinulta kykyä ottaa itsenäisesti vastuuta ja työskennellä terävällä ja määrätietoisella otteella nopeasti muuttuvassa ympäristössä. Hyvät kommunikointi- ja yhteistyötaidot ovat työssä ensiarvoisen tärkeitä.

**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?** Tarjoamme sinulle huikean mahdollisuuden päästä tekemään työtä merkityksellisen asian äärellä. Vastaanottokeskuksen sosiaaliohjaajan työssä pääset kartuttamaan ammatillista osaamistasi ja opit työskentelystä monikulttuurisessa ja -ammatillisessa ympäristössä. Tarjoamme sinulle ammatillisesti arvokkaan tilaisuuden kehittyä, menestyä ja samanaikaisesti vaikuttaa positiivisesti satojen ihmisten elämiin.

Työsuhteen ehtojen ja palkkauksen osalta noudatamme yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimusta. Palkkauksessa huomioidaan myös hakijan aikaisempi työkokemus. Työsuhde solmitaan Babando Oy:n kanssa. Työsuhteen alussa noudatetaan kuuden (6) kuukauden koeaikaa.

**Koetko, että sinulla olisi edellytykset menestyä tässä työtehtävässä? Täytä hakemus ja muistahan liittää mukaan CV:si! Haku päättyy 20.8.2026:https://babando.teamtailor.com/jobs/8177381-kainuun-vastaanottokeskuksen-sosiaaliohjaaja?promotion=2133264-trackable-share-link-tyomarkkinatori**

Toimithan hakemuksesi pian, sillä rooli täytetään heti sopivan hakijan löydyttyä!

Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa vastaanottokeskuksen johtaja Emma Juntunen 10.8.2026 alkaen, emma.juntunen@babando.fi tai 044 710 1448.

jobs.title: Produktionsledare - Kalmar
jobs.description:
Company description:

Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. With cutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and construction equipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm, Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries. Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.

Job description:

Har du erfarenhet av ledarskap i en produktionsmiljö och drivs av att skapa struktur, engagemang och ständiga förbättringar? Hos Epiroc börjar allt med människor – och nu söker vi en engagerad och kommunikativ Produktionsledare som vill vara med och forma framtidens produktion i Kalmar. Vår organisation i sin nuvarande form är relativt ny, vilket ger dig stora möjligheter att påverka, utveckla och sätta struktur i verksamheten.

Epiroc i Kalmar är mitt i den största expansionen i företagets 60-åriga historia till följd av konsolidering av produktion inom koncernen. Idag tillverkar vi världsledande hydrauliska produkter till gruv- och anläggningsindustrin och nu utökar vi detta sortiment vilket innebär tillväxt av såväl kapacitet och personal som omsättning. Vi kommer att ta oss an nya tekniker inom bearbetning och värmebehandling, utöka vår montering och göra vårt tekniska labb redo för att testa och utveckla nya, större produkter. Vi passar också på att modernisera vår materialhantering. Vi har påbörjat en efterlängtad resa och hoppas att du är rätt person att följa med!

Din missionSom Produktionsledare får du en nyckelroll i produktionsledningen och ansvarar för att leda vårt team inom maskinbearbetning. Tillsammans säkerställer ni ett effektivt, hållbart och flexibelt produktionsflöde. Du rapporterar till Produktionschef och är en aktiv del av Produktionens ledningsgrupp, där ni tillsammans skapar produkter och team i världsklass.

Du blir en del av ett engagerat och inkluderande team där samarbete, öppenhet och utveckling är centrala värderingar. Vi arbetar nära varandra över funktionella gränser och tar tillvara på både idéer och insikter från våra medarbetare. Här får du en verklig möjlighet att påverka och bidra till ett säkert, hållbart och effektivt produktionsflöde.

I rollen ansvarar du för ett team om totalt cirka 25 medarbetare i produktionsavsnittet maskinbearbetning. Som ledare ansvarar du för att leda och fördela arbetet mot uppsatta mål samt för att utveckla dina medarbetare genom bland annat medarbetarsamtal, kompetensutveckling och ett aktivt arbetsmiljöarbete. En viktig del av ditt uppdrag är också att skapa en trygg arbetsmiljö och en stark sammanhållning i gruppen.

Placering och resorDenna position är placerad i Kalmar, Sverige. Resor kan förekomma i tjänsten.

Livet på Epiroc När du blir en del av Epiroc kan du förvänta dig en atmosfär av kreativitet, innovation och mångfald. Du kommer att vara en del av en grupp skickliga och hjälpsamma kollegor som alla lever efter våra kärnvärden: samarbete, engagemang och innovation. Vi arbetar i en global miljö med över 113 nationaliteter.

Ansökan och kontaktI den här rekryteringsprocessen arbetar vi med löpande urval. Skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, dock senast 2026-08-16. För frågor angående rekryteringsprocessen eller ansökan vänligen kontakta: Maria Tedsjö, Rekryteringsspecialist, maria.tedsjo@external.epiroc.com.För frågor om tjänsten vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef: Lars Björk, acting Production Manager, lars.bjork@epiroc.com



Profile description:

Din profilFör att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har eftergymnasial utbildning inom relevant område och flera års erfarenhet av ledande arbete i en dynamisk produktionsmiljö. Du har god förståelse för produktionsprocesser gärna med teknisk kompetens.Du har arbetslivserfarenhet från industrin och behärskar svenska flytande samt har goda kunskaper i engelska, både i tal och skrift.



Som person är du en trygg och närvarande ledare som skapar engagemang genom förtroende, förståelse och delaktighet. Du har förmågan att coacha både individer och team mot gemensamma mål och ser ständiga förbättringar som en naturlig del av vardagen. Du är lösningsorienterad, flexibel och har lätt för att samarbeta, bygga relationer och kommunicera tydligt – även när tempot är högt och förutsättningarna förändras.



Vi värdesätter stort om du har ett intresse för digitalisering och förbättringsarbete samt en vilja att driva utveckling tillsammans med ditt team. Hos oss får du möjlighet att ta ett tydligt ledarskap, påverka arbetssätt och vara med och accelerera transformationen av vår produktion.



Våra ledarskapsförväntningarPå Epiroc förväntar vi oss att våra ledare är inspiratörer, pådrivare och nytänkare. Vi värdesätter ledare som går före med gott exempel och har modet att utmana det etablerade. Säkerhet och hållbarhet är våra högsta prioriteringar, och vi förväntar oss att våra ledare aktivt främjar säkerhet, inkludering och mångfald, samtidigt som de sätter medarbetarnas välmående och kontinuerliga utveckling i fokus. Vi söker dig som har modet att tro på nya idéer och ser möjligheter där andra ser utmaningar.

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Analyst at MSD
jobs.description:
MSD Sweden is seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst to play a critical role in driving data-driven decision-making across the organization. This is an exciting opportunity for a highly analytical professional to work at the intersection of commercial strategy, market intelligence, customer analytics, and business performance. The role partners closely with cross-functional stakeholders across local Commercial, Marketing, Medical, Finance, and regional and global teams to deliver actionable insights that support growth, enhanced customer engagement, and strategic decision-making.

The Business Intelligence Analyst will be responsible for analyzing market, customer, and competitive data to identify opportunities and trends that inform business strategy. The role will lead the development and maintenance of dashboards, reporting solutions, and centralized data platforms that provide stakeholders with timely and meaningful insights. In addition, the position will support product launches, sales force effectiveness initiatives, omnichannel performance analysis, and forecasting activities through advanced analytics and predictive modeling.

Acting as MSD Sweden's local Data & Analytics point of contact, the successful candidate will drive the adoption of analytics capabilities and help build data literacy across the organization. The role requires strong analytical skills, expertise in business intelligence and visualization tools, and the ability to communicate complex findings to a diverse range of stakeholders.

Success in this position will depend on the ability to lead complex projects, influence cross-functional teams, and translate data into actionable recommendations that support MSD Sweden's commercial and organizational objectives.

jobs.title: Test Engineer to the Production Team
jobs.description:
Scienta Omicron is a leading provider of instruments for surface science and nanotechnology. From its technology centers in Uppsala and Taunusstein, the company develops and manufactures high end systems for electron spectroscopy, scanning probe microscopy and thin film deposition in ultra-high vacuum

Scienta Omicron’s solutions are used by top universities, research institutes and industrial R&D labs worldwide to develop new materials for batteries, quantum technologies, next generation electronics, solar cells and advanced sensors. The technologies have supported several Nobel Prize winning research projects and are available as standard modular systems, “Materials Innovation Platforms” and tailored concepts for specific research needs.

Beyond instruments, Scienta Omicron builds long term partnerships through project planning, system design, equipment training, applications support and upgrades, across more than 30 experimental techniques. This combination of technology and support helps complex research infrastructure deliver value over many years.

We are now adding a new colleague to our Production Team based in Uppsala, Sweden. Our Production Team covers a wide range of functions including instrument assembly, testing, purchasing and managing logistics. This role is a great opportunity to be part of a growing high-tech company, in which you will have a profound influence in delivering world-leading scientific instruments. Our industry is highly international with customers based at Research Agencies and Universities around the world.

This position is responsible for part of the final testing of our instruments before they are delivered to our customers worldwide. Some of the instruments that we produce in Uppsala are the hemispherical photoelectron analyzers DA20, DA30, DFS30, HiPP 3, EW4000, Argus CU and the photon sources SX300, DSX400 and VUV5k.

Your Profile

·      PhD in physics or similar field

·      Experience in using Photo Electron Spectroscopy equipment, and Ultra High Vacuum (UHV) technology

·      Knowledge of instrument testing and production

·      Good understanding of complex technical parts

·      Hands on experience of building UHV systems

·      Proactive and creative problem-solving skills

·      Fluent in business English (verbal and written)

·      Ambition to learn Swedish (if not native)

·      Drive, energy and result oriented team player attributes

The workplace is located at Danmarksgatan 22, Uppsala, Sweden.

We will review applications and conduct interviews on a rolling basis.

jobs.title: Mobiililaiteteknikko ja asiakaspalvelija
jobs.description:
**Haluatko mobiililaitteiden huollon ja asiakaspalvelun mestariksi?**

iTapsan Turun myymälä etsii nyt uusia vahvistuksia riveihinsä asiakaspalvelun ja laitehuollon tehtäviin!

Tarjoamme monipuolisen työn, jossa pääset auttamaan asiakkaitamme arjen laiteongelmissa sekä huoltamaan mobiililaitteita. Tehtävä sopii sinulle, jos olet asiakaspalveluhenkinen, kiinnostunut elektroniikasta ja innokas oppimaan uutta.

**Edellytämme sinulta noin 1-2 vuoden aiempaa kokemusta laitehuollosta ja myymälätyöstä**, jotta pääset sujuvasti mukaan työtehtäviin.

Jos sinulla on intoa korjata tekniikkaa, nautit ihmisten auttamisesta ja haluat työpaikan, jossa yksikään päivä ei ole samanlainen, laita rohkeasti hakemusta tulemaan!

iTapsa on yksi Suomen laitehuoltoalan pioneereista olemme huoltaneet puhelimia, tabletteja ja tietokoneita jo vuodesta 2012.

**Mitä pääset tekemään?**

Työsi on monipuolinen yhdistelmä teknistä osaamista ja ensiluokkaista asiakaspalvelua. Olet tärkeä osa myymälämme arkea ja varmistat, että asiakkaat lähtevät meiltä tyytyväisinä.

Päivittäisiin tehtäviisi kuuluu:

- Asiakkaiden vastaanottaminen ja heidän auttamisensa laiteongelmissa

- Puhelinten, tablettien ja tietokoneiden huolto sekä vikadiagnostiikka

- Uudistettujen laitteiden myynti sekä ostoarvioiden tekeminen

- Huoltotöiden kirjaaminen ja hallinta järjestelmissämme

- Myymälän yleisestä viihtyvyydestä ja sujuvasta asiakaskokemuksesta huolehtiminen


**Millaista työkaveria etsimme?**

Etsimme ennen kaikkea oikeaa asennetta. Vaikka sinulla on jo hieman kokemusta alalta, tärkeintä on aito halu kehittyä ja oppia lisää!

Toivomme sinulta:

- Noin 1-2 vuoden kokemusta laitehuollosta ja myymälätyöstä

- Motivaatiota ja oppimishalua: olet valmis kehittämään osaamistasi ja nautit uuden oppimisesta

- Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja: nautit asiakaskohtaamisista ja osaat selittää asioita selkeästi

- Huolellisuutta: käsittelet laitteita vastuullisesti ja tarkasti

- Oma-aloitteisuutta: toimit itsenäisesti ja pidät huolen myymälän sujuvasta arjesta

- Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa


**Miksi tulla töihin iTapsalle?**

Meillä et ole vain työntekijä, vaan osa rentoa ja ammattitaitoista tiimiä.

- **Opit arvokkaita taitoja:** kerrytät osaamista asiakaspalvelusta, myymälän pyörittämisestä, laitehuollosta ja myynnistä

- **Kehityt ammattilaisena:** saat monipuolista työkokemusta teknisestä ja asiakaslähtöisestä työstä

- **Rento työilmapiiri:** työskentelet tiimissä, jossa huumori ja hyvä fiilis kulkevat mukana kiireessäkin

- **Kattava perehdytys:** tuemme sinua alusta asti, kunnes hallitset tehtävät itsenäisesti


**Näin haet meille**

Kiinnostuitko? Hienoa, laita rohkeasti hakemusta tulemaan!

Lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi sähköpostitse osoitteeseen myynti@itapsa.com. Kerro meille kuka olet, miksi haluat iTapsalle ja milloin voisit aloittaa. Muistathan laittaa sähköpostin otsikoksi **"Työhakemus iTapsa Turku"**.

Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikat heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Hakuaika päättyy 31.8.2026.

Palkkaus määräytyy kaupan alan työehtosopimuksen mukaan.

jobs.title: Unicon søger pumpechauffør til Sjælland
jobs.description:
Vil du arbejde med store maskiner, tage ansvar på komplekse byggeprojekter og være den, der får betonen sikkert frem til målet?

Hos Unicon søger vi en pumpechauffør til vores team i Avedøre. Har du den rette erfaring, tekniske forståelse og motivation, hjælper vi dig eventuelt med det nødvendige kørekort og de relevante certifikater. I videoen nederst kan du se eksempler på det udstyr, du skal køre og betjene.

Du kan naturligvis være Pumpechauffør i dag, men du kan lige så godt være uddannet maskinfører eller have tilsvarende erfaring. Du kan også være i entreprenørbranchen, betonbranchen eller landbruget. Det vigtigste er, at du trives med store maskiner, kan tage ansvar og bevare overblikket, når opgaverne bliver komplekse.

Du får ansvar for en af byggepladsens vigtigste opgaver

Som pumpechauffør hos Unicon er du specialist på byggepladsen. Du arbejder tæt sammen med kolleger, betonchauffører, byggeledere og kunder for at sikre, at støbningen bliver gennemført sikkert, effektivt og i den rigtige kvalitet.

Du er med til at sikre, at betonen bliver leveret og pumpet i den rette hastighed, så støbningen forløber som planlagt, og kunden får det resultat, der er aftalt. Det kræver både teknisk forståelse, gode samarbejdsevner og evnen til at træffe beslutninger, når forholdene ændrer sig.

Som pumpechauffør kører du pumpebilen fra fabrikken til byggepladsen. Her placerer du udstyret sikkert – ofte under trange forhold – og opsætter pumpen, så den passer til den konkrete opgave. Når støbningen går i gang, betjener du det avancerede pumpeudstyr og fungerer som kundens sparringspartner på pladsen.

Unicon er markedsleder i Danmark, og du bliver en del af projekter, der sætter varige spor i samfundet – fra boligbyggeri og infrastruktur til større erhvervs- og anlægsprojekter.

Hvem er du?

Din vej til jobbet kan være forskellig, men vi forestiller os, at du opfylder mindst ét af disse kriterier:

  • Uddannet maskinfører eller tilsvarende erfaring

  • Erfaring med beton- og støbearbejde

  • Erfaring med større maskiner og processer fra f.eks. landbrug eller industri

  • Erfaring med kraner, entreprenørmateriel eller andet teknisk udstyr

  • Relevant erfaring fra entreprenør- eller byggebranchen

Lige så vigtigt er det, at du:

  • Trives med ansvar og selvstændige beslutninger

  • Har en god teknisk og mekanisk forståelse

  • Er samarbejdsorienteret og serviceminded

  • Kan bevare overblikket, når tempoet er højt

  • Arbejder sikkert, struktureret og løsningsorienteret

Stort kørekort og EU-bevis er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Har du den rette profil, tilbyder vi den nødvendige oplæring samt mulighed for at opnå relevante kørekort og certifikater.

Derfor skal du vælge Unicon

Hos Unicon bliver du en del af Danmarks førende betonproducent og et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, hvor sikkerhed, kvalitet og samarbejde går hånd i hånd.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Grundig oplæring og introduktion til jobbet

  • Moderne udstyr og spændende arbejdsopgaver

  • Mulighed for at få relevante kørekort og certifikater gennem Unicon

  • Betalt arbejdstøjsordning inklusive vask

  • Gode udviklingsmuligheder – både fagligt og personligt

  • Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab og en unik holdånd

  • Branchens bedste ansættelsesforhold

En arbejdsform med frihed, ansvar og gode muligheder for afspadsering

Som pumpechauffør arbejder du ikke efter et traditionelt 7-15-skema.

Når en større støbning er i gang, bliver vi på pladsen, til opgaven er løst. Derfor vil du opleve perioder med lange arbejdsdage og en del overarbejde. Til gengæld får du både den løn, der følger med, og gode muligheder for at opspare afspadsering – ofte i form af hele fridage.

Mange af vores pumpechauffører sætter pris på friheden og variationen i jobbet. Nogle dage er kortere, andre længere, men fælles for dem alle er, at man arbejder sammen om at få opgaven sikkert i mål.

Hvis du trives med ansvar, variation og tanken om at gøre arbejdet færdigt frem for at kigge på klokken, vil du passe godt ind hos os.

Sådan bliver du en del af holdet

Kan du se dig selv i rollen, hører vi gerne fra dig – også selvom du ikke opfylder alle kravene på papiret.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Ib Jepsen på telefon 2484 0935.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi finder den rette kandidat.

Om Unicon

Hos Unicon tror vi på, at forskellighed skaber stærkere teams. Vi arbejder aktivt for et inkluderende arbejdsmiljø, hvor alle medarbejdere behandles med respekt, værdighed og lige muligheder.

Ansættelser sker på baggrund af kvalifikationer, kompetencer og potentiale, og vi opfordrer alle kvalificerede kandidater til at søge uanset baggrund.

jobs.title: Project Manager – Workplace Services (RFP & Transition), Espoo
jobs.description:

This is a unique opportunity to drive a business-critical sourcing initiative from planning through execution, with the possibility to continue leading the implementation and transition project during the first half of 2027.

If you enjoy bringing structure to complex environments, working closely with business stakeholders and vendors, and ensuring projects are delivered on time and within budget, this could be the next step in your career.

What you'll be doing

Your responsibilities will include:

- Leading and coordinating the overall RFP project

- Managing project plans, schedules, budgets and reporting

- Coordinating meetings, workshops and steering group activities

- Managing communication with business stakeholders and external vendors

- Coordinating vendor questions and responses throughout the RFP process

- Supporting proposal evaluation and scoring activities

- Following up on deliverables, deadlines and project milestones

- Managing project governance, risks and change management

- Coordinating project resources and dependencies across different teams

- Ensuring project transparency through regular reporting

- Supporting project financial follow-up and value creation

- Ensuring cyber security governance and compliance throughout the project


Should the project continue into 2027, you'll also have the opportunity to lead the implementation and transition of the selected Workplace Services solution.

We're looking for someone with

To succeed in this role, you're an experienced Project Manager who enjoys working in complex enterprise IT environments. You're organised, proactive and comfortable coordinating multiple stakeholders while keeping projects moving forward.

You have:

- 5+ years of experience in IT Project Management

- Experience leading enterprise-level IT projects

- Experience managing project budgets, reporting and governance

- Strong stakeholder and vendor management skills

- Experience coordinating cross-functional teams

- Knowledge of IT Service Management (ITSM)

- Understanding of IT service delivery

- Experience working with Workplace Services and Service Desk environments

- Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) tools

- Transition and transformation projects

- Application Management Services (AMS)

- Enterprise Workplace Services

- Service integration models

- Large-scale outsourcing or sourcing projects

- Cyber security governance within project environments


We believe you'll thrive in this role if you have experience with

- Leading complex enterprise IT projects

- RFP or sourcing projects

- Cross-functional stakeholder management

- Vendor management and contract-related projects

- Service Desk and Workplace Services

- ITSM environments

- ServiceNow

- Managing project governance, risks and reporting

- Driving structured projects with multiple parallel workstreams


Rather than looking for someone who only has traditional project management experience, we're particularly interested in someone who can combine strong organisational skills with an understanding of enterprise IT services and confidently collaborate with both business stakeholders and technical teams.

Additional requirements

**Please note!** We only accept applications submitted through our platform and will not respond to applications sent via email.

About Clevry

For over 30 years we have been the change maker for a more soft skills driven work-life within talent acquisition, assessments and advisory. We operate globally with customers, consultants and candidates from North America to Singapore with headquarters in Brighton, Stockholm and Helsinki. At Clevry we have over 150 soft skills certified recruiters, business psychologists and experts at your service.

jobs.title: Assistant Controller, Golf GameBook
jobs.description:
_Golf GameBook is a leading scorecard app with a mission to make golf more fun, easier and simpler for golfers of all levels – on and off the course. Founded in 2007, we set out to modernize golf by replacing traditional paper scorecards with a digital, social experience that brings golfers closer together._

_We believe golf is more than just a game – its about connection, shared moments, and enjoyment both on and off the course. With Golf GameBook, golfers can track live scores, share comments, photos, and videos, and stay connected with their golf community in a fun and effortless way._

_Today, Golf GameBook is used by over 2 million golfers worldwide, with more than 70 million rounds played through the app. As we continue to grow, were always looking for new talent with fresh ideas to help shape the future of golf._

**Would you be our new Assistant Controller?**

As an Assistant Controller, you will join Golf GameBooks finance team in a newly established role created to support our continued growth and international expansion. Working closely with our Head of Finance, you will be involved in a broad range of finance activities and gain a wide understanding of how finance supports a growing international business.

Your responsibilities will include processing sales and purchase invoices, managing daily cash management activities and supporting the smooth running of day-to-day finance operations. Alongside these responsibilities, you will support and develop monthly financial reporting, maintain and develop KPI reporting, and contribute to ad hoc analyses that support business decision-making.

You will also play an active role in developing internal processes and strengthening the internal control environment. As the finance function continues to evolve, you will have the opportunity to participate in reporting development projects and support the implementation of new technologies, including AI-driven solutions.

This is a full-time, permanent position starting as soon as possible. The role is based at our office in Espoo and follows a hybrid working model, with the possibility to work remotely one day per week.

**What are we looking for?**

We are looking for someone with 1–3 years of relevant experience in finance, accounting, controlling or auditing, together with a relevant educational background (BSc or MSc). You understand how financial processes work in practice and feel comfortable taking ownership of recurring finance tasks while also contributing to the development of reporting, processes and controls. Experience with Netvisor or a similar financial management system, combined with solid Excel skills, will help you succeed in the role.

Fluency in Finnish and English is required, and Swedish language skills are considered a plus. Experience from a technology company, subscription-based business, or another consumer-focused business environment is considered an advantage. Familiarity with BI tools, data analysis and reporting will help you succeed in the role.

As a person, you are detail-oriented, reliable and proactive. You enjoy working in a growth company where you can take ownership of your work and have a genuine impact on how things are done. We believe you will thrive in this role if you are curious by nature, eager to learn and motivated by developing both processes and your own expertise. While you don't need to be a golfer yourself, an interest in the sport or the industry can help you feel right at home in our team.

**Why us?**

SEINÄJOKI

Haemme ravintolatyöntekijöitä Eepeen ABC:n ja Maran henkilöstöpooliin
Avoinna olevat ravintolatyöntekijän työtehtävät ovat vakituisia, osa-aikaisin työtunnein, keskimäärin 36-72h/3vko ja työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan.Haemme tekijöitä laajasti poolin eri toimialueille eli rannikon, Suupohjan, Härmänmaan sekä Seinäjoen ja lähikuntien alueille. Mikäli sinua kiinnostaa henkilöstöpoolissa työskentely Eepeen ABC - liikennekaupan ja Maran ravintolamaailma toimipaikoissa hae mukaan!

Henkilöstöpoolissa työskentely on monipuolista ja vaihtelevaa – yksikään työpäivä ei ole samanlainen! Pooli on tosi tykätty, joustava ja monipuolinen työskentelymalli, jossa työntekijät pääsevät työskentelemään joustavasti useissa Eepeen toimipaikoissa. Henkilöstöpoolilaisena sinulle kasvaa monipuolinen osaaminen ravintolan työtehtävistä. Poolin tavoitteena on helpottaa yksiköiden arkea, tuoden apua ja osaamista sinne, missä sitä eniten tarvitaan.

Avoinna olevat työtehtävät ABC:n ja maran henkilöstöpoolissa ovat ravintolatyöntekijän työtä. Ravintolatyöntekijät työskentelevät tyypillisesti ravintolamaailmassa tai liikennemyymälässä ja tekevät monipuolisia ravintola-alan tehtäviä, kutenmyynti- ja asiakaspalvelu-, keittiö- ja hesburgerin työtehtäviä. Poolilainen on todellinen arjen moniosaaja ja osaamisen lähettiläs, joka vie hyviä käytäntöjä toimipaikasta toiseen. Hän pääsee auttamaan toimipaikkoja, joilla on äkillinen tarve saada huippu työkaveri avuksi.Poolilaisella on useampi työnteon yksikkö, ja alussa on kattava ja käytännönläheinen perehdytysjakso, jonka aikana ravintolan toimintatavat tulevat tutuiksi. Meillä työskennellään yhdessä tiimin kanssa, joten toivomme sinulta hyviä yhteistyötaitoja. Työ edellyttää oman auton käyttöä ja liikkumista alueen henkilöstöpoolin yksiköissä.

Aikaisempi kokemus ravintola-alan tehtävistä on hyödyksi, muttapositiivinen asenne ja aito halu oppia ja tehdä asiakaspalvelutyötä ovat kaikkein tärkeintä menestyäksesi tehtävässä

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja, Ikääntyneiden palvelut, Asumispalvelut, Turku
jobs.description:
Tehtäväsi

Työskentelet lähihoitajana asukaslähtöisesti ja asukkaan toimintakykyä tukien Runosmäen kaupunginosassa sijaitsevassa Villa Piiparin yksikössä. Työsi sisältää asukkaan hoitosuunnitelman mukaista perus- ja lääkehoitoa, toimintakyvyn ja hoidon tarpeen arviointia sekä kulttuuri- ja harrastetoiminnan toteuttamista. Hyödynnät RAI-mittaristoa systemaattisesti asiakkaan toimintakyvyn arvioinnissa ja käytät RAI-tuloksia hoidon suunnittelussa ja arvioinnissa. Laadukas, ajantasainen päivittäiskirjaaminen on keskeinen osa työtäsi.

Toimit itseohjautuvasti, mutta et koskaan yksin, saat vastuun rinnalle työyhteisön tuen. Työhösi kuuluu opiskelijoiden ohjaus sekä päivittäinen omaisyhteistyö. Asukas- ja työturvallisuus ovat meille ensiarvoisen tärkeitä, ja työssä hyödynnetään teknologisia ratkaisuja sekä ergonomisia apuvälineitä. Kunnioitat asukkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta ja oikeutta hyvään loppuelämään.

Työpaikka sijaitsee osoitteessa Varusmestarintie 14, 20360 Turku, ja meille pääsee helposti julkisilla kulkuneuvoilla.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Saat yksilöllisen perehdytyksen ja mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa työvuorosuunnitteluun. Arvostamme laaja-alaista osaamista ja tuemme osaamisen kehittämistä organisaatiossamme. Pääset työskentelemään ympärivuorokautisia asumis- ja hoivapalveluja tarjoavassa yksikössä, jossa aito läsnäolo ja asukkaan voimavarojen ylläpitäminen ovat toiminnan ytimessä.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Odotamme sinulta vahvaa RAI-osaamista ja kykyä hyödyntää sitä toiminnan suunnittelussa ja arvioinnissa sekä ajantasaista päivittäiskirjaamisen taitoa. Hallitset vastuualueesi, toimit ratkaisukeskeisesti ja olet motivoitunut kehittämään osaamistasi hoitotyön ammattilaisena. Työtehtävässä edellytetään, että ymmärtää toimintaan vaikuttavat lait ja säännökset sekä osaa soveltaa niitä käytännön työssä. Lisäksi tulee hallita omavalvonnan periaatteet, jotta palvelun laatu ja asiakasturvallisuus varmistuvat. Työ edellyttää hyvää suomen kielen taitoa.

Eduksi luemme voimassa olevan LOVelääkeluvan, kokemuksen muistisairaiden hoidosta ja toimintakykyä tukevasta työskentelystä sekä OMNI360 ja RAIosaamisen ja hyvät tietotekniset taidot.

Tehtävän kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon ammatillinen perustutkinto (lähihoitaja) tai alan aikaisempi kouluasteinen tutkinto sekä voimassa oleva rekisteröinti JulkiTerhikki- ja JulkiSuosikki-rekisterissä.

Hae mukaan tekemään merkityksellistä työtä ikääntyneiden parissa Villa Piipariin - odotamme hakemustasi. Etenemme rekrytoinnissa jo hakuaikana ja täytämme tehtävän sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

jobs.title: FM Category Lead (Energy & Utilities)
jobs.employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
jobs.description:
Job Description

Are you interested in shaping how energy and utilities are managed at a global scale? We are looking for a FM Category Lead within Energy & Utilities to join our Global Facilities Management team.



In this role, you will lead H&M Group’s global energy and utilities agenda, driving energy performance, cost efficiency, and sustainability goals through strategy, governance, supplier collaboration, and scalable energy-saving initiatives across brands and markets

WHAT YOU’LL DO

As FM Category Lead within Energy and Utilities, you will provide global category leadership by setting the direction for how H&M Group manages energy consumption, utilities costs and energy-related performance across markets. You will develop strategies, standards, tools, and ways of working that support energy reduction, cost optimisation, and long-term asset performance.

You will act as a global subject-matter expert, supporting markets with guidance, best practice, and implementation of energy-efficient solutions. This includes working with energy data, KPIs, business cases, supplier input and market performance follow-up to identify opportunities, drive improvements and enable clear decision-making.

If you are motivated by the idea of combining technical understanding, sustainability impact and global stakeholder influence, this role offers a strong opportunity to make your mark. It will suit you if you enjoy translating complex energy and utilities topics into clear actions, building alignment across markets and functions, and driving initiatives from strategy to implementation

Your responsibilities include, but not limited to:

    Define and drive the global Energy & Utilities strategy across brands and markets
    Set energy, cost, and sustainability targets, KPIs, and performance standards
    Identify and scale energy-efficient and cost-effective solutions across the portfolio
    Establish global standards, guidelines, and tools for energy management and installations
    Ensure accurate data, reporting, and performance tracking across markets
    Develop frameworks for business cases, investment planning, and asset performance
    Drive and monitor global energy initiatives, identifying risks and improvement opportunities
    Support markets with energy procurement, vendor evaluations, and regulatory insights
    Strengthen energy management capabilities through training, knowledge sharing, and cross-functional collaboration
    Monitor industry trends, technologies, and regulations to drive continuous improvement and sustainability outcomes

WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for people with…

    At least 3-5 years experience in energy management, utilities optimisation or building energy systems
    A bachelor’s degree within Facilities Management, Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Property Management, or equivalent
    Proven experience setting and implementing energy strategies, preferably across multiple sites, markets, or regions
    Experience identifying and implementing energy-efficient solutions, technical improvements, and consumption reduction initiatives
    Experience working with HVAC systems, building automation, lightning systems, and energy monitoring tools  
    Strong understanding of performance follow-up, KPI steering and cost management for energy and utilities consumption
    Experience working cross-functionally with a wide range of stakeholders

And people who are…

    Analytical and structured, with the ability to balance strategic and operational perspectives
    Confident communicators who can influence and align stakeholders across markets and functions  
    Proactive and solution-oriented, comfortable leading initiatives from idea to implementation
    Collaborative and supportive, with a strong focus on knowledge sharing and capability building  
    Motivated by sustainability, responsible energy management, and the opportunity to contribute to long-term energy reduction  

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

This is a full-time permanent position based in our Head Office in Stockholm. This role reports to the Head of Construction & Facilities. If your experience, skills, and ambitions align with this role, please submit your application at your earliest convenience. Please note that we will review applications and interview on a rolling basis.

WHO WE ARE

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.  

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.  

JOIN US

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it is our people who make us who we are.

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.



We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

jobs.title: Digital Product Designer
jobs.employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
jobs.description:
Job Description

The role is based in Stockholm, with an expectation of being onsite at least 4 days per week.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

As a Digital Product Designer in Retail Tech, you’ll help shape the tools and experiences that support everyday work in H&M stores around the world. This is a role where design has a direct impact on both store colleagues and customers, making complex retail operations feel simpler, smoother, and more intuitive.

You’ll work close to the reality of our stores, understanding how colleagues use digital tools in fast-paced environments and turning those insights into thoughtful, scalable design solutions. From simplifying workflows to improving key touchpoints in the store journey, you’ll help create experiences that remove friction and enable teams to focus on what matters most: delivering a great customer experience.

You will:

    Continuously test, iterate, and improve experiences based on performance data and user insights.
    Ensure designs are feasible, scalable, and aligned with platform capabilities and design systems.
    Present design concepts clearly, grounded in user insights and product strategy.
    Design inclusive experiences using accessibility best practices (including WCAG guidelines).
    Facilitate workshops that drive alignment and shared direction.
    Define and track UX metrics to measure design impact.
    Stay on top of industry trends and integrate best practices into your work.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

You will join the Digital Product Design organization at H&M, a diverse, global community of designers and researchers working across multiple Areas.

You’ll collaborate closely with cross‑functional product teams as well as colleagues in Tech, Marketing, and Commercial functions.  

WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for people with…

    Experience designing internal tools, B2B products, or operational systems (e.g. back‑office, workflows, task management).
    Experience designing for real-world usage contexts (e.g. shared devices, in‑store environments, time‑critical workflows).
    Experience working in fast-moving environments with changing priorities and multiple stakeholders.
    Strong ability to balance creativity with data-informed decision making.
    Experience designing for native Android applications.
    Strong interaction design skills, with the ability to simplify complex tasks and workflows.
    Experience using both qualitative and quantitative research methods.
    Proven experience working with Design Systems and system‑thinking in design.
    Strong communication skills and the ability to bring clarity in ambiguous situations.
    A self‑directed mindset and experience leading design initiatives end‑to‑end.
    Proficiency in tools such as Figma, Miro, UserZoom and Jira.

And people who are…

    Energized by bringing ideas to life quickly and iterating based on real user behavior
    Collaborative, transparent, and comfortable working in cross‑functional teams.
    Motivated by creating real user and business value.
    Curious, humble, and open to continuous learning.
    Driven by impact, ownership, and a thriving team culture.
    Grounded in trust, psychological safety, and open communication.

Who We Are

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.  

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.  

This role is based out of Stockholm, Sweden. For this we role are unable to provide relocation assistance or visa sponsorship. Applicants must have existing work authorization for the country in which the role is located.

Liikunnanohjaaja vastaa erilaisten ja eri-ikäisille suunnattujen terveysliikuntaryhmien ohjauksesta sekä alkeisuimakoulujen ja koululaisuintien ohjaamisesta.

Tehtävään sisältyvät uinninvalvonta, asiakaspalvelu ja uimahallin asiakkaiden turvallisuudesta huolehtiminen. Työn tavoitteena on edistää eri-ikäisten liikkumista, terveyttä ja hyvinvointia.

Liikunnanohjaaja osallistuu uimahallin toiminnan ja liikuntapalveluiden suunnitteluun yhdessä muun henkilöstön kanssa. Liikunnanohjaaja suunnittelee ja toteuttaa erilaisia liikuntatapahtumia. Yhteistyö oppilaitosten, varhaiskasvatusyksiköiden, liikunta- ja urheiluseurojen ja muiden alan sidosryhmien kanssa kuuluu tehtäviin.

Liikunnanohjaajan tehtävä edellyttää vastuullisuutta, riittävää fyysistä toimintakykyä, erinomaisia vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä monipuolisia liikunnanohjaustaitoja. Lisäksi työ edellyttää oman osaamisen jatkuvaa kehittämistä sekä pelastus-, ja ensiaputaitojen ylläpitoa. Olet uimahallin liikunnanohjaajien tiimin jäsen ja sinulla on hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot.

Työ sisältää ilta- ja viikonlopputyötä.

Tehtävän kelpoisuusehtona on soveltuva alempi korkeakoulututkinto tai liikunnanohjauksen perustutkinto tai vastaava liikunta-alan koulutus.

Uimahallin liikunnanohjaajalta edellytetään hyväksytysti suoritettua uinninvalvojan testiuintia ennen valintapäätöksen tekemistä.

Tehtävään valitun tulee esittää hyväksytty rikosrekisteriote (laki lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä 504/2022).

Hakuaika alkaa 5.8.2026. Hakuaika päättyy 26.8.2026 klo 12.00.

Haastatteluja pidetään viikolla 36. Haastattelusta jatkoon päässeet antavat vielä sovittuna ajankohtana lyhyen ohjausnäytön.

Työ alkaa 14.9.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Vapaamuotoiset hakemukset ansioluetteloineen pyydetään jättämään KuntaRekryyn.

jobs.title: Technical Storekeeper
jobs.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

The Technical Storekeeper is responsible for handling and managing the receiving, storage, and processing of incoming and outgoing spare parts and technical supplies at one or more Carnival Corporation owned and operated global destination. This role supports the overall management of inventory levels, ensuring that all materials are accurately accounted for, properly stored, and readily available for technical teams as needed. The Technical Storekeeper monitors stock levels, maintains accurate records, coordinates with procurement for replenishment, and ensures compliance with company policies and safety standards. The position requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work collaboratively with maintenance and technical staff to support smooth operational workflows.

  • Inventory Management and Record Keeping
  • Keep accurate records regarding stock counts, requirements, and reporting needs.
  • Review and issue a weekly inventory list of technical spares.
  • Update and maintain system records upon arrival of new parts and tools.
  • Label and maintain all tools, equipment, and spare parts.
  • Audit incoming materials for accurate paperwork and counts.
  • Confirm deliveries against invoices for accuracy of store count.
  • Monitor inventory levels to prevent shortages or overstock situations.
  • Track usage of spare parts to support maintenance planning and budgeting.
  • Ordering and Procurement Support
  • Place requests for all parts necessary for the storeroom for review and approval.
  • Assist with purchasing items and materials as needed.
  • Liaise with staff, management, and vendors to source supplies efficiently.
  • Coordinate with procurement teams to ensure timely delivery of parts.
  • Review vendor quotes and maintain records of supplier transactions.
  • Suggest alternatives for unavailable or discontinued parts.
  • Stores Organization and Receiving
  • Maintain stores in an organized and well-ordered manner.
  • Assist with unloading containers, sorting, counting, and receiving materials.
  • Ensure proper storage, handling, and labeling of all parts and tools.
  • Implement storage systems to maximize space and accessibility.
  • Conduct regular inspections to ensure cleanliness and orderliness of storerooms.
  • Follow safety protocols when handling heavy or hazardous materials.
  • Reporting, Compliance, and Other Duties
  • Create required reports related to inventory, usage, and discrepancies.
  • Uphold environmental policies and procedures in all store operations.
  • Document and report any damaged or defective parts to management.
  • Perform any other duties assigned by management.
  • Support cross-functional teams by providing required spare parts and technical materials.
  • Assist in audits and inspections as needed.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Needed

  • Ability to adhere to the companyâs standards regarding dress and appearance.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and data protection standards when handling vendor financial or business documents
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment as necessary.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to multitask effectively.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with data entry and reporting tools.
  • Detail orientated with a proactive approach to problem solving.
  • Ability to multi-task and think critically
  • Problem-solving and decision-making abilities
  • Strong planning and coordination skills, especially in handling multiple priorities under tight deadlines.
  • Must be physically fit.
  • Ability to work in an outdoor environment as needed.
  • May need to stand for long periods of time.
  • May be requested to work a shift schedule while at any of the destinations.
  • Knowledge: Understanding of workplace policies and procedures / Familiarity with team collaboration tools and techniques.
  • Skills: Strong time management and organizational skills
  • Abilities: Ability to maintain reliable and consistent attendance / Capacity to be punctual and meet deadlines / Ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues and work as part of a team / Demonstrated professionalism in all interactions and tasks.

HESS Responsibilities

  • Adhere to all company policies, procedures, and guidelines related to health, safety, environmental protection, and security.
  • Take all necessary precautions, use personal protective equipment (PPE), safety devices, and tools correctly and consistently, as required by the nature of the work.
  • Promptly report any unsafe conditions, incidents, or environmental concerns to the appropriate supervisor or HESS representative.
  • Take reasonable care for your own health and safety, as well as that of colleagues and others who may be affected by your actions.
  • Actively participate in HESS trainings and initiatives that promote a safe, secure, and environmentally sustainable workplace.
  • Cooperate fully with company efforts to maintain compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.
  • Seek opportunities to improve safety and environmental performance in daily tasks.

Essential/Minimum Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED ; equivalent experience is required; additional education in Hospitality or a related field is a plus
  • Current Health Certificate

Essential Experience Required

  • A minimum of two (2) years relevant work experience in a technical role
  • Ability to lift at least 50 pounds.
  • Ability to create reports and documentation skills.
  • Analytical and Numerate Skills
  • Strong interpersonal, problem solving, conflict resolution and communication skills.
  • Proficient in English
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office
  • Working knowledge of: Swimming hazards; Beach Hazards; Pool hazards Lifeguard training techniques
  • First aid and Cardio-pulmonary Resuscitation (CPR)
  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.
  • All island employees must be physically able to participate in emergency lifesaving procedures and drills. Full use/range of motion of arms and legs as well as full visual, verbal and hearing abilities are required to receive and give instructions in the event of an emergency.

jobs.title: Pomoc nauczyciela
jobs.description:
Zakres obowiązków: 1. Systematyczna kontrola stanu zabezpieczenia budynku i jego otoczenia w celu zapewnienia bezpieczeństwa wychowankom i pracownikom oraz ochrony mienia placówki.
2.  Realizacja dyżuru głównego, w tym:
a) czuwanie nad właściwą realizacją przebiegu dnia,
b) zapisywanie uwag o włączeniu się sygnalizacji pożarowej,
c) monitorowanie osób z zewnątrz odwiedzających wychowanków,
d) monitorowanie czystości pokoi sypialnych oraz pomieszczeń użytku wspólnego,
e) czuwanie nad ładem i porządkiem w pomieszczeniach bursy,
f) czuwanie nad ładem, porządkiem, kulturą zachowania młodzieży w stołówce,
g) organizacja pomocy medycznej (kontakt z przychodnią itp.),
h) sporządzanie raportów wynikających z rozkładu dnia.
3. Czuwanie nad przestrzeganiem przez wychowanków i gości ciszy nocnej w godzinach 22.00-6.00.
4. Współpraca z wychowawcami w zakresie zapewnienia bezpiecznych warunków pobytu.
5. Zapewnienie w trakcie sprawowania opieki nocnej  bezpieczeństwa młodzieży znajdującej się w placówce.

jobs.title: Nabór na stanowisko Koordynator/ Koordynatorka rodzinnej pieczy zastępczej
jobs.description:
Zakres obowiązków: 1)Udzielanie pomocy rodzinom zastępczym i prowadzącym rodzinne domy dziecka w realizacji zadań wynikających z pieczy zastępczej.
2)Przygotowanie, we współpracy z asystentem rodziny i odpowiednio rodziną zastępczą lub prowadzącym rodzinny dom dziecka, planu pomocy dziecku.
3)Pomoc rodzinom zastępczym oraz prowadzącym rodzinne domy dziecka w nawiązaniu wzajemnego kontaktu.
4)Zapewnianie rodzinom zastępczym oraz prowadzącym rodzinne domy dziecka dostępu do specjalistycznej pomocy dla dzieci, w tym psychologicznej, reedukacyjnej i rehabilitacyjnej.
5)Zgłaszanie do ośrodków adopcyjnych informacji o dzieciach z uregulowaną sytuacją prawną, w celu poszukiwania dla nich rodzin przysposabiających.
6)Udzielanie wsparcia pełnoletnim wychowankom rodzinnych form pieczy zastępczej.

- konieczne; dobra organizacja pracy własnej, umiejętność pracy w zespole - konieczne; dokładność, opanowanie, odpowiedzialność - konieczne; niekaralność za umyślne przestępstwo lub umyślne przestępstwo skarbowe - konieczne; pełna zdolność do czynności prawnych oraz korzystanie z pełni praw publicznych - konieczne; kandydat nie figuruje w bazie danych Rejestru Sprawców Przestępstw na Tle Seksualnym z dostępem ogranic

jobs.title: Solution Architect (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Main duties

Our Solution Architect plays a pivotal role in translating idea proposals into comprehensive solution design documents. This position involves close collaboration with the Enterprise Architecture team and lead developers to ensure all aspects of the solution are thoroughly documented and aligned with business needs.

    Develop detailed solution design documents based on initial idea proposals and business analysis.
    Create and maintain precise documentation, including data models, infrastructure designs, application maps, and cost impact analyses.
    Ensure all necessary documentation is drafted in collaboration with the Enterprise Architecture team and lead developers.
    Conduct data protection, risk, and security assessments to ensure compliance with company standards and regulatory requirements.
    Oversee the completeness of the solution design, initiating design authority meetings and securing final approval from relevant authorities.
    Participate in the continuous enhancement of the development process.
    Develop and standardise documentation and procedures related to software solution designs and integrations.
    Act as a technical liaison between project stakeholders, including business units, project leaders, and development teams, providing expert advice and guidance on the implementation and operation of IT solutions.
    Provide technical leadership and support to team members, offering insights and solutions to improve project outcomes.

    

Your blueprint for success at Luxair
Essential qualifications:

    A bachelor's degree in Information Technology or an equally compelling story of experience and expertise.
    Proven experience as a Solution Architect or in a similar role within IT architecture and design.
    Exceptional ability to document and articulate complex solutions clearly and effectively.
    Demonstrated ability in leading assessment processes and ensuring compliance with all regulatory and internal guidelines.
    Strong collaborative skills and the ability to work effectively across different teams and disciplines.
    A commitment to continuous learning and a willingness to dive deep into new technologies and tools.
    Excellent level spoken and written communication in English ensuring flawless information dissemination.



Desired or to be acquired required attributes:

    Strong understanding of Oracle databases and the ability to apply this knowledge to solution designs.
    Proficient in various aspects of IT architecture, including integration, data migration, and database management (both Relational and NoSQL), as well as data modelling and application design.
    Demonstrates comprehensive expertise across all phases of the software development life cycle, encompassing analysis, design, data migration, and integration.

jobs.title: Senior Consultant GRIC (m/f)
jobs.description:
Senior Consultant GRIC

Locations Luxembourg
time type Full time
job requisition id JR100099

Operating as an internationally integrated partnership in over 100 countries and territories, Forvis Mazars Group specialises in audit, tax and advisory services. The partnership draws on the expertise and cultural understanding of over 40,000 professionals across the globe to assist clients of all sizes at every stage in their development.

Your future team

Our multidisciplinary GRIC team of professionals is advising clients in various industries of the Financial Sector on how best to meet the regulatory, corporate governance and compliance challenges. We are assisting key function holders (comprising managing / governing bodies, executive management and head of internal control functions) to better understand the regulatory environment and its development and to identify laws and regulations having an impact on their business.
Forvis Mazars Financial Advisory Services is looking for outstanding individuals who will join a dynamic team committed to be the emerging Consulting & Advisory firm in Luxembourg.

Your role

• Provide advisory services to a broad range of financial institutions in Luxembourg (e.g. investment fund managers, electronic payment institutions, banks, investment firms, and other professionals of the financial sector), focusing on operational best practices and regulatory requirements.
• Advise clients on key regulatory matters (e.g. MiFID, ESG, Governance, Risk Management, Compliance, Portfolio Management, AML/CTF) by leading regulatory PMO projects, driving remediation initiatives, and managing deliverables such as gap and benchmark analyses, regulatory due diligences, and application files to Luxembourg authorities.
• Partner with clients throughout the full assignment cycle, from scoping and planning to implementation and post-delivery support, ensuring lasting value creation.
• Oversee and actively manage day-to-day tasks of assigned engagements, ensuring quality, timeliness, and client satisfaction.
• Guide, mentor, and support junior team members, fostering professional development, knowledge-sharing, and effective teamwork.
• Develop and deliver client-facing materials (e.g. presentations, flyers, tenders) on European and Luxembourg regulatory matters to strengthen our service offering and market presence.
• Collaborate with clients' management and the GRIC team to proactively identify new market opportunities, contribute to service innovation, and support business development initiatives.

Your profile

• Master's degree in Law, Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
• At least 3 years of professional experience in the financial sector, with proven expertise in governance, risk management, compliance, or regulatory advisory.
• Good understanding of Luxembourg and EU regulatory frameworks (e.g. MiFID, ESG, Governance, Risk Management, Compliance, AML/CTF).
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into practical, business-oriented solutions.
• Excellent report writing, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate confidently and effectively with senior stakeholders.
• Demonstrated leadership capabilities, including experience in managing projects, guiding junior colleagues, and coordinating cross-functional teams.
• Strong organizational skills, with the ability to deliver high-quality work within challenging deadlines.
• Fluency in English and French is required; German is considered an asset.

We offer

• The opportunity to deepen your skills in regulatory (e.g. laws, regulations, circulars) and to participate in regulatory implementation projects (e.g. MiFID, ESG, internal governance, compliance, risk management, portfolio management, AML/CTF);
• The chance to develop your business approach / eminence, interpersonal skills and knowledge of the financial market place;
• A dynamic, multicultural, and collaborative work environment with competitive remuneration and benefits.
• A strong focus on personal development and professional growth, including support in obtaining relevant certifications (e.g. ILA, PRM, FRM, CIA, or other governance and risk-related qualifications).
• The advantages of working in a human-sized international firm that combines professional excellence with a commitment to societal impact as well as global reach with a personal and collaborative working culture.
• A young, energetic, and supportive team culture where your contribution is valued, and where you can make a tangible difference for both clients and the firm.
• The opportunity to contribute to international projects or work with cross-border teams, while your base will be in Luxembourg.
Forvis Mazars is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture in which each individual feels welcomed.

We consider candidates based on their skills, abilities or experiences as we believe everyone brings their own talents with them.
The diversity of our talents is what makes our work environment multicultural, innovative and enriching.

jobs.title: Senior Fund Administrator - Level 1 (m/f)
jobs.description:
Your role

Our Administration team at Saltgate provide a bespoke suite of administration services. Our experienced team members deliver high
quality output designed to support throughout the fund life cycle.

Reporting to the Assistant Manager or Manager you will be the senior point of contact on all administration matters for a portfolio of clients
ensuring all items are completed and delivered within strict operational deadlines across client entity transactions. You will also act as a mentor
and supervisor for Juniors and Fund Administrators.

Your focus

- Coordinate, organise and document Board meeting and shareholder meeting including drafting minutes, preparing resolutions and ensuring action follow-up.
- Monitor and track incoming emails and ensure they are responded to on a timely basis, escalating where appropriate.
- Manage the full lifecycle of Luxembourg entities: incorporation, liquidation, restructuring, repatriation, statutory filings, audit coordination.
- Maintenance of accurate corporate records and database.
- Support deal execution by assisting with KYC/AML reviews, transaction documents and understanding investment structures.
- Lifecycle of investor transactions: capital call, distribution, transfer, capital call and distribution notices, capital Statements, investor register's update.
- Lead the communications with client contacts, lawyers, auditors, investors, bankers and other third parties.

Your experience

- Prior experience of 3 years in company administration in Luxembourg, ideally within financial services and investment funds framework along with knowledge of AIF structures
- Able to demonstrate excellent communication skills providing clear direction around delivery and able to delegate effectively
- Demonstrate a collaborate style working with others to build partnerships to meet shared objectives
- Be able to analyse complex information to effectively solve problems
- Has good judgement and decision-making skills and is able to deliver optimal client solutions

All individuals are assigned responsibility for assisting in the overall information security and data protection environment. This includes
attending and completing all mandatory information security and data protection training and complying with all applicable policies and
procedures.

Any questions or issues should be escalated in a timely manner to designated individuals, or if in doubt, consultation should take place with the relevant line manager.

Our pledge

As a people-first organisation, we aim to attract the best people and help them develop so they can deliver exceptional client services.

We embrace diversity, and have a culture of openness, which is reflected in our core values - engagement, partnership, integrity, and commitment. Whether you're a client or a colleague, Saltgate will partner with you to ensure you can achieve your best.

Saltgate is an equal opportunities employer and positively encourages applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of
sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital status, or pregnancy and maternity.

jobs.title: Senior Digital Marketing Manager (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description des tâches:
Role purpose: At Vodafone, we work every day to build a better future, for a world that is more connected, inclusive and sustainable. Travel eSIM is Vodafone's proposition for the hundreds of millions of international travellers that are looking for an easy and affordable solution to stay connected with friends, family or business partners while abroad, beyond their roaming plan. Travel eSIM is a key growth pillar at the heart of our Commercial strategy at Vodafone Group. We are breaking new ground with innovative offers and technologies like eSIM and our goal is to become the operator of choice for travellers abroad

The Senior Marketing Manager leads the marketing team. They are seen as a leader on all commercial activities related to Travel eSIM, with solid commercial knowledge of the industry, channels/partners, competition challenges. The role takes overall responsibility for driving maximum growth of Vodafone's Travel eSIM business worldwide, including definition and execution of pricing, proposition, market communication strategy & top-class customer experience.

The successful candidate will be a true influencer in the organisation and will help Vodafone scale its Travel eSIM business globally delivering superior customer experience and revenue growth, in line with Vodafone's commercial strategy.

Accountabilities and decision ownership: 

Own, lead and co-create proposition and pricing strategy for Travel eSIM offers including regional/local, segmented, time-bound promotions  

Develop and own integrated marketing plan and budgets  

Prepare briefs and provide input into proposition materials, comms materials, guides, FAQs  

Define & collect customer insights  

Define, propose and approve customer journeys  

Management of Brand activities

Management of Wholesale activities



Essential competencies, knowledge and experience: 

Strong knowledge of the telecoms industry and extensive pricing and commercial experience  

Excellent understanding of evolving customer attitudes in travel industry, behavioural economics, telecoms services and value perceptions  

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a track record of data-driven approaches  

Ability to rapidly understand and respond to strategic implications of external market developments.  

Very strong analytical, communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills  

Excellent strategic thinking and ability to lead change and execute strategy  

Ability to prioritise and demonstrating resilience  


Études:
Niveau d'étude demandé egal Bachelor (Bac +3)

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer - Consulting Manager (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description de tâches:


Applied AI Engineer – Consulting Manager


At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence.
We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.​
Join EY and help to build a better working world.



The opportunity

You will work across a diverse portfolio of clients spanning Financial Services, the Public Sector, and the Private Sector. Our Applied AI Engineering teams deliver production-grade AI systems in regulated financial institutions as well as government, health, infrastructure, consumer, industrial and energy organizations. This cross-sector model gives you broad exposure to different regulatory environments, data landscapes and operating models, while building deep engineering capability that transfers across industries.


Role purpose

Operate as a hands‑on engineer within a squad, taking ownership of defined components and delivering AI capabilities (e.g., agents, RAG pipelines) that meet enterprise standards for reliability, security and observability. Strengthen your foundations through the Applied AI Engineering Academy while taking on more responsibility for solution shaping and stakeholder engagement.


Your key responsibilities

Client‑facing engineering & delivery

Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders; translate requirements into engineering tasks; support workshops, demos and solution reviews; drive adoption through testing and iteration.
Solution design & implementation

Design and implement RAG pipelines, agents, microservices and integrations; apply monitoring, evaluation and Responsible AI guardrails.
Product mindset & continuous improvement

Shape MVP scope, backlog and release planning; capture reusable patterns and contribute to shared accelerators.


What we're looking for

Strong Python/TypeScript; async patterns; API design; testing/CI; microservice fundamentals.
Hands‑on LLMs, embeddings, vector databases; retrieval strategies and grounding.
Cloud engineering (Azure preferred), Docker/Kubernetes, serverless; secure networking/IAM.
Data engineering fundamentals (Spark/Databricks; ETL/ELT) and operational handover.
Consulting behaviors: stakeholder engagement and clear, client‑ready communication.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in a similar role.
Fluent written and spoken English, French/German is a plus.

Ideally, you'll also

Document/graph stores; streaming (Event Hub/Kafka); cloud architecture exposure and governance credentials.


What we offer you

At EY, we'll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create the best experience during the recruitment process, please describe any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.


EY |  Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

jobs.title: Procurement Officer (m/f)
jobs.description:
Summary

As a Procurement Officer, you will be responsible for managing the day-to-day procurement activities, ensuring the timely and cost-effective acquisition of goods and services while focusing on assessing vendors risks under the supervision of the Procurement & Corporate Project Manager.

You will play a key role in negotiating with suppliers, managing contracts, and maintaining strong relationships with vendors to support the organization's operational needs and meet quality standard of our products.
It requires nationwide coverage across all regions (e.g. Luxembourg, France, Morocco, Monaco…).

Missions of the role

• Procurement Operations: Manage the end-to-end procurement process. Review and validate all Purchase Order in the ERP in accordance with the internal procedures. Evalue supplier quotation and make recommendation based on commercial and technical criteria to Po issuers. Monitor PO status and ensure timely delivery of good and services.
• Supplier Management
Identify, evaluate, and select reliable suppliers based on quality, price, and delivery capabilities.
Maintain and update supplier databases and contracts.
• Compliance with Regulatory standards:
Monitor Level of compliancy from vendors with eIDAS, GDPR, DORA, ISO certifications…
Conduct periodical risk assessment.
• Governance and Documentation:
Ensure all procurement activities comply with company policies, legal requirements, and ethical standards.
Maintain accurate records of purchases. In collaboration with our Legal Department, manage Suppliers contracts and communications.
• Purchase Orders & Contracts:
Prepare, issue, and track purchase orders in accordance with company policies and procedures.
Negotiate terms and conditions with suppliers to secure advantageous pricing and payment terms.
• Stakeholder Collaboration:
Work closely with finance, operations, IT Security, Compliance, CSR and project teams to align procurement activities with organizational goals.
Provide regular reports on procurement activities, spending, and supplier performance.
• Cost Optimization:
Analyze market trends and supplier pricing to identify cost-saving opportunities.
Implement strategies to reduce procurement costs while maintaining quality standards.
• Reporting & Analysis: prepare procurement reports and KPI. Analyse purchasing data and market trends. Support budgeting and forecasting activities.
