jobs.title: Resource Manager
jobs.description:
Company Description

The Story Shack is a modern, low-overhead creative studio built to scale a brand's story. We give brands the power of an in-house creative team â without the headaches and high costs that plague the industry. We address the broken creative model by offering flexible, budget-friendly, scalable, and specialized solutions for brands.


Role Description

We're on the hunt for a sharp and dependable operator to join our scrappy, fast-growing creative studio and work directly alongside our Head of Community.


As our Resource Manager, you'll be the engine behind the scenes â running talent outreach, supporting creative resourcing, coordinating project needs, and keeping administrative tasks tight and on track. You'll help make sure every project has the right people in place at the right time, and that nothing falls through the cracks.


You'll also get exposure to the business side of a growing agency â supporting resourcing, budgeting, invoicing, and talent relationships as we continue to grow.


If you've got real experience in the agency, studio, or production world, love staying organized amid creative chaos, and want a front-row seat to how a creative company is actually run, this role was made for you.


Responsibilities

  • Manage daily tasks with our 300-person creative community, including administrative outreach to freelance talent such as creative directors, copywriters, directors, cinematographers, photographers, producers, designers, and more â including initial outreach, scheduling, and follow-up.
  • Run availability and rate checks across our talent network for upcoming projects, keeping records accurate and up to date.
  • Support creative resourcing with Project Managers, Account Managers, and Producers by helping match the right talent to the right projects based on skill set, client needs, availability, and budget.
  • Handle financial administration, including invoice monitoring, payment tracking, and flagging discrepancies.
  • Maintain organized, up-to-date talent and project databases.
  • Serve as a first point of contact for talent inquiries and applications, while helping build and maintain strong relationships across our creative community.


Qualifications

  • Experience in a creative agency, studio, or production environment with resourcing responsibilities.
  • Outstanding communication and organizational skills.
  • Comfortable managing multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.
  • Detail-oriented, especially when it comes to financials and scheduling.
  • A collaborative, low-ego attitude with the ability to support someone else's workflow and priorities.
  • Genuine interest in the advertising and film industries and building relationships with creative talent.
  • Familiarity with talent databases, project management tools, and invoicing/accounting software is a plus.
  • Existing relationships within the creative production community are a plus.

jobs.title: Analyst in Cyber Governance & Compliance (m/f)
jobs.description:
Analyst in Cyber Governance & Compliance
Location:  Luxembourg, LU
Company:  Deloitte Luxembourg
Job Function:  Technology & Cyber Security
Seniority:  Junior
Contract Type:  Open-term

Your future team

Our Cyber Governance & Compliance team provides assistance with various increasingly complex IT issues, to help our clients mitigate cyber risks. Our reputation for providing high quality services with integrity has earned us the trust of our clients.

The advantages of joining us

• Innovative work that matters
• Purpose-driven work
• Build your network
• Career growth, your way

How you'll contribute to our success

• Help our clients achieve their governance and risk management objectives leveraging your business, information systems and technology audit skills
• Assist clients through a full range of services, from regulatory compliance assessment to implementation of target operating model.
• Identify and evaluate business and technology risks, internal controls, and related opportunities for internal control improvement.
• Establish policies, roles and responsibilities across organization hierarchy with regards to business continuity management.
• Assist our clients to improve their IT and security risk management frameworks and implement appropriate controls to enhance the framework.
• Assist our clients to evaluate their compliance with the regulatory requirements relevant to IT and security, identify gaps and prepare appropriate action plans to remediate those gaps.
• Develop and maintain active communication with clients in order to manage expectations and ensure satisfaction.

Your skills

jobs.title: Senior FP&A Analyst, Corporate Finance
Cybersecurity Senior Strategy Consultant (m/f/d) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
Transform the everyday Shape the future of digital resilience. In a world where cyber threats evolve faster than ever, organizations need strategic minds who can turn security challenges into competitive advantages. This is your opportunity to lead that transformation at Siemens.
Your mission in our team
You'll join a forward-thinking cybersecurity strategy team where your role is to advise senior leadership and key stakeholders on building robust, future-proof security frameworks. You'll work across organizational boundaries, translating complex security challenges into clear, actionable strategies that drive business value while protecting critical assets.
The role combines top-management consulting, business excellence, and strategic program leadership — with a strong focus on structure, analytical rigor, and impact.
This is a role for a former consultant who enjoys turning ambiguity into clarity, strategy into roadmaps, and ideas into measurable results.

What we offer you

- An environment where everyone can bring their whole self to work and feel a sense of belonging. - A workplace that values curiosity and guarantees continuous learning, with development opportunities for both personal and professional growth. - Share matching programs to become a shareholder of Siemens AG. - A wide range of flexible benefits for you and your family to enjoy!

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .
The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.
You'll make an impact by

- Strategy & Strategic Execution- Continuously refine the Cybersecurity strategy and strategic ambition in line with Siemens’ overall business and IT strategy.- Translate strategic priorities into clear roadmaps, programs, and initiatives, including prioritization and sequencing.- leadership decision materials, and serve as a trusted strategic advisor to Cybersecurity and IT executives.
- Program & Performance Management- Design and drive cross-functional strategic and business excellence programs, from set-up to execution and impact tracking.- Define program structures, governance, milestones, KPIs, and success metrics.- Monitor progress, risks, and benefits realization; prepare regular management updates and steer course corrections where needed.- Case analyses while coordinating internal and external resources, including service providers.
- Stakeholder & Change Management- Engage with senior stakeholders across Cybersecurity, IT, and the business to understand needs, align priorities, and drive buy-in.- Support organizational development initiatives, including target operating models, role clarity, and governance structures.- Act as a coach and thought partner to executives while ensuring clear, structured communication of strategy and progress.

This is how you'll win us over

- Education- Master’s degree in Business Administration, Management or Economics; or an equivalent qualification
- Experience & Skills- Several years of post-consulting experience in cybersecurity strategy, risk management, or related advisory roles- Proven ability to develop strategic recommendations and influence senior decision-makers technical audiences- Experience in digital transformation or enterprise-wide (security) initiatives- Familiarity with specific frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001, or similar)- Knowledge of cloud security, OT/IT convergence, or industry-specific security requirements- Experience working in regulated industries or large, complex organizations
- Ways of working: Collaborative, adaptable, and committed to continuous learning, working effectively across diverse teams and staying current with evolving security trends- Languages: business proficiency in English and German

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
Your individual personality and perspective are important to us. We create a working environment that reflects the diversity of the society and support you in your personal and professional development. Let’s get to know your authentic personality and create a better future together with us. As an equal-opportunity employer (https://www.siemens.com/de/de/unternehmen/jobs/arbeiten-bei-siemens/inklusion.html) we are happy to consider applications from individuals with disabilities. In the case of equal qualifications, severely disabled applicants and applicants with equivalent status will be given preference.

About Us
The world never stands still. And new challenges arise every day. With a passion for questioning things, for supplying ideas, and intelligently driving things forward we are helping society move towards a smarter tomorrow. Be it with technologies that reduce carbon emissions in cities or hyperintelligent robots. This is how we are able, to tackle the most important projects and push them forward together. Help us shape the future.

jobs.title: Marketing & Community Specialist
jobs.description:
Marketing & Community Specialist til Kids-world.


Brænder du for at skabe tætte relationer til influencers og ambassadører?

Har du styr på detaljerne, når der skal planlægges digitale events, og elsker du at engagere dig med et stærkt forældre-community?

Så er du måske vores nye Marketing & Community Specialist.


Hos Kids-world har vi fart på vores internationale vækst. Vores aktiverings- og community-indsatser er virksomhedens tillidsmotor, der opbygger relationer, arrangerer eventbaserede digitale formater og skaber lokal forankring på tværs af vores markeder.


Vi søger nu en struktureret, idérig og udadvendt medarbejder, der skal være med til at opbygge og løfte dette område som en nøglespiller i vores marketingafdeling.


Din hverdag og primære arbejdsopgaver
Du bliver den eksekverende drivkraft i vores aktiverings-indsatser. Din dag vil være fyldt med varierede opgaver, hvor du både er i direkte dialog med vores ambassadører og sikrer praktisk fremdrift på vores kampagner og digitale events.


Dine primære opgaver bliver:

·         Ambassadører & Influencer Management: Du står for den daglige kontakt med vores ambassadør- og influencer-netværk – fra indledende dialog og aftaleindgåelse til produktudsendelser og opfølgning på indhold.

·         Community Building & Giveaways: Du skal aktivt opbygge brandloyale følgere og forældre-communities, og du koordinerer og eksekverer vores løbende giveaways, konkurrencer m.m.

·         Events, Podcasts & POS-materialer: Du hjælper med det praktiske arbejde omkring deltagelse i events/messer, opsætning af podcast-aftaler og bestilling/distribution af flyers og fysiske POS-materialer til vores pakker.

·         Koordinering med Country Managers: Du understøtter vores lokale Country Managers med koordinering af lokalt tilpasset indhold og kampagnemateriale på vores internationale markeder.

 

Din placering i teamet
Du bliver en central del af et passioneret og dynamisk marketing-team. Du refererer til CMO/Head of Marketing, hvor I sammen sikrer en stærk synergi mellem ambassadører, UGC, events og vores samlede SoMe-distribution.
Du arbejder samtidig tæt sammen med vores SoMe samt vores Onsite Performance Team (omkring afvikling på shoppen).


Hvem er du?
Det vigtigste er din energi, din struktur og din lyst til at tage ejerskab over dine opgaver. Om du er nyuddannet med den rette profil, eller har et par års erfaring fra et bureau, et brand eller en
e-commerce virksomhed, er ikke afgørende.

 

Vi forestiller os, at:

·         Du er udadvendt og en stærk relationsbygger: Du elsker at skrive og tale med mennesker, og du møder altid influencers, partnere og kunder med overskud og smil.

·         Du er velstruktureret og får tingene over målstregen: Du kan holde styr på mange ambassadøraftaler, pakkeudsendelser og event-køreplaner på samme tid uden at miste overblikket.

·         Du har interesse for børnefamilie-segmentet: Du forstår forældres behov, og du ved, hvad der skaber tillid og engagement i målgruppen.

·         Du er selvkørende og løsningsorienteret: Når der opstår uforudsete udfordringer under et live-show eller et event, bevarer du roen og finder en hurtig løsning.

·         Du kan tale og forstå dansk.

 

Hvad tilbyder vi?

·         En spændende og afvekslende stilling i en af Danmarks førende e-commerce virksomheder i stærk vækst.

·         Masser af ansvar fra dag ét og rig mulighed for at præge dine egne opgaver og udvikle dig fagligt i takt med at afdelingen vokser.

·         Et uformelt, ungt og engageret arbejdsmiljø i Esbjerg med højt til loftet og stærkt sammenhold.

·         Løn efter kvalifikationer samt gode personalegoder.

 

Ansøgning og kontakt
Send dit CV og en kort ansøgning via job@kids-world.dk . Marker mailen med ” Marketing & Community Specialist”. Vi afholder samtaler løbende.

Vil du høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Dennis på 60211280 for en fortrolig samtale.

jobs.title: Notino Experience Program Manager - EMEA & APAC, Early Career
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

This early-career Notino Experience Program Manager role is for a builder who thrives in ambiguity and turns it into momentum. You’ll wear many hats across the People team, but your core job is to jump in, chart the path, and drive high-impact projects based on business priorities—bringing clarity, aligning cross-functional partners, and executing quickly so the team can deliver meaningful employee experiences across EMEA and APAC.

You’ll succeed here if you’re deeply curious, eager to grow, and excited to hone your craft in People. This is a launchpad opportunity to learn from strong leaders, build expertise across the full spectrum of People work, and help shape moments that matter—bringing energy, optimism, and genuine care for people while helping build a workplace where everyone can do the best work of their careers.

As the regional anchor for how Notion’s global people & environment programs come to life outside the U.S., you’ll sit at the intersection of global vision and local execution. Based in Dublin and reporting to the Notino Experience & Environment Lead for APAC & EMEA, you’ll partner closely with the Global Experience Programs team in AMER and environment teams across Dublin, Sydney, Tokyo, Seoul, and Hyderabad—translating global programs into locally relevant, high-quality experiences and building the operational infrastructure to deliver them consistently at scale.

We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own regional program operations. Take end-to-end ownership of key people programs across EMEA and APAC — from onboarding and performance cycles to engagement surveys and talent retention initiatives. You'll research, plan, launch, and iterate.

 - Bridge global and local. Act as the connective layer between the Global Experience Programs team and on-the-ground environment teams. You'll translate global frameworks into locally relevant experiences.

 - Build the infrastructure. Create processes, playbooks, and agents that make local execution easier and more consistent across markets. Think onboarding workflows, program calendars, and repeatable delivery frameworks.

 - Elevate Affinity Groups. Partner with Affinity Group leads across the region to strengthen their programmes, provide operational support, and help surface retention and engagement insights from within those communities.

 - Use data to drive decisions. Build and maintain dashboards that track program health, adoption, and outcomes. Use what you learn to run experiments, course-correct quickly, and demonstrate ROI.

 - Partner cross-functionally. Work closely with People Partners, NoE , Recruitment and business leaders to align people programs with organisational goals and ensure an inclusive, well-supported employee experience.

 - Champion the Notion Experience. Help craft and bring to life a more distinct Notino Experience brand across EMEA and APAC — reimagining how we work, how we connect, and what it feels like to be a Notino in your region.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Programatic: experience running people programs end-to-end, across multiple markets & time zones.

 - AI-native mindset: you’re “AI‑pilled” in the best way: you proactively use AI tools to speed up research, ops, and communication, and you’re excited to build AI agents/playbooks.

 - Project management: strong skills and the ability to hold many moving pieces.

 - Stakeholder trust: you build trust naturally across levels, from team members to executive partners.

 - Bias toward action: you’re resourceful, scrappy when needed, and energised by a fast-moving environment.

 - Change management: experience driving change at a high-growth company — you know how to bring people along, not just roll things out.

 - Executive presence: you’re comfortable presenting to and partnering with senior leaders.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Familiarity with or enthusiasm for Notion

 - Experience working across APAC and EMEA markets, with an understanding of cultural nuance in employee experience.

The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €60,000 - €70,000 per year.

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

Notre offre

Au sein de la direction International et Opérations (DIO), rattaché au second de cuisine, le cuisinier a pour mission de réaliser la production alimentaire d'un restaurant collectif et de ces prestations particulières.

- Réaliser les préparations culinaires selon les fiches techniques

Le candidat est de nationalité française et/ou ressortissant européen.

Formation CAP/BEP restauration et/ou niveau équivalent acquis par une expérience d'au moins 2 ans dans le domaine.


Les savoir-être partagés par tous les collaborateurs de l'EdA

Esprit d'équipe, sens du service, discrétion, implication, agilité, éthique, communication, initiative


Nos propositions

Poste à pourvoir sur des enceintes militaires françaises.

Rattaché au second de cuisine.

Respect des règles de sécurité édictées par l'autorité militaire, notamment les conditions de sortie.

Logement fourni (nuitée et petit déjeuner), type appart hôtel.

Poste de contact, varié, nécessitant d'être apte à travailler en autonomie aussi bien qu'en équipe.

L'engagement au côté des forces armées françaises nous permet de donner du sens à nos actions et de nous accomplir au quotidien. C'est l'opportunité de mettre nos expertises et notre créativité au service de projets dimensionnants.

jobs.title: Postdoc in clinical Raman spectroscopy and AI-based diagnostics
jobs.description:
A position as Postdoc (full-time) is vacant at the TE Andersen Lab part of the Research Unit of Clinical Microbiology, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Shape the future of clinical diagnostics

We are seeking an ambitious and highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to help establish next-generation Raman spectroscopy technologies for clinical microbiology. This position offers a unique opportunity to work at the interface between optics, artificial intelligence, microbiology and clinical diagnostics in close collaboration with hospitals, industry and international research partners.

Research environment

The successful candidate will join the research group led by Professor Thomas Emil Andersen. The group conducts translational research in microbiology, advanced infection models, spectroscopy and medical technology. We collaborate extensively with Danish and international hospitals, universities and industrial partners, with a strong focus on translating innovative technologies into improved patient care.

The academic position

The job involves research, professional development, research education, research-based teaching, and supervision.

Your responsibilities will consist of the following:

  • Lead OUH contributions to the EU- and state-funded projects (Innovation Fund Denmark project nanoRaman, two Eurostars projects MbCare and QMIC, and the MedTech Odense project UriNix).

  • Design, plan and execute experimental studies from concept to publication.

  • Develop Raman spectroscopy workflows for analysis of clinical samples.

  • Apply machine learning and AI for spectral analysis and diagnostic classification.

  • Coordinate collaborations across hospitals, academia and industrial partners.

  • Build and develop a Raman spectroscopy research platform within the Andersen Lab.

  • Supervise students and junior researchers.

  • Publishing results in leading international journals and contributing to future grant applications.

Expectations and qualifications

We are looking for candidates holding a PhD in physics, engineering, optics, spectroscopy, biomedical engineering or a related discipline. The candidate may also hold a PhD within health sciences, biology, microbiology or similar but should then also hold significant knowledge and experience within optical sciences, spectroscopy and related data handling.

Essential qualifications:

  • Significant knowledge and experience with Raman spectroscopy.

  • Experience with optical instrumentation.

  • Experience with machine learning and/or AI.

  • Experience analysing biological or clinical samples.

  • Profound in scientific writing and a solid publication record.

Desirable qualifications:

  • Experience with clinical microbiology or hospital diagnostics.

  • Experience in academia–industry collaborations.

  • Project coordination skills.

  • Ability to work independently while thriving in multidisciplinary teams.

What we offer

  • A unique translational research environment combining engineering and medicine.

  • Participation in major externally funded collaborative projects.

  • Close interaction with clinicians, engineers and industrial partners.

  • Access to state-of-the-art spectroscopy and microbiology facilities.

  • Excellent opportunities for scientific publishing, networking and career development.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision - We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future - it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research - with people at the centre; strong research environments - as drivers of development; and the research journey - from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information

Further information about the position can be obtained from Professor Thomas Emil Andersen, e-mail: thandersen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 21261634 or Head of Department of Clinical Research, Rikke Leth-Larsen, e-mail: rllarsen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 65503477.

Application deadline

August 18, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

The work location will be at the laboratory of Professor Andersen at the Department of Clinical Microbiology, Odense University Hospital, J. B. Winsløws Vej 21.1, Odense C, Denmark. The laboratory and department will move to the newly built University Hospital associated with the University of Southern Denmark, in late summer 2027.  

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a research plan detailing the candidate’s ideas and plans for her/his future research work

  • An explanation other qualification relevant to the post

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

Produces a high-quality factual report for the Consultant Neurophysiologist to interpret and report on the studies performed. Includes notes on the study where relevant. Obtains standard recordings, utilises judgement to determine whether patient meets normal standards and reports significant changes to appropriate personnel. Performs calibration as required and ensures maintenance as appropriate. Able to troubleshoot minor equipment issues and escalate necessary Keep documentation in line with the clinic’s protocols Adhere to GDPR principles at all times Be confident in training and supervising new Physiologists/students in Neurophysiology studies carried out at the Diagnostic Centre. Open and willing to develop new applicable services within the organisation. During quiet periods be willing and able to perform other functions e.g. contact referred patients to make appointments. Qualifications: Possess the BSc in Clinical Measurement from Dublin Institute of Technology or from a recognised equivalent 3rd level institution. jobs.title: Kodinkoneasentaja
jobs.description:
Avantego Oy on vakavarainen ja luotettava työnantaja. Historiamme kodinkoneiden kuljetus- ja asennuspalveluista ulottuu 2000-luvun alkuun, jolloin nykyinen operatiivinen johto on aloittanut kodinkoneiden kuljetus- ja asennustyöt Tampereella ja Hämeenlinnassa. Kuljetimme ja asensimme noin 25000 kodinkonetta vuonna 2025. Työllistämme kumppanimme mukaan lukien noin 45 työntekijää. Kuluvana vuonna kuljettamiemme ja asentamiemme kodinkoneiden määrä kasvaa noin 40 000 kodinkoneeseen. Vuodesta 2024 olemme toimineet KOTIISI -Kerralla kuntoon brändillä.

Kodinkoneiden kuljetus- ja asennusliiketoimintamme edelleen laajentuessa haemme palvelukseen KODINKONEASENTAJAA Satakuntaan, Porin ja Rauman seudulle.

Työtä tehdään omatoimisesti tai pareittain asiakkaiden luona ja työhön kuuluu kodinkoneiden kuljetus- ja asennustehtäviä.

Työssä menestyminen vaatii hyvää peruskuntoa, reipasta ja iloista otetta työhön sekä vähintään B-luokan ajo-oikeutta. Koulutus ja kokemus lvi- tai/ja sähköalalta katsotaan eduksi, sillä toimitamme mm. astianpesukoneita ja kotitalousliesiä asennettuna.

Aiempaa kokemusta kodinkoneiden asentamisesta olisi hyvä olla jo kartutettuna. Työhön opastus ja käyttämiemme järjestelmien koulutus kuuluu aina työnaloitus perehdytykseen. Sujuva Suomen kielen taito on välttämätön ja muu kielitaito (englanti, ruotsi) on plussaa.

Vapaamuotoiset hakemukset palkkatoiveineen pyydämme lähettämään sähköpostilla, rekrytointi@kotiisi.net.

Nyt tarjottava tehtävä sisältää pääasiassa työtä auton apumiehenä / toisena asentajana. Työ on luonteeltaan sellaista, että jokaiselle päivälle ei välttämättä ole tunteja tarjolla. Työpäivät sekä työpäivien pituus voidaan sovittaa valittavan tekijän oman elämäntilanteen mukaan. Työ sopii hyvin esim. opiskelijalle tai lisätyöksi epäsäännöllistä työtä tekevälle.

Vil du have et job med gode fremtidsmuligheder, stærkt fællesskab og adgang til moderne maskiner og udstyr? Hos os får du en aktiv hverdag, hvor du kan udvikle dig både fagligt og personligt – og hvor sikkerhed og ordentlighed er en del af kulturen.

Du tilbydes

  • Et spændende job med gode udviklingsmuligheder
  • En aktiv hverdag med engagerede kollegaer og stærk holdånd
  • Personlig og faglig udvikling – bl.a. gennem videreuddannelse

  • God løn, pension og sundhedsordning
  • Arbejdstøj og vask heraf, senest efter 4 ugers ansættelse

Dine opgaver

  • Du bliver en vigtig del af produktionen, hvor du sammen med dit team sikrer høj kvalitet og stabil drift
  • Betjening af belægningsstensmaskine
  • Truckkørsel (4-gaflet truck)
  • Kvalitetskontrol
  • Rengøring af betonblander og siloer samt oprydning i produktionen

Vi søger dig, som…

  • Har erfaring fra produktion og hænderne godt skruet på
  • Trives med fysisk arbejde
  • Er selvkørende og ikke bange for at tage fat
  • Besidder teknisk forståelse
  • Har viljen og lysten til at lære nyt
  • Er let omgængelig, pålidelig og mødestabil

Hvem er vi?

Vi er en del af CRH – en international koncern – men i Roust er vi et lokalt team med stærkt sammenhold, uformel tone og fokus på sikkerhed. Vi hjælper hinanden, vi udvikler hinanden, og vi får tingene gjort.

Klar til at blive en del af holdet i Roust

Hvis du kan se dig selv i rollen, så send din ansøgning allerede i dag. Vi holder samtaler løbende, indtil vi har fundet den rette.

Om CRH Products

CRH Products har ca. 150 medarbejdere på seks lokationer i Danmark og leverer alt fra fliser, belægning og støttemure til rør- og brøndsystemer, bygværker og plansiloer. Vi er en del af CRH i Danmark, der samlet har ca. 1.500 ansatte på 19 lokationer inden for råhusbyggeri, råstoffer, belægning og rørsystemer. Vores mål er at udvikle løsninger, der bygger, forbinder og forbedrer verden.

Læs mere på www.crhproducts.dk.

jobs.title: Doctoral Researcher, Strategic Business Development (H2Nexus Project)
jobs.description:
The University of Vaasa is an inspiring and international community where we work together for a sustainable and responsible future. We combine expertise in business and technology in a unique way, tackling current challenges with determination and collaboration. As part of the Nordic regions largest energy technology hub, we promote sustainable business, energy, and society. We educate future professionals who will create a fairer and more sustainable world.

The University of Vaasa is seeking a motivated and talented Doctoral Researcher to join the Research Council of Finland-funded H2NEXUS project.

The position is full-time and fixed-term (3 years), aligned with the duration of the H2NEXUS project. The preferred start date is September 2026 or as agreed. The position is located in the [School of Management](https://www.uwasa.fi/en/university/organisation-and-management/school-management) in the [Strategic Business Development](https://www.uwasa.fi/en/research/groups-and-focus-areas/strategic-business-development)research grouphttps://www.uwasa.fi/en/research/groups/public-policy-and-governance. The position is located in Vaasa.

About the Project

The H2Nexus project investigates the co-evolution of markets and energy ecosystems, with a particular focus on the emergence of the hydrogen economy in Finland. The project enables a comprehensive understanding of the systemic change through a dual approach: combining techno-economic modelling with a theoretical lens that views markets as designed and evolving coordination systems.

The project explores how institutional work and market practices shape the development and stabilization of key components such as business model innovation, pricing mechanisms, and ecosystem governance. A central research objective is to analyze the conditions and mechanisms that enable or hinder the transition from early-stage development to more mature and institutionalized stages.

Quantitative and qualitative analyses will be integrated into this research, particularly to analyze the impacts of new hydrogen markets and regulations on both the overall energy system and business cases in some hard-to-abate sectors, such as the production of steel, fertilizers, shipping fuels, and aviation fuels. The research will incorporate project-level and system-level models for hydrogen and its derivatives, aligned with market-shaping theory.

The project will produce new knowledge on the clean hydrogen market from market-ecosystem, business case, and energy system perspectives, as well as relevant new datasets, modelling methods, and blueprints. The results can be directly utilized in the scientific community, but also to improve decision-making in the public and private sectors.

Your Role

You will play a key role in the project team and actively participate in the implementation of different activities within the research project. The role emphasizes the ability to conduct high-quality research and interact with different national and international stakeholders. Your work will contribute directly to project deliverables and high-quality academic publications.

Key Responsibilities in the position:

- Contribute to the projects activities.
- Conduct independent and collaborative research on ecosystem emergence, market shaping, and business model innovation.
- Collaborate with an interdisciplinary group of universities, research organisations, manufacturers, retailers, and civil society organisations.
- Participate in data collection (e.g., interviews, workshops, case studies), analysis, and validation activities with industry stakeholders and policy makers.
- Lead and co-author high-quality scientific publications in international peer-reviewed journals.
- Support teaching or supervision tasks when applicable (according to university guidelines).
- Present research at academic conferences and project meetings.
- Produce a doctoral dissertation based on the research carried out within the project.

The position may also include other tasks to be agreed upon separately. All tasks are agreed in more detail in the Annual Work Plan. The annual working time is 1612 hours.

Requirements

A person who has completed a suitable higher university degree (see below) and is a doctoral student at the University of Vaasa can be selected for the position of Doctoral Researcher. We therefore expect the selected person to have the ability and motivation for doctoral studies and to complete a doctoral degree. The selected candidate needs to apply for doctoral studies through a separate application to the University of Vaasa's Graduate School | [Read more about doctoral education, application and eligibility for studies.](https://www.uwasa.fi/en/education/doctoral-education)

Required:

- Masters degree in a relevant field of business studies, such as management, industrial management, B2B management, or a related field.
- Strong proven interest in the research area of the project.
- Ability to work both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
- Excellent communication skills in English.
- Motivation to produce high-quality research outputs.

Desirable:

- Experience with qualitative or mixed methods research.
- Experience working with industry stakeholders.
- Experience related to the project's context, whether it be energy or even hydrogen.

Read more about the selection process and language policies: [University of Vaasa (uwasa.fi)](https://www.uwasa.fi/en/open-positions/application-and-selection-process)

We offer

- A fully funded doctoral researcher position (3 years) aligned with a high-profile Research Council of Finland project.
- The selected applicant will be accepted into the University of Vaasas Doctoral Programme and will pursue their doctoral degree in Management after a separate application process.
- Opportunity to collaborate with leading experts across Europe.
- Training in doctoral research, methods, and professional skills.
- Access to industry cases, real-world data, and hands-on circular innovation activities.
- Supportive research environment within the University of Vaasas vibrant research community.

We promote the overall well-being of our employees at work by, among other things, offering fitness and cultural benefits, extensive occupational health care services, and versatile opportunities for continuous learning. F

jobs.title: Are you a Flight Instructor? Explore Multiple Career Paths at Greybird, no matter your level.
jobs.description:
GreyBird Pilot Academy is expanding and is looking for Flight Instructors to join our team fulltime or parttime in Denmark.

Are you passionate about training and developing the next generation of commercial pilots? Do you thrive in a professional aviation environment where you can combine flight instruction with classroom and simulator-based teaching?

Three profile opportunities

Whether you are a newly graduated or an experienced Flight Instructor, already hold CRI/SPA privileges, or are ready to take the next step through our sponsored development program, we offer exciting opportunities to build your aviation career while helping future pilots achieve their goals:

Career Path 1: Flight Instructor DK summer / Spain winther

About the Role

As a Flight Instructor, your primary responsibility will be delivering flight training onboard our aircraft. Depending on operational needs, you may also conduct simulator sessions and classroom-based theoretical instruction.

You will guide students throughout their training journey and help ensure the highest standards of pilot education.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI

  • Set to have a split base between Denmark in the summer and Spain in the winter

  • Based in either DK or Spain

Read more and apply here

Career Path 2: Flight Instructor – Sponsored CRI/SPA Program

About the Role

This position is designed for pilots who meet the requirements for CRI/SPA training but have not yet obtained the qualification.

As a Flight Instructor, you will deliver flight training, simulator instruction, and classroom teaching while participating in our sponsored development pathway.

Sponsored Development Opportunity

GreyBird will sponsor the CRI/SPA training required for the role if you meet the eligibility criteria below.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for sponsorship for a full-time position based at Aarhus Airport in Denmark, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Experience as PIC on MEP aircraft

  • Meet EASA FCL requirements for:

  • CRI/SPA ME, or

  • IRI MEP

Read more and apply here

Career Path 3: Flight Instructor CRI/SPA/(ME) (fulltime / or flexible planned partime)

About the Role

This position is aimed at experienced instructors already holding CRI/SPA qualifications.

You will primarily conduct flight training and may also deliver simulator and classroom instruction as part of our integrated training programs.

For candidates with these qualifications, GreyBird offers a full-time position or a flexible employment for candidates who are interested in a combination of working as an instructor at GreyBird and an airline job or commute between residence and Aarhus airport.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • CRI/SPA qualification (mandatory)

  • ME qualification (preferred but not required)

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI)

Read more and apply here

Ready for Take-Off?

If you meet the requirements for one of the three career paths, we encourage you to apply for the position that matches your current qualifications.

Join GreyBird Pilot Academy and help shape the future of aviation.

We can’t wait to hear from you.

Relocation: Candidates must be willing to relocate and live within commuting distance of our base in Aarhus, DK fulltime or parttime depending on the position.

jobs.title: Intermediate Backend Engineer - Platform Integrations (Monetization)

Har du lyst til at arbejde med kundeservice i et internationalt tech-miljø?

Brænder du for at hjælpe andre, og vil du gerne udvikle dig i en rolle, hvor teknologi, kundekontakt og problemløsning går hånd i hånd? Dette er din mulighed for at blive en del af et globalt team i hjertet af Málaga.

Denne stilling er perfekt til dig, der ønsker at kombinere karriereudvikling med et liv i en af Spaniens mest solrige og livlige byer. Fuld oplæring, moderne værktøjer og et stærkt fællesskab venter — og rollen gør dig til en vigtig del af kundernes oplevelse.

Hvad laver en Customer Support Representative?

Rollen handler om at skabe tryghed, løse problemer og guide kunder gennem både tekniske og praktiske spørgsmål. Henvendelser kommer via telefon, e-mail og chat, og du arbejder i CRM-systemer, registrerer sager og sikrer, at hver kunde får en professionel og personlig oplevelse.

⚡ XPENG-projekter kræver erfaring eller stærk viden om elbiler. Perfekt for dig, der interesserer dig for fremtidens mobilitet og grøn teknologi.

Skaber værdi og teknisk support

Kundehenvendelser håndteres med fokus på både service og teknisk forståelse. Første niveau support gives på produkter, konti og platforme. Sager registreres korrekt og følges til løsning inden for SLA. Behov analyseres, og den rette løsning findes i samarbejde med kunden. Kunderejsen understøttes fra første kontakt til afsluttet sag.

jobs.description:
Technical Support Advisor for Phillips til vores danske team i Benalmádena.

Alle kan søge, men vi foretrækker en fastboende i Málaga‑regionen, da opstart er hurtigst mulig.

Hvad skal jeg lave?

Dette er en teknisk kundeservicerolle, hvor du hjælper dansktalende brugere af Philips TV og audiovisuelle produkter. Du arbejder med kunder, der oplever problemer med deres TV‑opsætning, forbindelser, lyd eller billede, smart‑TV apps eller generel brug af udstyret. Din opgave er at guide dem igennem fejlsøgningen trin for trin, uanset om det handler om Wi‑Fi, HDMI, softwareopdateringer eller kompatibilitet mellem enheder. Når en sag er mere kompleks, sørger du for at sende den videre til de tekniske specialister. Rollen handler i høj grad om at skabe gode kundeoplevelser og levere support af høj kvalitet i et miljø, hvor KPI’er og kundetilfredshed er centrale.

Kort sagt er du den person, kunderne kontakter, når deres TV ikke fungerer, og du hjælper dem med at finde løsningen – enten ved at løse problemet direkte eller ved at guide dem videre.

TP Vision er virksomheden bag Philips TV og audio globalt. De udvikler, producerer og markedsfører Philips‑brandede TV og lydprodukter i Europa, Latinamerika og flere andre regioner. Virksomheden er en del af TPV Technology, som er en af verdens største producenter af monitorer og TV‑paneler. TP Vision har hovedkontor i Amsterdam og opererer internationalt inden for forbrugerelektronik. Kort fortalt er det TP Vision, der driver og udvikler Philips TV‑forretningen på verdensplan.

Rollen er attraktiv, fordi du får mulighed for at arbejde med et globalt elektronikbrand og samtidig få en stærk indgang til teknisk support, IT og AV‑relaterede roller. Du bliver en del af et struktureret arbejdsmiljø med klare KPI’er og gode udviklingsmuligheder – og du arbejder i Benalmádena på Costa del Sol.

Hvordan er kontormiljøet?

Du bliver en del af et internationalt team med dansk‑ og engelsktalende kolleger. Kontoret ligger ved Málaga og har moderne faciliteter, professionelle arbejdsstationer og et stærkt socialt miljø. Der er fokus på samarbejde, udvikling og trivsel, og du får mulighed for at arbejde tæt sammen med både danske og internationale medarbejdere.

Dit ansvar:

  • Yder 1st level IT‑support via telefon, mail og chat og hjælper brugerne videre, når de oplever tekniske udfordringer

  • Hjælper medarbejdere med at navigere i systemer, programmer og hardware

  • Arbejder med fejlsøgning og identificerer årsagerne til tekniske problemer

  • Håndterer IT‑tickets og sikrer, at sagerne bliver prioriteret korrekt

  • Benytter interne vidensdatabaser til at finde løsninger hurtigt og effektivt

  • Indgår i tæt samarbejde med 2nd level‑teams og eksterne leverandører

  • Bidrager til en professionel og serviceminded oplevelse for alle brugere

Dine kvalifikationer:

  • Dansk i både skrift og tale og kommunikerer sikkert på engelsk (C1)

  • Har interesse for IT og gerne erfaring med supportopgaver

  • Kender til Windows 10, Office 365 og MS Teams og føler dig hjemme i digitale miljøer

  • Arbejder struktureret og kan holde overblik, selv når der er flere opgaver i gang

  • Trives i en rolle, hvor service, hjælpsomhed og tydelig kommunikation er i fokus

  • Har en analytisk tilgang og kan løse tekniske udfordringer på en systematisk måde

  • Er nysgerrig, lærevillig og motiveret for at arbejde i et internationalt team

Løn og benefits:

  • Fast fuldtidskontrakt (indefinido) med spansk kontraktsret

  • Konkurrencedygtig grundløn på 2071 Euro/ Brutto

  • Bonusordning på op til 1800 Euro om året /Brutto

  • Spansk social sikring, pension og betalt ferie

  • Mulighed for delvist hjemmearbejde efter oplæring

  • Moderne kontormiljø i solrige omgivelser

  • Flyttehjælp og assistance med lokale formaliteter

Den perfekte kandidat:

Den ideelle kandidat til denne rolle er en person, der trives i et miljø, hvor service, problemløsning og kommunikation går hånd i hånd. Du er typen, der bliver nysgerrig, når noget ikke virker, og som gerne vil forstå, hvad der ligger bag en teknisk udfordring. Samtidig er du god til mennesker og formår at skabe ro og tryghed, når du hjælper andre gennem en IT‑udfordring. Du arbejder struktureret, holder hovedet koldt, når der er flere opgaver i spil, og du har en naturlig lyst til at lære nyt og udvikle dine kompetencer. Det er vigtigt, at du er samarbejdsorienteret og trives i et internationalt miljø, hvor man hjælper hinanden og deler viden. Hvis du både kan lide at arbejde med mennesker og teknologi, og du motiveres af at gøre en forskel for brugerne, vil du passe perfekt ind i teamet.

jobs.title: Personlig assistent till kvinna
jobs.description:
Hej,

Jag är en glad och positiv kvinna i 50-årsåldern som bor i Arabiastranden i Helsingfors. Nu söker jag en personlig assistent som kan tillbringa cirka 15 timmar i månaden tillsammans med mig.

På vardagarna har jag dagverksamhet fram till kl. 13.00. Kvällar och veckoslut har jag däremot inget regelbundet program. Jag deltar gärna i vissa av DUV:s fritidsaktiviteter och uppskattar också möjligheten att ibland göra en utflykt under veckosluten. Särskilt under veckosluten önskar jag sällskap, eftersom dagarna annars kan bli långa.

Till mina intressen hör bland annat musik, sång, olika bollsporter, att pyssla hemma vid dåligt väder eller att åka en tur med spårvagnen. Jag tycker även om att besöka museer och bibliotek för att läsa djur och båttidningar.

Jag behöver stöd i vardagen med till exempel påklädning, toalettbesök, tidsuppfattning och kommunikation.


Jag söker dig som är glad, empatisk och trygg. Det är viktigt för mig att du tycker om att umgås, prata och skämta, och att du kan skapa en trivsam och avslappnad stämning tillsammans med mig.

Den person som väljs till jobbet behöver visa upp ett giltigt straffregisterutdrag (Lag om tillsynen över social- och hälsovården 741/2023 § 28).

Intresserad?

Lämna din ansökan direkt via länken. Vi går igenom ansökningarna löpande och anställer så fort vi hittar en lämplig assistent!

Vill du veta mera innan du söker? Hör av dig till vår rådgivare Fanny Väärä, tel. 040 648 7747.

Din arbetsgivare blir JAG Assistans Ab , en icke-vinstdrivande serviceproducent som är specialiserad på personlig assistans för personer med olika funktionsnedsättningar. Det betyder att vi anställer, och är arbetsgivare åt, personliga assistenter och sköter administrationen kring den personliga assistansen. JAG står på en stark värdegrund: Alla människor är lika mycket värda, alla kan vara självbestämmande, alla kan kommunicera och alla har rätt att vara huvudperson i sitt eget liv!

jobs.title: Er du kok med faglig stolthed (og lyst til kun at arbejde i dagstimer på hverdage)
jobs.description:
God mad - God energi - god kollega - godt arbejde!

Brænder du for god mad, høj kvalitet og et køkken med stærkt samarbejde? Har du faglig stolthed og kan tage ansvar for dit eget parti fra start til slut? Så er det måske dig, vi søger hos The Food Company A/S. Vi søger en dygtig og stabil kok til en 37-timers stilling, hvor du bliver en vigtig del af et professionelt køkkenteam med højt tempo, god energi og fokus på kvalitet – hver dag.

Om jobbet

Som kok hos The Food Company har du ansvaret for dit eget parti og for at levere mad af høj faglig standard. Du er med hele vejen – fra planlægning og indkøb til tilberedning, smag, præsentation og aflevering.

Du bliver en del af et køkken, hvor struktur, ansvar og samarbejde er afgørende for, at dagens samlede leverance lykkes.

Dine primære opgaver

Som kok hos os forventer vi, at du:

  • planlægger dit parti, udarbejder daglige indkøbslister og have evner til at sørge for god daglig dækning

  • sikrer, at råvarer og ingredienser er tilgængelige og lever op til kvalitetskrav

  • tilbereder maden med faglig stolthed og smager den til, så kvaliteten er ensartet og høj

  • tjekker kuverter, menu og interne bestillinger i relevante systemer (fx Kanpla og FreezeAway)

  • Oplæring af nye medarbejdere ved håndtering af råvarer og madlavning

  • møder kl. 06.00 (eller 05.00 ved bagerpartiet) og er klar til produktion

Service by Feeling – sådan arbejder vi

Hos The Food Company arbejder vi ud fra princippet Service by Feeling.

Det betyder, at vi ikke bare leverer mad – vi leverer en oplevelse, der er bygget på ansvar, kvalitet og samarbejde.

Som kok betyder Service by Feeling, at du:

  • tager fuldt ansvar for dit parti og leverer mad, du selv kan stå inde for

  • arbejder grundigt og kvalitetsbevidst – også når tempoet er højt, eller planen ændrer sig

  • samarbejder ordentligt og konstruktivt med kollegaer og sikrer klare overleveringer

  • bidrager til et godt arbejdsmiljø gennem respekt, hjælpsomhed og ordentlig tone

  • udviser fleksibilitet og hjælper, hvor behovet opstår, når det er nødvendigt for dagens samlede leverance

Service by Feeling handler ikke om fine ord – men om at tage ansvar og gøre tingene ordentligt i hverdagen.

Vi forventer, at du

  • er uddannet kok eller har solid erfaring fra professionelt køkken

  • har høj faglighed og arbejder struktureret

  • kan holde overblik og levere stabil kvalitet – også under pres

  • bidrager med idéer og input til udvikling af kvalitet, maden og arbejdsgange

  • kommunikerer respektfuldt og samarbejder godt med teamet

  • overholder alle hygiejnekrav og møder korrekt påklædt
    (skridsikre sko, sort tøj og forklæde – forklæde udleveres; sat hår, korte negle osv.)

Fleksibilitet og fælles ansvar

Køkkenet er et fælles ansvar, og derfor forventer vi også, at du:

  • hjælper med opvask, rengøring og øvrige køkkenopgaver ved behov

  • deltager i firmaevents og samarbejdsopgaver efter aftale med køkkenchefen

  • kan indgå i andre partier samt hjælpe med opvask, chaufførvagter, rengøring og tøjvask ved sygdom og ferie

Vi tilbyder

jobs.title: GTM Recruiter, Tokyo
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re looking for an experienced Go-To-Market (GTM) Recruiter in Tokyo to partner closely with our Japan leadership team to attract, engage, and close top talent from an array of backgrounds. In this role, you’ll help build our Japan organization in a high-ownership, high-growth environment. We will look to you to advise and consult with hiring managers and interviewers, proactively source and engage future Notinos, and design a rigorous hiring processes while ensuring a delightful candidate experience.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the Japan recruiting process for GTM roles, primarily for Solutions Consultants (direct sales) and other GTM roles.

 - Operate autonomously across the end-to-end cycle, from direct sourcing and screening through close, while ensuring a thoughtful candidate experience at every step.

 - Run role kick-off meetings, define profiles, and align interview plans and scorecards to drive consistent, high-quality decisions.

 - Utilize internal hiring metrics and external market data to proactively propose recommendations and solutions to leaders.

 - Drive our diversity and inclusion strategy forward, with a heavy emphasis on sourcing and maintaining a well-balanced and diverse top-of-funnel candidate slate.

 - Build and nurture future talent pipelines for priority Japan GTM roles.

 - Establish trusted partnerships with the Japan leadership team to ensure Notion hires the right talent at the right time to achieve the company’s ambitious goals.

 - Ensure scalable, structured hiring plans for all roles with a strong sense of urgency and agency, while building repeatable processes and creative solutions that help the recruiting team scale for years to come.

 - Inspire candidates throughout all stages of the interview process, and build a customized close for each candidate.

 - Collaborate closely with peers and cross-functional partners, including Recruiting Coordinators, HRBPs/People Partners, Compensation Partners, Recruiting Operations, Executive Operations Partners, and Revenue Operations.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - You have at least 3 years of recruiting experience, preferably in a high-growth, in-house environment. Agency background is also welcome if you have full-cycle IT/SaaS sales hiring experience.

 - You have a track record of directly sourcing, qualifying, and closing exceptional GTM talent (e.g. Sales, Customer Success, Pre-Sales, Professional Services) based in Tokyo.

 - You can partner with, manage, and influence leadership stakeholders effectively. You have coached and guided hiring managers and interviewers through the full recruiting process.

 - You have built diverse candidate pipelines and helped hiring managers build inclusive teams.

 - You have outstanding communication and interpersonal skills in both English and Japanese (written and spoken fluency in both are required.)

 - You have a relentless focus on delivering a high-touch, high-quality recruiting experience, while respecting candidates’ and hiring managers’ time.

 - You can multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced, ever-evolving environment.

 - You’re a team player with an optimistic attitude, and you’re comfortable wearing many hats in a smaller organization.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You have owned the end-to-end hiring process at global SaaS companies.

 - You have managed roles and candidates across regions outside of Japan.

 - You’re a Notion power user!




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Partner Sales Specialist
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


We're looking for a Partner Sales Specialist to help scale Replit's strategic partnership ecosystem into a repeatable and measurable revenue channel. This role sits at the intersection of Partnerships and Enterprise Sales, serving as the execution engine behind our co-sell motions with strategic partners including Microsoft, Google Cloud, Databricks, and future ecosystem partners.

You will work directly with Account Executives, Strategic Alliances, and partner field teams to identify opportunities, coordinate co-sell engagement, accelerate deal progression, and drive measurable business outcomes through partnerships.

This is a highly collaborative and externally facing role for someone who enjoys building relationships, working directly with sales teams, and turning strategic partnerships into pipeline and revenue. You'll play a critical role in helping Replit establish partnerships as a scalable enterprise growth channel.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Drive enterprise co-sell motions across Replit's strategic partnerships, including Microsoft, Google Cloud, Databricks, and future ecosystem partners.

 - Partner closely with Account Executives to identify opportunities where strategic partners can accelerate customer acquisition, expansion, and procurement.

 - Build trusted working relationships with partner account teams to increase co-sell engagement and opportunity progression.

 - Conduct recurring account mapping exercises with strategic partners to identify whitespace opportunities and prioritize joint engagement.

 - Coordinate partner involvement throughout the sales cycle, ensuring opportunities receive appropriate partner support and visibility.

 - Drive partner sourced and partner influenced opportunities through active coordination, follow up, and stakeholder management.

 - Manage deal registration processes across partner portals, ensuring accurate and timely submission of opportunities to maximize partner program benefits and co-sell eligibility.

 - Collaborate closely with Sales, Strategic Alliances, Partner Operations, Marketing, Enablement, and partner stakeholders to ensure successful execution of partnership initiatives.

 - Help establish repeatable co-sell processes, operating rhythms, and best practices that can scale across Replit's partner ecosystem.

 - Maintain visibility into partner engagement across active opportunities and support accurate attribution of partner sourced and partner influenced pipeline.

 


REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - 5+ years of experience in enterprise sales, channel sales, partnerships, alliances, business development, partner management, or related go to market functions.

 - Experience working directly with enterprise Account Executives and sales organizations to drive pipeline and revenue outcomes.

 - Experience supporting enterprise co-sell motions with hyperscalers, cloud providers, ISVs, systems integrators, or strategic technology partners.

 - Strong understanding of enterprise sales cycles, opportunity management, and pipeline development.

 - Experience conducting account mapping, opportunity planning, and partner engagement activities.

 - Familiarity with deal registration processes and partner portal management across hyperscaler or ISV programs.

 - Strong relationship building skills and comfort working across both internal and external stakeholder groups.

 - Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple opportunities, priorities, and stakeholders simultaneously.

 - Experience operating in fast paced, high growth environments.

 - Excellent communication, coordination, and project management skills.

 - Strong Salesforce proficiency and familiarity with CRM driven sales processes.

 


BONUS QUALIFICATIONS

 - Familiarity with Microsoft, Google Cloud, Databricks, or other enterprise technology ecosystems.

 - Familiarity with Azure Marketplace, Google Cloud Marketplace, private offers, hyperscaler procurement motions, and co-sell programs.

 - Experience supporting partner sourced or partner influenced revenue motions.

 - Experience working in SaaS, cloud infrastructure, developer tools, AI, or enterprise software companies.

 - Experience helping build repeatable partnership and co-sell programs from the ground up.

 - Passion for AI, developer tools, and helping enterprises transform how software gets built.

  • virtualizacija i serveri: Instalacija, konfiguracija i proaktivno održavanje Windows servera te upravljanje Hyper-V virtualizacijskom okolinom i virtualnim strojevima (VM).
  • sigurnost podataka: Konfiguracija, nadzor i redovito testiranje sustava za sigurnosnu pohranu (backup) i oporavak podataka korištenjem Veeam rješenja.
  • upravljanje domenom: Administracija Active Directoryja (upravljanje korisničkim računima, grupama, pravima pristupa i GPO politikama).
  • file serveri: Održavanje i strukturiranje mrežnih dijeljenih mapa (File servers), dodjeljivanje prava i praćenje dostupnosti.
  • korisnička podrška i oprema: Instalacija, održavanje i rješavanje problema na radnim računalima (hardware i software) te konfiguracija mrežnih printera i ostale periferne opreme.
  • nadzor sustava: Praćenje rada cjelokupnog informacijskog sustava i pravovremeno rješavanje tehničkih poteškoća.
UVJETI
  • minimalno 1 godina radnog iskustva na istim ili sličnim poslovima.
  • napredno poznavanje Microsoft Windows Server okruženja je prednost.
  • praktično iskustvo s Hyper-V tehnologijom virtualizacije.
  • iskustvo u radu s Veeam Backup & Replication alatima.
  • odlično poznavanje Active Directory, DNS, DHCP servisa.
  • sposobnost samostalnog rješavanja problema s računalima (Windows 10/11) i perifernom opremom (printeri, skeneri).
  • poznavanje osnovnih mrežnih koncepata (LAN, WAN, TCP/IP, VPN)
ŠTO NUDIMO
  • ugovor na neodređeno vrijeme uz probni rok.
  • pristup najnovijim tehnologijama.
Kako se prijaviti? Ako prepoznaješ sebe u ovom opisu i želiš postati dio našeg tima, pošalji nam svoj životopis (CV) i kratko motivacijsko pismo na e-mail adresu: natjecaji@osatina.hr s naslovom "Prijava za posao: Sistem inženjer". Natječaj ostaje otvoren do 14.08.2026. Samo kandidati koji uđu u uži krug bit će kontaktirani. Radujemo se tvojoj prijavi!

jobs.description:
To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

Your profile

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment
- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling
- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions
- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures
- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching
- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company
- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discounts

Your next step - get in touch!

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

jobs.title: Mobile Product Designer
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. 

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Quality is our competitive advantage. Every member of our fully remote team is a maker at heart, caring deeply about the quality and feel of our work. While the industry optimizes for speed and metrics alone, we believe that craft and quality have lasting value. Quality creates gravity — it pulls people toward our team and product rather than requiring us to push. This philosophy drives everything we do, from product decisions to hiring choices.

For this role, we expect robust design skills, sharp product thinking, and the ability to engage in technical discussions. We work in small, autonomous project teams, where engineers are paired tightly with designers to explore ideas, build prototypes, deploy internal builds, and ultimately ship to customers. You will be a key element of projects from beginning to end.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in North America. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you'll do

 - Own the experience of our iOS and Android mobile apps, including guiding the adaptation of desktop features to mobile

 - Pair closely with mobile engineers and product leads to initiate and complete mobile-specific projects, no hand-offs

 - Take opportunities to redesign or refine key screens and flows, as well as smaller quality issues and “paper cuts” as you use Linear

 - Create mockups, prototypes, and high-fidelity visuals to communicate ideas and describe their execution

 - Guide and inspire fellow designers through collaborative critique of work-in-progress across both mobile and desktop platforms

 - Use and improve our lightweight design system components

 - Help with hiring new teammates that can elevate our team and product

What we’re looking for

 - 5+ years experience designing software, with mobile-specific emphasis

 - Courage to ask questions, experiment, and advocate for what you feel is right

 - Humility to accept feedback, adapt your thinking, and iterate toward the best solution

 - Experience with prototyping directly in code, or with tools like Figma, Origami, etc

 - Ability to distill problems and feedback, then design clear, focused solutions

 - Effective written and verbal communication skills — much of our work is async

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

jobs.title: Product Engineer, New Products
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Product Engineer, you’ll take emerging ideas from concept to polished experiences. You’ll build sophisticated, intuitive user experiences while working across AI models, agentic workflows, and all parts of web infrastructure to ship complete products.




The Goal: Build products that can define major new categories for Replit. You will combine the flexibility of software with the accessibility of presentations, spreadsheets, dashboards, and visual editors, enabling anyone to create powerful, interactive artifacts through natural language.




The Audience: We build for the next generation of creators, knowledge workers, and high-leverage teams. Our users should be able to turn an idea, dataset, or business problem into a polished, editable, and shareable product just by themselves.

Candidates who thrive here often have the product judgment, technical range, and ownership mindset associated with founders. This is a high-visibility role working closely with product leadership.





HOW WE WORK

Structure: We operate as a collective of in-house technical founders, not narrowly specialized engineers. Initiatives are run by lean, autonomous teams built for velocity and technical leverage. Engineers maintain meaningful ownership over technical direction, product quality, and launch success, supported by Product and Design partners.



Cadence: We work in focused three-week sprints, shipping quickly, observing real user behavior, and incorporating feedback into each iteration. We value decisive execution, thoughtful experimentation, and the ability to make progress without perfectly defined requirements.





WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own major product experiences from initial concept through design, implementation, launch, measurement, and continued improvement

 - Invent and build intuitive interfaces for generating, editing, arranging, and collaborating on AI-created presentations, data applications, and visual artifacts

 - Deliver exceptional frontend experiences across interaction design, typography, layout, motion, accessibility, performance, and error recovery

 - Partner directly with users, Product, Design, and AI engineers to understand real workflows, test ideas, and turn feedback into better products

 - Create reusable editing, visualization, and collaboration primitives that accelerate future products across Replit
   
   
   


REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

 - 4+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong record of shipping high-quality, user-facing products

 - Understanding of the full agentic software development stack, helping coding agents build, test and review correct code

 - Deep experience with TypeScript, React, HTML, and CSS, along with strong knowledge of browser performance, application state, responsive design, and accessibility

 - Strong product judgment and visual taste, with the ability to balance usability, speed, correctness, polish, and long-term maintainability

 - Comfort working across the full stack, including Node.js, APIs, Postgres, data models, and production debugging

 - Familiarity with agentic software development and how coding agents build, test, review, and operate software
   
   
   


BONUS POINTS

 - Building visual editors, presentation software, creative tools, data applications, developer tools, or collaboration products

 - Working with canvas or graphics systems, rich text, direct manipulation, real-time collaboration, data visualization, or complex interactive interfaces

 - Designing user experiences around AI generation, streaming responses, tool calls, and long-running agent workflows

 - Founding a technical company, working as a founding engineer, or shipping a high-visibility independent project

En tant que directeur(rice), vous serez le garant du bon fonctionnement de l'établissement, de la qualité de l'accueil et de la mise en œuvre du projet éducatif de la Ligue de l'enseignement.

Il(elle) assure la direction d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire, favorise le travail collaboratif et veille à la qualité du service rendu aux différents publics accueillis.
